items.summary_en: Amtrak’s ticket-booking system was reportedly down on Friday evening. The disruption occurred as thousands of travelers across the United States dealt with a nationwide FAA ground stop. An error message appeared on Amtrak’s website when users tried to book tickets.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，Amtrak 的订票系统于周五晚间宕机。与此同时，美国各地数千名旅客正应对 FAA 实施的全国地面停飞。用户尝试购票时，Amtrak 网站显示错误消息。

items.title_en: Queens Public Library under ransomware attack
items.title_zh: 皇后区公共图书馆遭遇勒索软件攻击
items.summary_en: Queens Public Library reported a significant network outage affecting all of its locations. The libraries were closed on November 11 for Veterans Day and were otherwise announced as open as scheduled despite the outage. The available notice does not confirm the cause of the network disruption.
items.summary_zh: 皇后区公共图书馆报告称，所有馆点均受到严重网络中断影响。图书馆 11 月 11 日因退伍军人节闭馆，除该节日外仍宣布按计划开放，尽管网络故障持续存在。现有公告没有确认网络中断的原因。

items.title_en: The Utah Teapot
items.title_zh: 犹他茶壶
items.summary_en: The Utah Teapot is presented as the subject of this item. The available context contains only a video reference and no further description.
items.summary_zh: 该条目以“犹他茶壶”为主题。现有信息只有一个视频引用，没有提供更多描述。

items.title_en: Nvidia deliberately kept GPU prices high through circular financing deals
items.title_zh: 英伟达通过循环融资交易蓄意维持 GPU 高价
items.summary_en: The headline alleges that Nvidia deliberately kept GPU prices high through circular financing deals. No further details are available here about the transactions or the evidence behind the allegation.
items.summary_zh: 标题指称英伟达通过循环融资交易蓄意维持 GPU 高价。现有信息未提供相关交易或这一指控所依据证据的更多细节。

items.title_en: Why I wrote the BEAM book (2025)
items.title_zh: 我为什么写《BEAM 之书》（2025）
items.summary_en: The author describes writing The BEAM Book after a decade of maintaining Klarna's core system. They began the project on October 12, 2012, with a four-line DocBook file, and spent the first two weeks mostly creating structure and metadata. The book was intended to help engineers diagnose BEAM pauses that could stall millions of peak-shopping payments.
items.summary_zh: 作者回顾了自己在维护 Klarna 核心系统十年后撰写《BEAM 之书》的经历。他于 2012 年 10 月 12 日以一个仅有四行内容的 DocBook 文件启动项目，前两周主要是在搭建结构和更新元数据。这本书旨在帮助工程师诊断可能让高峰购物期数百万笔支付停顿的 BEAM 暂停问题。

items.title_en: We need more goat sacrifices
items.title_zh: 我们需要更多山羊祭祀
items.summary_en: The discussion connects beliefs about luck with the idea that lucky people notice opportunities more readily. It suggests that visualization may help some people by training them to notice things differently, while noting that this is not presented as a scientific conclusion. The text also says that medieval magic practitioners viewed magic as working through this kind of perception rather than through an empirical or physics-based process.
items.summary_zh: 这段讨论将对运气的看法与“幸运的人更容易注意到机会”这一观点联系起来。文中认为，视觉化练习或许能通过训练人们改变观察方式而帮助部分人，但也明确表示这并非科学结论。文中还指出，中世纪的魔法实践者认为魔法正是通过这种感知方式发挥作用，而不是依靠经验科学或物理过程。

items.title_en: Elephants found to be increasingly isolated leading to fractured social networks
items.title_zh: 大象日益孤立，社会网络逐渐碎片化
items.summary_en: Researchers studying Asian elephants found that declining populations are producing more isolated and fractured communities. They warn that the animals may be approaching a social tipping point that could harm their future. Asian elephants rely on group networks to cooperate in obtaining food and caring for young.
items.summary_zh: 研究亚洲象社会动态的学者发现，数量下降正在造成更加孤立、更加碎片化的群体。研究人员警告，大象可能正在接近一个会危及其未来的社会性临界点。亚洲象依靠群体网络合作获取食物并照料幼崽。

items.title_en: Cryptocurrency lawsuit: Ethereum Foundation required "suicide pledge"
items.title_zh: 加密货币诉讼：以太坊基金会被要求签署“自杀承诺”
items.summary_en: A lawsuit filed in Colorado alleges that the Ethereum Foundation required employees to endorse a document described as a “suicide pledge.” The 38-page document, titled “The Ethereum Foundation Mandate,” reportedly outlined leadership’s vision for the foundation over the next 1,000 years. The foundation is a Switzerland-registered nonprofit supporting the Ethereum blockchain.
items.summary_zh: 科罗拉多州一宗诉讼指称，以太坊基金会要求员工认可一份被称为“自杀承诺”的文件。这份 38 页、名为《以太坊基金会使命》的文件据称阐述了管理层对基金会未来 1000 年的构想。该基金会是在瑞士注册、支持以太坊区块链的非营利组织。

items.title_en: A primer on GPUs and kernel optimization
items.title_zh: GPU 与内核优化入门
items.summary_en: This primer introduces the basics of GPUs, profilers, distributed computation, and kernel optimization. It is intended as an overview of the concepts involved in improving GPU program performance.
items.summary_zh: 这篇入门材料介绍 GPU、性能分析器、分布式计算和内核优化的基础知识，旨在概览提升 GPU 程序性能所涉及的核心概念。

items.title_en: Emacs Is My Browser
items.title_zh: Emacs 是我的浏览器
items.summary_en: The author has been using Emacs's EWW text-based browser more seriously as part of an effort to make Emacs the sole computing environment. After several days, EWW appeared sufficient for roughly 85–90% of browsing tasks, including many JavaScript-heavy sites. The author also says that EWW and other terminal browsers reduce the distractions and endless browsing loops common in modern graphical browsers.
items.summary_zh: 为了让 Emacs 成为唯一的计算环境，作者开始更认真地使用其文本浏览器 EWW。经过几天使用，作者认为 EWW 足以应对大约 85% 至 90% 的浏览需求，包括许多 JavaScript 密集型网站。作者还表示，EWW 及其他终端浏览器能减少现代图形浏览器中常见的干扰和无休止的浏览循环。

items.title_en: On Being an Engineer in 2026
items.title_zh: 2026 年如何成为一名工程师
items.summary_en: The piece is titled "On Being an Engineer in 2026." The available excerpt contains only links and no substantive description of its argument or subject matter.
items.summary_zh: 文章题为《2026 年如何成为一名工程师》。现有内容仅包含链接，没有提供其论点或主题的实质性描述。

items.title_en: Relax: JIT compiler for Rust to reduce build times
items.title_zh: Relax：通过减少构建时间实现 Rust 的 JIT 编译器
items.summary_en: Relax is a live compiler and JIT runtime for Rust, itself written in Rust. It runs a Cargo package directly from source without rustc, LLVM, or a linker in the execution loop. Instead of building first and running afterward, Relax runs the program while it is being built.
items.summary_zh: Relax 是一个用 Rust 编写的 Rust 实时编译器和 JIT 运行时。它可以直接从源代码运行 Cargo 包，执行过程中不需要 rustc、LLVM 或链接器。与先构建、后运行不同，Relax 会在程序构建的同时运行它。

items.title_en: A short explainer on how El Niño works [video]
items.title_zh: 简明视频解释厄尔尼诺如何运作
items.summary_en: A short video explains how El Niño works.
items.summary_zh: 一段简短视频解释了厄尔尼诺现象如何运作。

items.title_en: Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation
items.title_zh: 下一概念建模：快速并行的由粗到细文本生成
items.summary_en: Next-Concept Modeling is a two-stage, coarse-to-fine text-generation framework that uses hierarchical discrete codes and predicts all codes within each level in parallel. At comparable parameter scales, it reportedly runs 21× faster than the strongest diffusion-language-model baseline on LM1B, 10× faster on OpenWebText, and 31× faster on XSum while matching or improving quality metrics. On Sudoku, it outperformed autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all tested difficulty levels using fewer function evaluations.
items.summary_zh: 下一概念建模（NCM）是一种由粗到细的两阶段文本生成框架，使用分层离散编码，并在每一层并行预测全部编码。在相近参数规模下，NCM 据称在 LM1B 上比最强扩散语言模型基线快 21 倍，在 OpenWebText 上快 10 倍，在 XSum 上快 31 倍，同时保持或提升质量指标。在数独任务中，它使用更少的函数评估次数，在所有测试难度上都超过了自回归和扩散模型基线。

items.title_en: Show HN: I recreated Papers Please but you're deciding which YC startups to fund
items.title_zh: Show HN：我重制了《Papers, Please》，但你要决定资助哪些 YC 初创公司
items.summary_en: Term Sheet Please turns the central decision of Papers, Please into a startup-funding scenario. Players inspect founders’ financials, question their records, and decide which YC startups receive funding.
items.summary_zh: Term Sheet Please 将《Papers, Please》的核心决策机制改造成初创公司投资场景。玩家需要检查创始人的财务数据、质询记录，并决定哪些 YC 初创公司能够获得资金。

items.title_en: How Not to Build a Music Player
items.title_zh: 如何不要制作音乐播放器
items.summary_en: The author began archiving music and seeking offline alternatives after an internet shutdown made online music players impractical under an oppressive regime. Strawberry provided a feature-rich offline option, but its internet-fetched lyrics were sometimes not synchronized and displayed distracting timestamps. The experience led the author to consider alternatives such as foobar2000.
items.summary_zh: 互联网关闭后，在线音乐播放器在压制性政权环境下变得不切实际，作者因此开始归档音乐并寻找离线替代方案。功能丰富的 Strawberry 一度满足需求，但其联网获取的歌词有时不同步，还会显示令人分心的时间戳。这段经历让作者开始考虑 foobar2000 等其他播放器。

items.title_en: Old Bitly Links Are Being Hijacked
items.title_zh: 旧 Bitly 链接正遭劫持
items.summary_en: Burger King and McDonald’s were not hacked. Instead, someone re-registered Bitly links posted in their 2011 tweets. The same person or group has replaced 57 of 97 links in old tweets by Donald Trump.
items.summary_zh: 汉堡王和麦当劳并未遭到黑客入侵。有人重新注册了它们在 2011 年推文中使用的 Bitly 链接。同样的问题还影响了唐纳德·特朗普旧推文中的 97 个链接，其中 57 个已被替换。

items.title_en: Data centers need power – lower income, rural residents pay the price
items.title_zh: 数据中心需要电力——低收入和农村居民正在承担代价
items.summary_en: A Cornell study found that data centers paid only 38% of the energy-infrastructure costs linked to their growth across four major U.S. grids from 2020 to 2025. In 2025, they paid $3.12 billion of an $8.25 billion bill, leaving $5.13 billion largely to residents. The lowest-income households faced additional energy costs reaching up to 28% of their incomes.
items.summary_zh: 康奈尔大学的一项研究发现，在 2020 至 2025 年间，数据中心只承担了美国四个主要电网因其增长产生的能源基础设施成本的 38%。2025 年，数据中心支付了 82.5 亿美元账单中的 31.2 亿美元，剩余 51.3 亿美元主要由居民承担。最低收入家庭增加的能源支出最高可达到其收入的 28%。

items.title_en: 'Birdbrain' Is a Misnomer. Crows Make Decisions Faster Than We Can
items.title_zh: “鸟脑”是个误称：乌鸦做决定比人类更快
items.summary_en: In a recent experiment, crows processed and responded to visual cues at twice the speed of humans and monkeys. The study, published in Science, provides a first quantitative measure of the neural speed of avian decision-making. The results show that the crows outperformed both human and nonhuman primate participants.
items.summary_zh: 在一项近期实验中，乌鸦处理并回应视觉线索的速度是人类和猴子的两倍。这项发表于《科学》的研究首次量化了鸟类决策的神经速度。结果显示，乌鸦的表现超过了人类和非人类灵长类参与者。

items.title_en: Fossil CO2 emissions decrease in 2026
items.title_zh: 2026 年化石燃料二氧化碳排放下降
items.summary_en: The 2026 Global Carbon Budget projects that fossil-fuel carbon dioxide emissions will fall by 0.4% this year. The projected decline is attributed to the expansion of solar and wind power and the Iran conflict. Total fossil CO2 emissions are projected at 38.2 billion tonnes.
items.summary_zh: 《2026 年全球碳预算》预计，今年化石燃料二氧化碳排放量将下降 0.4%。预计降幅源于太阳能和风能扩张以及伊朗冲突。化石燃料二氧化碳排放总量预计为 382 亿吨。

items.title_en: All US airports are currently ground stopped
items.title_zh: 美国所有机场目前均实施地面停飞
items.summary_en: The FAA placed all U.S. airports under a ground stop, meaning flights could not depart for U.S. airports. Aircraft already in the air were allowed to land. The action was linked to an FAA equipment outage.
items.summary_zh: FAA 对美国所有机场实施了地面停飞，这意味着航班不得起飞前往美国机场。已经在空中的飞机获准降落。此次措施与 FAA 设备故障有关。

items.title_en: Protomaps: Self-hosting map tiles has gotten cheap and easy
items.title_zh: Protomaps：自托管地图瓦片如今既便宜又简单
items.summary_en: Protomaps uses PMTiles, a tile format that stores a map in a single file and serves it through HTTP Range requests. The file can be uploaded to a storage bucket and cached by compatible CDNs, while an edge function can translate conventional x/y/z tile URLs for services such as Cloudflare. This makes map data portable and inexpensive to deploy compared with usage-priced commercial APIs.
items.summary_zh: Protomaps 使用 PMTiles，这种瓦片格式将地图存储在单个文件中，并通过 HTTP Range 请求提供服务。该文件可以上传到存储桶并由支持相关缓存的 CDN 缓存；对于 Cloudflare 等服务，也可以用边缘函数将传统的 x/y/z 瓦片 URL 转换为 Range 请求。与按使用量收费的商业 API 相比，这让地图数据更易移植，也更便宜易部署。

items.title_en: Open research, stronger privacy: Making Firefox users harder to fingerprint
items.title_zh: 开放研究，强化隐私：让 Firefox 用户更难被指纹识别
items.summary_en: Firefox's latest fingerprinting protections reduce the amount of distinguishing information that tracking scripts can extract from browsers and devices. By making more Firefox users appear alike, the changes are intended to hinder cross-site recognition even when trackers do not use cookies. Mozilla says the protections are based on research into which browser and device details make users uniquely identifiable.
items.summary_zh: Firefox 最新的指纹识别防护减少了跟踪脚本能够从浏览器和设备中提取的区分性信息。通过让更多 Firefox 用户呈现相似特征，这些改动旨在阻碍即使不使用 Cookie 的跨网站识别。Mozilla 表示，这些防护措施建立在其对哪些浏览器和设备细节会使用户具有唯一可识别性的研究之上。

items.title_en: 'Grey Rocking': The Life-Improving Power of Being Really, Really Boring (2021)
items.title_zh: “灰色岩石法”：极度无聊也能改善生活的力量（2021）
items.summary_en: The grey rock technique recommends responding to difficult people with deliberately uninteresting, emotionally neutral behavior. The term was coined in 2012 by an American mental-health blogger using the pseudonym Skylar, after she left a 25-year relationship she considered abusive and dangerous. The technique has since been described as useful in both serious and everyday situations.
items.summary_zh: “灰色岩石法”建议人们以刻意无趣且情绪中立的方式回应难以相处的人。这个术语由一名使用 Skylar 笔名的美国心理健康博主于 2012 年提出，当时她刚结束一段持续 25 年、被自己认为具有虐待性和危险性的关系。此后，这一技巧被描述为既适用于严肃情境，也适用于日常场景。

items.title_en: Why is Google cutting off Search from AI-free schools? Here are some theories
items.title_zh: Google 为什么要切断与“无 AI”学校的搜索服务？这里有几种猜测
items.summary_en: The item examines why Google may be cutting off Search from schools that avoid AI. It notes that Google is deeply embedded in the school day for millions of students, serving not only as a search engine but also as a hub for sharing documents and submitting homework. No specific explanation for the policy is provided in the available context.
items.summary_zh: 该条目探讨 Google 可能为何要切断对不使用 AI 的学校提供搜索服务。它指出，Google 已深度融入数百万学生的日常学习，不仅是搜索引擎，也是分享文档和提交作业的平台。现有信息未提供这一政策的具体原因。

items.title_en: The same H100 costs $2.69 or $12.29 an hour depending where you rent it
items.title_zh: 同一块 H100 的租用价格可能是每小时 2.69 或 12.29 美元
items.summary_en: A price comparison normalizes on-demand GPU rental costs across AWS, Azure, and neocloud providers by GPU and hour. For identical GPUs, it reports a 4.57× gap between the cheapest and most expensive options. Running one GPU continuously for a month costs $1,964 or $8,972 depending only on the provider.
items.summary_zh: 一项价格比较按 GPU 和每小时费用，对 AWS、Azure 及新型云服务商的按需 GPU 租赁价格进行了标准化。对于相同 GPU，最便宜和最昂贵选项之间的价格差达到 4.57 倍。连续运行一块 GPU 一个月，费用可能因服务商不同而为 1964 美元或 8972 美元。

items.title_en: Brazil's Caixa insurer breach exposes names and tax IDs of all 7.6M customers
items.title_zh: 巴西 Caixa 保险公司遭入侵，760 万客户的姓名和税号曝光
items.summary_en: A breach at Brazil’s Caixa insurer exposed the names and tax identification numbers of all 7.6 million customers. No further information about the incident is available.
items.summary_zh: 巴西 Caixa 保险公司遭遇数据泄露，全部 760 万名客户的姓名和税号被曝光。现有信息未提供更多关于此次事件的细节。

items.title_en: U.S. October PPI Rises 6.5% YoY, Highest in Nearly Four Years
items.title_zh: 美国 10 月生产者价格同比上涨 6.5%，近四年来最高
items.summary_en: U.S. producer prices rose 6.5% year over year in October, the highest increase since November 2022. The result was slightly below the 6.6% expectation but above September’s 6.3%, while prices rose 0.3% month over month versus the 0.4% forecast. September’s monthly increase was revised from 1.3% to 1.4%.
items.summary_zh: 美国生产者价格指数 10 月同比上涨 6.5%，创 2022 年 11 月以来最高涨幅。该结果略低于 6.6% 的预期，但高于 9 月的 6.3%；环比上涨 0.3%，也低于 0.4% 的预期。9 月环比涨幅则由 1.3% 修正为 1.4%。

items.title_en: Fireworks AI security breach impacts Notion and their customers
items.title_zh: Fireworks AI 安全漏洞影响 Notion 及其客户
items.summary_en: Notion says a security incident at its vendor Fireworks AI may have affected fewer than 1% of Notion workspaces. Some unattributable chat sessions with Notion AI may have been exposed, but the transcripts contained no tool-call results and could not be tied to a user, workspace, or company. Notion says no other workspace data was affected.
items.summary_zh: Notion 表示，其供应商 Fireworks AI 的一次安全事件可能影响了不到 1% 的 Notion 工作区。部分与 Notion AI 的聊天会话可能被暴露，但这些记录没有标注用户或工作区，也不包含工具调用结果，无法追溯到具体用户、工作区或公司。Notion 表示，工作区中的其他数据未受影响。

items.title_en: Children of Men: The future is a mirror for the present
items.title_zh: 《人类之子》：未来是当下的镜子
items.summary_en: The piece revisits Alfonso Cuarón’s 2006 science-fiction film Children of Men, starring Clive Owen, Clare-Hope Ashitey, Julianne Moore, and Michael Caine. It calls the film one of the best science-fiction movies of the 21st century and argues that science fiction and stories about the future are inherently connected to politics and the present.
items.summary_zh: 文章重新讨论了 Alfonso Cuarón 于 2006 年执导的科幻电影《人类之子》，主演包括 Clive Owen、Clare-Hope Ashitey、Julianne Moore 和 Michael Caine。文章称其为 21 世纪最出色的科幻电影之一，并认为科幻作品和关于未来的故事都与政治及当下密不可分。

items.title_en: Singapore Says U.S. Not Helpful on Investigation into Suspected Spy's Company
items.title_zh: 新加坡称美国没有帮助调查涉嫌间谍的公司
items.summary_en: Singapore said the United States provided little help with its investigation into Alice Huang, who is at the center of a suspected spy plot linked to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Singapore held Alice Huang’s passport from June 2025 until February over potential false declarations involving her company, Megaspeed. She was released with a stern warning and barred from re-entering Singapore.
items.summary_zh: 新加坡表示，美国在调查 Alice Huang 一案中提供的帮助很少；她是一起涉嫌间谍活动的核心人物，该案牵涉英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋。新加坡因 Megaspeed 公司可能存在虚假申报，从 2025 年 6 月至次年 2 月扣留 Alice Huang 的护照。她后来收到严厉警告并被禁止再次入境新加坡。

items.title_en: The first 300-millimeter power silicon carbide (SiC) wafer
items.title_zh: 首片 300 毫米功率碳化硅晶圆
items.summary_en: Infineon announced what it describes as the world's first 300-millimeter power silicon-carbide wafer. The announcement presents the wafer as an innovation milestone. The available excerpt provides no further manufacturing or product details.
items.summary_zh: 英飞凌宣布推出其所称的全球首片 300 毫米功率碳化硅晶圆。该公司将其称为一项创新里程碑。现有内容未提供更多制造或产品细节。

items.title_en: Lonewolf 0.3 – A standalone XMPP server written in Rust
items.title_zh: Lonewolf 0.3：用 Rust 编写的独立 XMPP 服务器
items.summary_en: Lonewolf 0.3.0 adds certificate-authenticated federation, direct TLS, and additional desktop-client features. It remains a pre-1.0, single-node server, while full XMPP compliance and clustering are still on the roadmap. The release expands secure federation without yet providing those larger deployment features.
items.summary_zh: Lonewolf 0.3.0 新增基于证书认证的联邦通信、直接 TLS，以及更多桌面客户端功能。它仍是一个处于 1.0 之前阶段的单节点服务器，完整 XMPP 兼容性和集群支持仍在路线图中。此次更新增强了安全联邦能力，但尚未提供这些更大规模部署功能。

items.title_en: The Dawn of the Data Intelligence Engineer
items.title_zh: 数据智能工程师的黎明
items.summary_en: AI has changed data-team work by allowing agents to handle much of the traditional workload. MotherDuck co-founder and data engineer Nick Ursa says he has no backlog for the first time in his career, yet remains busier because people must verify answers produced by LLMs and agents. The role is shifting from calculating correct numbers to ensuring that machine-generated numbers are correct.
items.summary_zh: AI 让代理能够承担许多传统数据团队工作，正在改变数据团队的工作方式。MotherDuck 联合创始人兼数据工程师 Nick Ursa 表示，这是他职业生涯中第一次没有待办积压，但他仍比过去更忙，因为人工仍需核验大语言模型和代理生成的答案。这个岗位正从计算正确数字，转向确保机器生成的数字正确。

items.title_en: Libreagi – Save OSS Models
items.title_zh: LibreAGI：保存开源模型
items.summary_en: LibreAGI is a private BitTorrent tracker where members preserve copies of open models that may disappear from their original hosting locations. The project argues that open models should outlive the services that host them. It provides torrent-based tooling for sharing model copies.
items.summary_zh: LibreAGI 是一个私有 BitTorrent Tracker，成员可保存那些可能从原托管位置消失的开源模型副本。该项目认为，开源模型的存续时间不应受限于托管它们的服务。项目提供了基于种子文件共享模型副本的工具。

items.title_en: To deter bioterrorism, U.S. imposes new rules on ordering synthetic DNA
items.title_zh: 为遏制生物恐怖主义，美国对合成 DNA 的订购实施新规
items.summary_en: The United States is imposing new rules on ordering synthetic DNA. The stated purpose is to deter bioterrorism. The available information does not specify the rules' exact requirements or scope.
items.summary_zh: 美国正在对合成 DNA 的订购实施新规则。其目的被表述为遏制生物恐怖主义。现有信息未说明这些规则的具体要求或适用范围。

items.title_en: Starship Flight 15 on 11/13 plans to catch both booster and ship
items.title_zh: 星舰第 15 次飞行计划于 11 月 13 日同时接住助推器和飞船
items.summary_en: SpaceX’s Starship Flight 15 is scheduled for November 13 and plans to catch both the booster and the ship. The available information identifies SpaceX as a company that designs, manufactures, and launches rockets and spacecraft, but provides no further details about the flight plan.
items.summary_zh: SpaceX 的星舰第 15 次飞行计划于 11 月 13 日进行，目标是同时接住助推器和飞船。现有信息只说明 SpaceX 负责设计、制造和发射火箭及航天器，没有提供更多飞行计划细节。

items.title_en: Making a €40 USB-C hub work as a Nintendo Switch 2 dock
items.title_zh: 让一款 40 欧元的 USB-C Hub 充当 Nintendo Switch 2 底座
items.summary_en: The project investigates how to make a €40 USB-C hub work as a Nintendo Switch 2 dock. The author wanted a smaller travel alternative to the official dock and used a USB-PD sniffer to examine why a generic hub normally fails. The hub is a Cable Matters 7-in-1 model with DisplayPort, HDMI, VGA, and up to 60 watts of power.
items.summary_zh: 该项目研究如何让一款 40 欧元的 USB-C Hub 充当 Nintendo Switch 2 底座。作者希望找到比官方底座更适合旅行的替代品，并使用 USB-PD 嗅探器分析普通 Hub 无法工作的原因。这款 Hub 是 Cable Matters 七合一型号，配有 DisplayPort、HDMI、VGA 接口，供电能力最高为 60 瓦。

items.title_en: US IRS free online tax filing open source repo (2025)
items.title_zh: 美国国税局免费在线报税开源仓库（2025）
items.summary_en: Direct File is a US government service that lets taxpayers file federal returns electronically for free and directly with the IRS. It uses interview-style questions, works across phones and computers, supports English and Spanish, and translates users' answers into tax forms submitted through the IRS Modernized e-File API. The repository contains the service's code and related tests and scenarios.
items.summary_zh: Direct File 是美国政府提供的服务，允许纳税人免费通过电子方式直接向美国国税局提交联邦税表。该服务采用问答式界面，可在手机和电脑等设备上使用，支持英语和西班牙语，并将用户答案转换为税表后通过国税局 Modernized e-File API 提交。该开源仓库包含服务代码以及相关测试和场景。

items.title_en: Hacking the Meta Ray-Ban smartglasses
items.title_zh: 破解 Meta Ray-Ban 智能眼镜
items.summary_en: In July, the author examined the previous year's Pwn2Own targets while waiting for the 2026 rules. They unexpectedly achieved arbitrary code execution on the Meta Ray-Ban glasses. The glasses were no longer in the wearables category at that time.
items.summary_zh: 今年 7 月，在等待 2026 年 Pwn2Own 规则期间，作者研究了前一年的目标设备。他意外地在 Meta Ray-Ban 眼镜上实现了任意代码执行。当时，这款眼镜已经不再属于可穿戴设备类别。

items.title_en: The Hardest Tarball?
items.title_zh: 最难的 Tar 包？
items.summary_en: The author presents an archive that can be created with a single GNU tar invocation but extracted in eight distinct ways depending on the tool used. The archive contains repeated files, a hard link, an empty file, and a PAX header whose UTF-8 filename and size record alter how the entries are interpreted. Its behavior depends on how extraction tools handle hard-link sizes and the resulting tar-header-sized value.
items.summary_zh: 作者展示了一个只需一次 GNU tar 调用即可构造、却会因解压工具不同而产生八种解压结果的归档文件。该归档包含重复文件、硬链接、空文件，以及一个会改变条目解释方式的 PAX 头，其中记录了 UTF-8 文件名和大小。其行为取决于解压工具如何处理硬链接大小，以及由此产生的恰好等于 tar 头大小的数值。

items.title_en: Switcher (2004)
items.title_zh: Switcher（2004）
items.summary_en: The author recalls Thunderscan, a low-cost, high-resolution scanner for the Macintosh developed with Thunderware after taking a leave of absence from Apple in March 1984. Work began in June 1984, and the product was nearly complete by early October. The account places the development in the author’s early post-Apple work.
items.summary_zh: 作者回忆了 Thunderscan：这是一款与 Thunderware 合作开发的低成本高分辨率 Macintosh 扫描仪，项目始于作者 1984 年 3 月离开 Apple 休假之后。开发于 1984 年 6 月开始，到 10 月初产品已基本完成。这段经历属于作者离开 Apple 后早期工作的内容。

items.title_en: Perplexity Decider v1.3: Training, eval, and use cases
items.title_zh: Perplexity Decider v1.3：训练、评测与使用场景
items.summary_en: Perplexity released Decider v1.3 and the smaller distilled Decider Flash v1.3. The models are described alongside training and evaluation details, including locate extraction, real-world results, and costs. Both are available on Hugging Face under the Apache license, through OpenRouter, and via the Perplexity Decisions API.
items.summary_zh: Perplexity 发布了 Decider v1.3，以及由其蒸馏而来的较小模型 Decider Flash v1.3。配套介绍涵盖训练与评测细节，包括定位提取、真实场景结果和成本。两款模型均以 Apache 许可证发布于 Hugging Face，并可通过 OpenRouter 和 Perplexity Decisions API 使用。

items.title_en: Demystifying phone unlocking tools: A technical overview
items.title_zh: 手机解锁工具揭秘：技术概览
items.summary_en: This is a technical overview of tools used to unlock mobile phones. The available material provides no further details about the tools or techniques covered.
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇关于手机解锁工具的技术概览。现有信息未提供所涉及工具或技术的更多细节。

items.title_en: M John Harrison becomes first science fiction author to win the Booker
items.title_zh: M·约翰·哈里森成为首位获得布克奖的科幻作家
items.summary_en: Eighty-one-year-old M. John Harrison has won the Booker Prize for The End of Everything, a post-apocalyptic novel set on a near-future Kent coast. He becomes the oldest winner in the prize’s history. The award is worth £50,000.
items.summary_zh: 81 岁的 M·约翰·哈里森凭借《一切的终结》获得布克奖。这部后末日小说以近未来的肯特海岸为背景，使他成为该奖历史上最年长的获奖者。奖金额为 50,000 英镑。

items.title_en: OpenAI disbands its robotics team as its general models start running robots
items.title_zh: OpenAI 解散机器人团队，通用模型开始驱动机器人
items.summary_en: OpenAI disbanded its standalone robotics team and reassigned its researchers to the main research organization under Chief Research Officer Mark Chen. Applied robotics and hardware teams moved to the larger Applied organization led by President Greg Brockman. OpenAI said robotics remains a core long-term goal, framing the reorganization as a commitment to the field rather than a retreat.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 解散了独立的机器人团队，并将研究人员调入由首席研究官 Mark Chen 领导的主要研究部门。应用机器人和硬件团队则转入由总裁 Greg Brockman 负责的更大规模 Applied 部门。OpenAI 表示，机器人仍是其长期核心目标，并将此次重组描述为对该领域的持续投入，而非退缩。

items.title_en: Weight Space Misfolding
items.title_zh: 权重空间错折
items.summary_en: Weight-space editing directly changes a neural network’s knowledge, behavior, or alignment. The work calls the possibility that one model induces unauthorized behavior in another “weight space misfolding,” including direct interference and possible onward propagation. It presents a threat model centered on the asymmetry between generating one harmful payload and detecting it among a model’s weights.
items.summary_zh: 权重空间编辑会直接改变神经网络的知识、行为或对齐状态。该研究将一个模型诱导另一个模型产生未授权行为的可能性称为“权重空间错折”，并讨论直接干预及潜在的继续传播。研究提出了一个威胁模型，重点关注攻击者只需生成一次恶意载荷，而防御者却必须在模型权重中搜寻它这一不对称性。

items.title_en: Ultorg: The User Interface for Relational Databases
items.title_zh: Ultorg：关系数据库的用户界面
items.summary_en: Ultorg is a spreadsheet-like interface for querying and editing relational databases across tables and relationships. It is designed to work without SQL or custom CRUD applications. The software is available for macOS, Windows, and Linux with a 14-day free trial.
items.summary_zh: Ultorg 是一个类似电子表格的关系数据库界面，可跨表和关系查询、编辑数据。它无需 SQL 或定制 CRUD 应用即可使用。该软件支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，并提供 14 天免费试用。

items.title_en: Researchers discover rare star system that emits radio signals every 8 minutes
items.title_zh: 研究人员发现每 8 分钟发出一次无线电信号的罕见星系系统
items.summary_en: Scientists at the Curtin University node of ICRAR linked mysterious radio pulses to a pair of stars known as GPM J071507−114153. The system contains a white dwarf and a G-type star similar to the Sun, orbiting each other. The white dwarf spins once every eight minutes, providing the unusual timing associated with the signals.
items.summary_zh: 国际射电天文学研究中心科廷大学节点的科学家将神秘无线电脉冲与名为 GPM J071507−114153 的双星系统联系起来。该系统由一颗白矮星和一颗类似太阳的 G 型恒星组成，两者相互绕行。白矮星每 8 分钟自转一周，这与信号出现的特殊周期相对应。

items.title_en: A general purpose Apple Silicon layer for x86-64 PCs
items.title_zh: 面向 x86-64 PC 的通用 Apple Silicon 层
items.summary_en: Stela is a UEFI boot program intended to provide an Apple Silicon layer for x86-64 PCs. It includes an Arm64-to-x86-64 translator, an NVIDIA Metal driver, and a model of Apple silicon hardware, and can currently boot macOS and most apps. The v0.1.0 release is slow, requires more testing, and has a low chance of booting on current hardware.
items.summary_zh: Stela 是一个面向 x86-64 PC、旨在提供 Apple Silicon 兼容层的 UEFI 启动程序。它包含 Arm64 到 x86-64 的转换器、NVIDIA Metal 驱动以及 Apple 芯片硬件模型，目前可以启动 macOS 和大多数应用。v0.1.0 运行速度较慢，仍需大量测试，在当前硬件上成功启动的概率也很低。

items.title_en: Retirement Savings Are Fueling the AI Bubble
items.title_zh: 退休储蓄正在助推 AI 泡沫
items.summary_en: The piece argues that Americans broadly oppose the construction of AI datacenters while their retirement accounts help finance it. It cites a $3.2 trillion one-day stock-market loss and nearly $1 trillion in lost value for the “Magnificent Seven” after concerns about AI spending and borrowing. The central question is whether future AI demand will be sufficient to cover the industry’s investments and loans.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，美国人总体上反对建设 AI 数据中心，但他们的退休账户却在为相关建设提供资金。文章提到股市单日蒸发 3.2 万亿美元，以及“科技七巨头”在市场担忧 AI 支出和借贷后市值损失近 1 万亿美元。文章提出的核心问题是，未来对 AI 的需求是否足以覆盖该行业的巨额投资和贷款。

items.title_en: Show HN: Black Ops II statically recompiled to native ARM64 macOS
items.title_zh: Show HN：将《使命召唤：黑色行动 II》静态重编译为原生 ARM64 macOS 应用
items.summary_en: This project statically recompiles a Steam copy of Black Ops II into a native ARM64 macOS application using Claude Opus 5.5, without Wine, Crossover, Rosetta, or another emulator. The game reportedly runs at nearly 60 frames per second across the campaign, local multiplayer with bots, and local Zombies mode, including owned DLC maps. Split-screen is being worked on, while LAN mode is planned for later.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目使用 Claude Opus 5.5，将 Steam 版《使命召唤：黑色行动 II》静态重编译为原生 ARM64 macOS 应用，不依赖 Wine、Crossover、Rosetta 或其他模拟器。据称，战役、本地机器人多人模式和本地僵尸模式都能以接近 60 帧运行，已拥有的 DLC 地图也可使用。开发者正在处理分屏功能，局域网模式则计划稍后加入。

items.title_en: Show HN: A terminal-native idle factory game, written in Rust with ratatui
items.title_zh: Show HN：用 Rust 和 ratatui 编写的终端原生放置工厂游戏
items.summary_en: Term inactory is a cozy factory game that runs directly in a terminal and was built for playing while waiting on long-running agent tasks. It includes basic factory mechanics such as building, deleting, selecting, measuring earnings, and researching unlocks. Additional features include a fictional browser with a wiki and forums, extensive lore, and hooks that display coding-agent responses as in-game “telegrams.”
items.summary_zh: Term inactory 是一款直接运行在终端中的休闲工厂游戏，适合在等待耗时较长的代理任务时游玩。游戏包含建造、删除、选择、收益测算和研究解锁等基本工厂机制。它还加入了带有 Wiki 和论坛的虚构浏览器、大量背景故事，以及将编码代理回复显示为游戏内“电报”的钩子功能。

items.title_en: I gave an agent a lakehouse and control of my garden
items.title_zh: 我给智能体一座湖仓和一块花园
items.summary_en: The project uses eleven sensors, a camera, an old phone, and an agent to water roughly two square metres of vegetables. The author presents it as an experiment in home gardening and as a way to consider where the Internet of Things is heading. The setup produced a lettuce costing about €60.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目使用 11 个传感器、一台摄像头、一部旧手机和一个智能体，为约两平方米的蔬菜浇水。作者将其作为家庭园艺实验，也借此思考物联网的发展方向。这套系统种出了一棵成本约 60 欧元的生菜。

items.title_en: $30M Raised to Redo the CPU
items.title_zh: 融资 3000 万美元，重做 CPU
items.summary_en: Tendrils has completed a $30 million funding round led by Benchmark to rebuild general-purpose computing. The company argues that backward compatibility with sequential, single-core processors has left modern CPUs burdened by cache-coherency protocols and reorder buffers. Tendrils says it wants to move general-purpose computing beyond architectures designed for legacy software.
items.summary_zh: Tendrils 已完成由 Benchmark 领投的 3,000 万美元融资，目标是重构通用计算。该公司认为，为兼容顺序式单核处理器，现代 CPU 承担了复杂的缓存一致性协议和重排序缓冲区等历史负担。Tendrils 表示，希望让通用计算超越为旧软件设计的架构。

items.title_en: Live-migration support in FreeBSD and bhyve coming
items.title_zh: FreeBSD 和 bhyve 即将支持实时迁移
items.summary_en: A first working implementation can live-migrate a running amd64 bhyve guest between two FreeBSD 15.1 hosts over TCP. The guest continues running during pre-copy memory transfer and dirty-page tracking, pausing only for the final stop-and-copy phase. The work adds migration support to the vmm kernel module, bhyve, and bhyvectl, while building on experimental snapshot support.
items.summary_zh: 一项初步可用的实现可以通过 TCP，在两台 FreeBSD 15.1 主机之间实时迁移运行中的 amd64 bhyve 虚拟机。虚拟机在预复制内存传输和脏页跟踪期间继续运行，仅在最后的停止并复制阶段暂停。该工作为 vmm 内核模块、bhyve 和 bhyvectl 增加了迁移支持，并建立在实验性快照功能之上。

items.title_en: Jensen Huang might return to Nvidia as CEO
items.title_zh: 黄仁勋可能回归英伟达担任 CEO
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang might return to Nvidia as chief executive.
items.summary_zh: 黄仁勋可能回归英伟达担任首席执行官。

items.title_en: Show HN: AgentRun – open-source, Self-improving Managed Agents
items.title_zh: Show HN：AgentRun——开源、自我改进的托管智能体
items.summary_en: GREP.AI has open-sourced AgentRun as a managed platform for agents. It includes self-improving agents, web-grounded workflows, sandboxes, computer environments, tools and integrations, and behavioral analytics. AgentRun supports harnesses including Pi, Claude Agents, Codex, and OpenCode, and can be self-hosted or used as a hosted service.
items.summary_zh: GREP.AI 将 AgentRun 开源为一个托管智能体平台。它包含自我改进智能体、基于网页信息的工作流、沙箱和计算机环境、工具与集成，以及智能体行为分析。AgentRun 支持 Pi、Claude Agents、Codex 和 OpenCode 等 harness，也可自行托管或使用托管版本。

items.title_en: Formalizing US Tax Code (Using Lean)
items.title_zh: 用 Lean 形式化美国税法
items.summary_en: The project aims to formalize the entire U.S. Internal Revenue Code in Lean and use formal search to find previously unknown loopholes. Lean’s type checker verifies mathematical proofs step by step from explicit definitions. Earlier experiments reportedly rediscovered known loopholes, including the backdoor Roth, by searching retirement-account rules.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目计划用 Lean 形式化整个美国《国内税收法典》，并通过形式化搜索寻找此前未知的漏洞。Lean 的类型检查器会根据明确的定义逐步验证数学证明。此前的实验据称已经通过搜索退休账户规则重新发现了包括 backdoor Roth 在内的已知漏洞。

items.title_en: Microsoft outage gives customers a crash course in dependence on Redmond
items.title_zh: 微软宕机让客户切身体会对雷德蒙德的依赖
items.summary_en: Microsoft 365 services were slowly recovering from a prolonged outage. Affected customers lost access to email, experienced unreliable Teams messaging, and could not use collaboration features normally. The disruption became a case study for critics of relying heavily on a single vendor.
items.summary_zh: Microsoft 365 服务正从一次持续较久的宕机中逐步恢复。受影响客户无法使用电子邮件，Teams 消息传递不稳定，协作功能也无法正常使用。这次中断成为批评过度依赖单一供应商者所指的一个现实案例。

items.title_en: CUI – Native UI components for C
items.title_zh: CUI：面向 C 的原生 UI 组件
items.summary_en: CUI is a library of about 190 native UI components for C. The components include spring-based motion and keyboard support, and are available to try in a live demonstration.
items.summary_zh: CUI 是一个面向 C 语言的原生 UI 组件库，包含约 190 个组件。组件支持弹簧动画和键盘操作，并可通过在线演示实时体验。

items.title_en: Huawei releases MACaQ, its internal quantizer for local inference
items.title_zh: 华为发布用于本地推理的内部量化器 MACaQ
items.summary_en: MACaQ is a model-agnostic quantization system for GGUF and local inference across text, image, video, and audio models. It supports llama.cpp, vLLM, Diffusers, and PyTorch. Huawei says it can quantize a 122-billion-parameter model in 64 minutes using 32.5 GB of device memory, while achieving lower perplexity than MR-GPTQ and DuQuant++ in stated comparisons.
items.summary_zh: MACaQ 是一个面向 GGUF 和本地推理的模型无关量化系统，支持文本、图像、视频和音频模型。它兼容 llama.cpp、vLLM、Diffusers 和 PyTorch。华为称，MACaQ 可使用 32.5 GB 设备内存，在 64 分钟内完成一个 1220 亿参数模型的量化；在其给出的比较中，困惑度低于 MR-GPTQ 和 DuQuant++。

items.title_en: Italy fines Meta €805M over photo privacy
items.title_zh: 意大利因照片隐私问题对 Meta 处以 8.05 亿欧元罚款
items.summary_en: Italy has fined Meta €805 million over photo privacy. No further details are available about the authority's findings or the specific practices involved.
items.summary_zh: 意大利因照片隐私问题对 Meta 处以 8.05 亿欧元罚款。现有信息未提供监管机构调查结果或相关具体做法的更多细节。

items.title_en: Tailscale's DNS IPv6 spells out "Tailscale"
items.title_zh: Tailscale 的 DNS IPv6 地址拼出了“Tailscale”
items.summary_en: Tailscale’s DNS IPv6 address is designed so that its hexadecimal representation spells “Tailscale.” This is presented as an Easter egg in the service’s DNS configuration.
items.summary_zh: Tailscale 的 DNS IPv6 地址经过设计，其十六进制表示形式会拼出“Tailscale”。这是该服务 DNS 配置中的一个彩蛋。

items.title_en: Formalizing CPython
items.title_zh: 形式化 CPython
items.summary_en: AI agents wrote 613,318 lines of Lean modeling Python's internals and tested each piece against the real Python implementation. The work uncovered 418 bug reports in Python. A correction excluding GUI-related code changed the modeled coverage from 15.7% to 14.3%.
items.summary_zh: AI 智能体编写了 613,318 行 Lean 代码，用于逐行建模 Python 的内部机制，并将每个部分与真实 Python 实现进行测试。这个过程发现了 Python 中的 418 个 bug 报告。由于修正了对 GUI 相关代码的统计，已建模覆盖率从 15.7% 改为 14.3%。

items.title_en: Serving GLM-5.3 at 607.8 tok/s across two Nvidia DGX stations with vLLM
items.title_zh: 使用 vLLM 在两台英伟达 DGX 工作站上以 607.8 token/s 部署 GLM-5.3
items.summary_en: The deployment uses two NVIDIA DGX Stations connected by ConnectX-8 RDMA to serve GLM-5.3 through one endpoint. Tensor parallelism splits the model’s weights and computation across the systems. The NVFP4 model has 753 billion parameters, activates 40 billion per token, and occupies about 464 GB, exceeding the 252 GB of HBM3e on a single GB300 GPU, so the setup keeps all weights in GPU memory without CPU offload.
items.summary_zh: 该部署使用两台通过 ConnectX-8 RDMA 连接的 NVIDIA DGX 工作站，通过单一端点提供 GLM-5.3 服务。张量并行将模型权重和计算任务拆分到两台机器上。这个 NVFP4 模型拥有 7530 亿个参数，每个 token 激活 400 亿个参数，占用约 464 GB，超过单块 GB300 GPU 的 252 GB HBM3e，因此该方案不启用 CPU 权重卸载，而是将全部权重保存在 GPU 内存中。

items.title_en: NetBSD 11 desktop on a Raspberry Pi 4
items.title_zh: 树莓派 4 上的 NetBSD 11 桌面
items.summary_en: The author’s guide describes running a NetBSD 11 desktop on a Raspberry Pi 4. After the post received unexpected attention on Hacker News, the author updated parts of the guide, including instructions for writing the image to an SD card. The author also noted interest in NetBSD as an AI-free alternative.
items.summary_zh: 作者的指南介绍了如何在 Raspberry Pi 4 上运行 NetBSD 11 桌面。文章意外受到 Hacker News 关注后，作者更新了部分内容，包括将系统镜像写入 SD 卡的说明。作者还提到，人们对 NetBSD 作为无 AI 替代方案的兴趣有所增加。

items.title_en: Handwriting, as a Font
items.title_zh: 把手写字迹变成字体
items.summary_en: This browser tool turns a user’s handwriting into a font. Users write each letter in the browser and download the result as OTF or WOFF2. No account or upload is required, and the letters remain on the device.
items.summary_zh: 这个浏览器工具可以将用户的手写字迹转换为字体。用户在浏览器中书写每个字母，然后下载 OTF 或 WOFF2 格式的字体。它无需账户或上传，字母会保留在设备上。

items.title_en: Taking another shot at the cheap IP camera, part 2
items.title_zh: 再次尝试廉价 IP 摄像头，第 2 部分
items.summary_en: The author revisits a cheap IP camera based on the proprietary Tuya IoT platform after previously failing to obtain a local video stream without using the vendor’s servers. During a move, the author decided to try again, first attempting reverse engineering personally and then considering an LLM if needed. The goal was both to recover local streaming and learn from the model’s analysis.
items.summary_zh: 作者重新尝试研究一款基于 Tuya 专有物联网平台的廉价 IP 摄像头；此前作者未能在不经过厂商服务器的情况下获得本地视频流。搬家期间，作者决定再次挑战，先亲自进行逆向工程，失败后再考虑使用 LLM。目标既是恢复本地视频流，也是从模型的分析中学习。

items.title_en: Book list for streetfighting computer scientists
items.title_zh: 街头格斗计算机科学家的书单
items.summary_en: This 2025 book list intentionally differs from conventional “best books for programmers” recommendations. It emphasizes books the author believes computer scientists should read to understand the systems and ideas behind their work, rather than focusing on standard programming advice. The author also presents C and C++ as broadly implemented lingua francas and describes Rust as useful for writing and reading code.
items.summary_zh: 这份 2025 年书单有意区别于常见的“程序员最佳读物”推荐。它更重视作者认为计算机科学家应阅读的、帮助理解系统及其背后思想的书，而不是常规编程建议。作者还将 C 和 C++ 视为广泛实现的通用语言，并认为 Rust 适合编写和阅读代码。

items.title_en: DeepX claims inference up to 100B parameters at less than 5 W
items.title_zh: DeepX 声称可在低于 5 瓦功耗下推理最高 1000 亿参数模型
items.summary_en: DeepX claims its technology can run inference on models with up to 100 billion parameters while consuming less than 5 watts. The title does not provide further details about the chip, benchmark, or conditions behind the claim.
items.summary_zh: DeepX 声称其技术能够在低于 5 瓦的功耗下，对最高 1000 亿参数的模型执行推理。现有信息未提供该说法所依据的芯片、基准测试或具体条件。

items.title_en: The Apple Support Community will permanently close on November 20, 2026
items.title_zh: Apple 支持社区将于 2026 年 11 月 20 日永久关闭
items.summary_en: Apple Support Community is scheduled to close permanently on November 20, 2026. The community currently lets users search for answers and ask questions about Apple products.
items.summary_zh: Apple 支持社区计划于 2026 年 11 月 20 日永久关闭。该社区目前允许用户搜索答案并就 Apple 产品提问。

items.title_en: A visual explanation of reinforcement learning
items.title_zh: 强化学习的可视化解释
items.summary_en: The interactive explanation builds a digital being with a simple brain and observes it learning a new behavior. It follows an earlier creature called a spark, which could steer toward light, and shows how small changes to its neural circuitry produced very different behaviors. The presentation uses the creature’s learning process to illustrate reinforcement learning.
items.summary_zh: 这个交互式教程构建了一个拥有简单大脑的数字生物，并观察它学习新行为的过程。它延续了此前名为 spark 的生物：该生物能够朝光源转向，而神经回路的微小变化会产生截然不同的行为。教程通过这种学习过程解释强化学习。

items.title_en: How hard is it to check for whitespace?
items.title_zh: 检查空白字符究竟有多难？
items.summary_en: The piece follows a journey through Unicode whitespace characters and perfect hashing. It begins with the author's discovery of a whitespace-checking method in Guava, Google's popular Java library. The discussion examines the implementation challenges involved in identifying whitespace correctly.
items.summary_zh: 文章围绕 Unicode 空白字符和完美哈希展开探索。作者先讲述自己在 Google 的知名 Java 库 Guava 源码中发现一种空白检查方法的经历。随后文章考察了正确识别空白字符所涉及的实现难题。

items.title_en: I'm Working on a FOSS Linux Pinbal Simulation Engine
items.title_zh: 我正在开发一款 FOSS Linux 弹球模拟引擎
items.summary_en: The developer is adding features, fixing bugs, and improving performance in a Linux pinball simulation engine. The engine is intended to be fully free and open-source software, but it needs more work before an initial release. The developer plans to demonstrate it at the 2026 IAAPA Expo to gauge vendors’ interest in supporting Linux and FOSS.
items.summary_zh: 开发者正在为一款 Linux 弹球模拟引擎增加功能、修复错误并提升性能。该引擎计划完全采用自由开源软件许可，但在首次发布前仍需进一步完善。开发者计划在 2026 年 IAAPA Expo 上展示它，以了解厂商对支持 Linux 和 FOSS 的兴趣。

items.title_en: What objective is reasoning solving?
items.title_zh: 推理究竟在优化什么目标？
items.summary_en: The post questions whether longer chains of thought are themselves what make language models more accurate. During reinforcement learning, models tend to produce longer reasoning chains and improve, but forcing a trained model to continue any one chain eventually stops helping and can even hurt accuracy. This suggests that inference-time reasoning may involve something more subtle than simply increasing chain length.
items.summary_zh: 文章质疑，让思维链变长是否本身就是提高语言模型准确率的原因。在强化学习过程中，模型往往会生成更长的推理链并变得更准确；但对训练完成的模型强行延长某一条思维链，效果最终会停滞，甚至可能降低准确率。这表明，推理时的收益可能并不只是简单增加思维链长度。

items.title_en: Vulcan rocket fails during return-to-flight launch, 40 Amazon satellites lost
items.title_zh: Vulcan 火箭在复飞任务中发射失败，40 颗亚马逊卫星损失
items.summary_en: United Launch Alliance’s Vulcan Centaur rocket suffered an anomaly about 10 minutes into its launch on November 15. The failure resulted in the loss of 40 Amazon internet satellites. The cause of the anomaly remains unclear.
items.summary_zh: 联合发射联盟公司的 Vulcan Centaur 火箭于 11 月 15 日发射约 10 分钟后发生异常。此次故障导致亚马逊的 40 颗互联网卫星损失。目前尚不清楚异常原因。

items.title_en: EU Digital Identity Wallet rollout: every EU state on one board
items.title_zh: 欧盟数字身份钱包部署情况：27 个成员国一览
items.summary_en: A tracker lists the status, launch dates, and builders of EU Digital Identity Wallets across all 27 EU states. It was sourced and updated on October 15, 2026. The tracker cautions that national availability does not by itself establish EUDI certification.
items.summary_zh: 一份追踪表列出了欧盟 27 个成员国数字身份钱包的状态、上线日期和开发方，并于 2026 年 10 月 15 日完成资料更新。追踪表特别提醒，某国已提供钱包并不等同于获得 EUDI 认证。

items.title_en: Pharo in the Browser with WebAssembly
items.title_zh: 通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行 Pharo
items.summary_en: The Pharo Smalltalk environment is running in a web browser through WebAssembly. This brings the Pharo world and its development environment to the browser without requiring a separate native runtime.
items.summary_zh: Pharo 这一 Smalltalk 环境通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行。这样，Pharo 世界及其开发环境无需单独安装本机运行时即可在浏览器中使用。

items.title_en: The Sicilian Citrus Family Tree
items.title_zh: 西西里柑橘家谱
items.summary_en: The piece presents a family tree of citrus fruits from Sicily. No further details about the varieties or their relationships are available here.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容展示了一份西西里柑橘的家谱。现有信息未提供具体品种或它们之间关系的更多细节。

items.title_en: What thousands of conversations look like inside a language model
items.title_zh: 语言模型内部数千段对话的形态
items.summary_en: The author mapped thousands of conversations inside Qwen to examine how language takes shape. Each possible question, misunderstanding, explanation, or unfinished argument produces a sequence of internal states. The project asks whether conversations about similar subjects occupy neighboring regions and whether the same idea in different languages reaches recognizably similar regions.
items.summary_zh: 作者绘制了 Qwen 内部数千段对话的分布，以观察语言如何形成。每个问题、误解、解释或未完成的争论，都会产生一系列内部状态。该项目进一步探讨，主题相近的对话是否会经过相邻区域，以及不同语言表达的同一想法是否会抵达具有相似特征的区域。

items.title_en: Greg Kurtzer's Ginux is now a userspace kernel
items.title_zh: Greg Kurtzer 的 Ginux 现已成为用户态内核
items.summary_en: Ginux is now a configurable userspace kernel for isolated Linux compatibility instances. It runs as an ordinary Linux process and defines an explicit, versioned contract between managed workloads and the host kernel. Its earlier phase as an independent Rust kernel booting through UEFI is complete, with that source preserved separately while active development continues on the userspace version.
items.summary_zh: Ginux 现已成为用于隔离 Linux 兼容实例的可配置用户态内核。它作为普通 Linux 进程运行，并在受管理工作负载与主机内核之间建立明确且有版本控制的契约。此前通过 UEFI 启动、以 Rust 编写的独立内核阶段已经结束，相关源代码被单独保留，当前开发转向用户态版本。

items.title_en: FAA issues nationwide ground stop due to "extraordinary circumstances"
items.title_zh: FAA 因“特殊情况”发布全国地面停飞令
items.summary_en: The FAA issued a nationwide ground stop because of what it described as “extraordinary circumstances.” No further details about the circumstances or the stop’s operational effects are available here.
items.summary_zh: FAA 因其所称的“特殊情况”发布了全国地面停飞令。现有信息未提供相关情况或停飞措施运行影响的更多细节。

items.title_en: Try Gleam
items.title_zh: 试试 Gleam
items.summary_en: Gleam is a functional language targeting the BEAM virtual machine, with simple syntax and interoperability with Erlang and Elixir. It can also compile to JavaScript and run through Node.js. The author compares its syntax and programming experience favorably to Rust while noting that the BEAM ecosystem works differently.
items.summary_zh: Gleam 是一种面向 BEAM 虚拟机的函数式语言，语法简洁，并可与 Erlang 和 Elixir 互操作。它还可以编译为 JavaScript，并通过 Node.js 运行。作者认为，Gleam 的语法和编程体验与 Rust 有不少相似之处，但 BEAM 生态的工作方式有所不同。

items.title_en: In defense of giving a shit
items.title_zh: 为“在乎”辩护
items.summary_en: The author describes judging the Independent Games Festival, where a discussion about the game Big Walk drew far more comments than other entries. This year's rules required developers to disclose any use of AI, and many games consequently reported AI involvement. Big Walk's developers said LLMs were used for less than 0.1% of the code to fix errors late in production.
items.summary_zh: 作者讲述了担任独立游戏节评委的经历，其中围绕游戏《Big Walk》的讨论获得了远多于其他作品的评论。今年的规则要求开发者披露任何 AI 使用情况，因此许多游戏都声明使用过 AI。《Big Walk》的开发者表示，他们在制作后期使用大语言模型修复错误，涉及的代码不到 0.1%。

items.title_en: Let's Write a PostScript Interpreter
items.title_zh: 编写一个 PostScript 解释器
items.summary_en: The tutorial builds an interpreter for an interesting subset of the PostScript programming language. It deliberately ignores or simplifies many features and most error handling, while ensuring that the examples behave the same in the toy implementation and in a standard interpreter such as Ghostscript. The project presents implementing a language as a practical, human-scale programming exercise.
items.summary_zh: 这篇教程将实现 PostScript 编程语言的一个有代表性的子集。教程会忽略或简化许多功能以及大部分错误处理，但确保示例在这个简化实现和 Ghostscript 等标准解释器中的行为一致。项目将编写语言呈现为一项切实可行、适合个人完成的编程练习。

items.title_en: TPUs
items.title_zh: TPU
items.summary_en: Google has expanded its eighth-generation TPU portfolio with two new systems: TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max. TPU 8tx is designed for secure, confidential inference, while TPU 8i Max targets workloads requiring massive context windows. Google says the systems are intended for complex agentic workloads involving security, density, and reasoning.
items.summary_zh: Google 扩充了第八代 TPU 产品线，推出 TPU 8tx 和 TPU 8i Max 两套新系统。TPU 8tx 面向安全、机密推理，TPU 8i Max 则针对需要超大上下文窗口的工作负载。Google 表示，这些系统面向同时涉及安全性、密度和推理能力的复杂智能体工作负载。

items.title_en: Zebkit – Chromium as an embeddable library
items.title_zh: Zebkit——可嵌入的 Chromium 库
items.summary_en: Zebkit packages Chromium’s engine as a cross-platform library for Linux, macOS, and Windows. It includes Blink, V8 with its JIT tiers, PDFium, FFmpeg, and other Chrome components, but omits the Chrome browser and Electron runtime. Applications can use it through C, C++, Rust, Python, Go, or JavaScript bindings.
items.summary_zh: Zebkit 将 Chromium 引擎打包成可运行于 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 的跨平台库。它包含 Blink、带有各级 JIT 的 V8、PDFium、FFmpeg 及其他 Chrome 组件，但不包含 Chrome 浏览器本身或 Electron 运行时。应用可以通过 C、C++、Rust、Python、Go 或 JavaScript 绑定使用它。

items.title_en: A NES emulator written in Odin
items.title_zh: 用 Odin 编写的 NES 模拟器
items.summary_en: The author built a Nintendo Entertainment System emulator in Odin, starting the project in late June 2024 as a part-time effort. Work was paused in January 2025 so the author could focus on other things. The project was enjoyable but became more difficult toward the end while pursuing full emulation accuracy.
items.summary_zh: 作者用 Odin 编写了一个任天堂 NES 模拟器，并于 2024 年 6 月下旬开始利用业余时间开发。项目在 2025 年 1 月暂停，以便作者投入其他事务。整个过程充满乐趣，但在追求完全准确的模拟时，后期变得更加困难。

items.title_en: ExcalidrawZ: Local Native Excalidraw on macOS/iOS
items.title_zh: ExcalidrawZ：macOS/iOS 原生本地版 Excalidraw
items.summary_en: ExcalidrawZ is a macOS and iOS drawing app built with SwiftUI that preserves the familiar Excalidraw canvas. It adds native document management, iCloud sync, history, export, AI assistance, MCP integration, and other Apple-platform features. Drawings are handled as application documents rather than loose browser downloads.
items.summary_zh: ExcalidrawZ 是一款使用 SwiftUI 构建的 macOS 和 iOS 绘图应用，保留了熟悉的 Excalidraw 画布。它增加了原生文件管理、iCloud 同步、历史记录、导出、AI 辅助、MCP 集成及其他 Apple 平台功能。绘图会作为应用文档管理，而不是浏览器中零散下载的文件。

items.title_en: US university students tell surveillance cameras to Flock off
items.title_zh: 美国大学生让监控摄像头“滚蛋”
items.summary_en: Privacy concerns about Flock Safety’s automated license plate readers have sparked protests at schools across the United States. Stanford senior Angela Nguyen helped collect hundreds of signatures demanding that the university end its Flock contract and establish safeguards for similar tools. She argues that cameras recording where vehicles were at specific times could be exploited to target vulnerable people.
items.summary_zh: 对 Flock Safety 自动车牌识别摄像头的隐私担忧，已经在美国各地校园引发抗议。斯坦福大学大四学生 Angela Nguyen 帮助收集了数百个签名，要求学校终止与 Flock 的合同，并为未来使用类似技术制定保障措施。她认为，记录车辆在特定时间所在位置的摄像头可能被利用来针对弱势群体。

items.title_en: AI, activity, and outcomes in software engineering
items.title_zh: AI、活动与软件工程成果
items.summary_en: AI, Activity, and Outcomes in Software Engineering examines the relationship between AI use, engineering activity, and software-development outcomes. The available context contains only a video reference and no further details.
items.summary_zh: 《AI、活动与软件工程成果》讨论 AI 使用、工程活动与软件开发成果之间的关系。现有信息只有一个视频引用，没有提供更多细节。

items.title_en: Show HN: Ghanaian street games you can play in the browser
items.title_zh: Show HN：可以在浏览器中玩的加纳街头游戏
items.summary_en: The project offers 35 playable Ghanaian street games in a browser. The collection includes Four Corners, Laski, One Pole, penalty games, neighbourhood Pilolo, and Pampanaa. It is designed to make these games directly playable online.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目在浏览器中提供 35 款可玩的加纳街头游戏。游戏包括 Four Corners、Laski、One Pole、点球游戏、社区版 Pilolo 和 Pampanaa 等。用户可以直接在线体验这些游戏。

items.title_en: Clice v1.0 Released: Welcome to Modern C++
items.title_zh: Clice 1.0 发布：欢迎来到现代 C++
items.summary_en: Clice has reached its first stable release after surpassing 1,000 commits and undergoing about four months of alpha testing since July 19, 2026. The project’s author reports extensive testing across open-source projects and says its core features are now stable for everyday use. The release follows two and a half years of development.
items.summary_zh: Clice 在提交数超过 1,000 次、并自 2026 年 7 月 19 日起经历约四个月 alpha 测试后，发布了首个稳定版本。项目作者表示，它已在多个开源项目上进行了广泛测试，核心功能现已适合日常使用。此次发布源于两年半的开发工作。

items.title_en: Do House members' stock trades beat the market? A test of 8,900 trades
items.title_zh: 众议员的股票交易能跑赢市场吗？对 8,900 笔交易的测试
items.summary_en: A study tests whether stock trades by members of the U.S. House of Representatives outperform the market, using a dataset of 8,900 trades.
items.summary_zh: 一项研究使用 8,900 笔交易的数据，检验美国众议院议员的股票交易是否能跑赢市场。

items.title_en: A rare glimpse inside the high-risk, high-reward Hormuz trade
items.title_zh: 深入了解高风险、高回报的霍尔木兹贸易
items.summary_en: A witness statement by Mercuria freight trader Renaud Hauspy in the London trial Mercuria v Baltic Exchange sheds light on transporting crude through the Strait of Hormuz. The trade is described as highly secretive, with private transaction terms, unusually media-shy participants, extreme security risks, and potentially enormous financial rewards. The case provides a rare view into how this oil trade operates.
items.summary_zh: Mercuria 货运交易员 Renaud Hauspy 在伦敦审理的 Mercuria 诉 Baltic Exchange 案中提交的证词，揭示了通过霍尔木兹海峡运输原油的情况。这类贸易高度隐秘，交易条款不公开，参与者极少接受媒体采访，同时面临极高的安全风险，却可能带来巨额经济回报。该案件为了解这类石油贸易的运作方式提供了少见的视角。

items.title_en: Billion Watts in the Speaker [video]
items.title_zh: 扬声器中的十亿瓦特 [视频]
items.summary_en: The item is a video titled “Billion Watts in the Speaker.” No further details about its content or the speaker setup are established.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个名为《扬声器中的十亿瓦特》的视频。现有信息未说明视频内容或扬声器设备的更多细节。

items.title_en: PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, 14.25, and 19 RC 2 Released
items.summary_en: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group released updates for PostgreSQL 18, 17, 16, 15, and 14, along with the second release candidate of PostgreSQL 19. The releases fix 52 security vulnerabilities and more than 140 bugs reported in recent months. Some post-update steps may be required, and the project documents them in its updating guidance.
items.summary_zh: PostgreSQL 全球开发组发布了 PostgreSQL 18、17、16、15 和 14 的更新，以及 PostgreSQL 19 的第二个候选版本。这些版本修复了过去数月报告的 52 个安全漏洞和 140 多个错误。更新后可能需要执行额外步骤，项目已在升级指南中说明相关要求。

items.title_en: Show HN: I have trained 15 blood glucose forecasting models on my own data
items.title_zh: Show HN：我用自己的数据训练了 15 个血糖预测模型
items.summary_en: The project is a model zoo for forecasting blood glucose levels, trained and tested on the author’s personal data as well as the public Metabonet dataset. It includes 15 forecasting models, including models developed by the author. Most of the repository’s code was written with AI assistance.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目是一个血糖预测模型集合，使用作者自己的数据和公开的 Metabonet 数据集进行训练与测试。集合中包含 15 个预测模型，其中也有作者自行开发的模型。仓库中的大部分代码由 AI 辅助编写。

items.title_en: The Evolving Story of How Chemistry Became Biology
items.title_zh: 化学如何演变为生物：一个不断发展的故事
items.summary_en: Scientists are revisiting how life may have emerged after decades of disagreement over which molecules came first. Current work focuses on the roughly 200 million years between the appearance of Earth's life-supporting conditions and the earliest known single-celled ancestor. The research is reshaping ideas about what life was, is, and could be.
items.summary_zh: 在围绕究竟是哪类分子最先出现的争论持续数十年后，科学家正在重新思考生命可能如何诞生。当前研究聚焦于地球出现适宜生命的条件之后、最古老单细胞祖先出现之前的大约 2 亿年。相关研究正在改变人们对生命过去、现在及可能形态的理解。

items.title_en: AI is turning Apple's app review process into a nightmare for synth developers
items.title_zh: AI 正让 Apple 的应用审核流程成为合成器开发者的噩梦
items.summary_en: The rapid growth of AI-generated apps is overwhelming Apple’s app review process. Developers are being caught in the resulting review problems, with the report citing two examples. The situation reflects broader pressure on review systems as AI-assisted app production expands.
items.summary_zh: AI 生成应用的快速增长正在给 Apple 的应用审核流程带来压力。开发者受到由此产生的审核问题影响，报道列举了两个例子。随着 AI 辅助应用开发扩大，审核系统面临的压力也在增加。

items.title_en: Semicircle Packing
items.title_zh: 半圆打包
items.summary_en: The author entered a short-story competition called GPU World and planned to publish the entry after the winners were announced. The contest offered a $40,000 first prize and seven $4,000 runner-up prizes, an unusually large pool compared with other competitions the author had entered. The piece is associated with the author's entry, titled “Semicircle Packing.”
items.summary_zh: 作者参加了名为 GPU World 的短篇小说比赛，并计划在公布获奖者后发布参赛作品。比赛一等奖为 4 万美元，另有 7 个 4000 美元的入围奖，奖金池相比作者当年参加的其他比赛高得多。该作品与作者题为《半圆打包》的参赛稿有关。

items.title_en: Ctrl+C, Ctrl+v, Ctrl+cve: Bypassing Android's Clipboard Read Security Measures
items.title_zh: Ctrl+C、Ctrl+V、Ctrl+CVE：绕过 Android 剪贴板读取安全措施
items.summary_en: The post concerns bypassing Android’s security measures that restrict clipboard reads. It focuses on techniques represented by the “Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, Ctrl+CVE” framing.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章关注绕过 Android 限制剪贴板读取的安全措施。内容聚焦于标题所概括的“Ctrl+C、Ctrl+V、Ctrl+CVE”相关技术。

items.title_en: Time for AVIF everywhere?
items.title_zh: 是时候全面采用 AVIF 了吗？
items.summary_en: The piece asks whether AVIF should now be used everywhere. The available information does not provide details about the format's advantages, adoption, or the author's conclusion.
items.summary_zh: 文章提出了是否应当全面采用 AVIF 的问题。现有信息未提供该格式的优势、采用情况或作者结论。

items.title_en: ClickHouse Acquires Xata
items.title_zh: ClickHouse 收购 Xata
items.summary_en: Xata is joining ClickHouse to bring agentic capabilities to ClickHouse Managed Postgres. The combined effort will target a Postgres platform for modern applications and AI agents. It will combine local-NVMe production workloads with Xata's instant provisioning, copy-on-write branching, and scale-to-zero compute technology.
items.summary_zh: Xata 将加入 ClickHouse，为 ClickHouse Managed Postgres 带来智能体能力。双方将共同打造面向现代应用和 AI 智能体的 Postgres 平台。该平台将把本地 NVMe 存储上的高性能生产负载，与 Xata 的即时数据库配置、写时复制分支和缩容至零计算技术结合起来。

items.title_en: Fun things to do with your VM/370 CE machine – Fun with big computers
items.title_zh: VM/370 CE 机器上的趣事：大型计算机的乐趣
items.summary_en: This guide assumes access to a physical or emulated machine running the VM/370 Community Edition operating system. VM/370 CE builds on IBM’s last unrestricted VM/370 release with extensive fixes and improvements. Although it runs on systems limited to one CPU and 16 MB of memory, it includes capabilities that were absent from the original R6 release.
items.summary_zh: 这份指南面向拥有运行 VM/370 Community Edition 操作系统的实体或模拟机器的读者。VM/370 CE 在 IBM 最后一个不受许可证限制的 VM/370 版本基础上加入了大量修复和改进。尽管它只能运行在单 CPU、16MB 内存的系统上，但仍包含原始 R6 版本没有的多项能力。

items.title_en: 500 Lines or Less A 3D Modeller
items.title_zh: 500 行以内：一个 3D 建模器
items.summary_en: This project presents a 3D modeller built in fewer than 500 lines of code. Its author, Erick, is a software developer and a 2D and 3D graphics enthusiast who has worked on games, visual-effects software, and computer-aided design tools.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目展示了一个代码量少于 500 行的 3D 建模器。作者 Erick 是软件开发者和 2D、3D 图形爱好者，曾参与电子游戏、视觉特效软件和计算机辅助设计工具的开发。

items.title_en: Show HN: Godbolt-in-a-floating-window for Neovim (C, C++, Rust)
items.title_zh: Show HN：Neovim 浮动窗口中的 Godbolt（支持 C、C++、Rust）
items.summary_en: AssemblyForNeovim brings a Godbolt-style assembly view into a floating Neovim window for C, C++, and Rust. It generates assembly with a compiler installed locally, so it does not require an internet connection.
items.summary_zh: AssemblyForNeovim 将类似 Godbolt 的汇编查看功能带入 Neovim 浮动窗口，支持 C、C++ 和 Rust。它使用本地安装的编译器生成汇编代码，因此无需互联网连接。

items.title_en: The 42-Year Journey to Bring 'Neuromancer' to the Screen
items.title_zh: 《神经漫游者》登上荧幕的 42 年历程
items.summary_en: William Gibson published the seminal novel Neuromancer in 1984, and it has now made its way to Apple TV after a 42-year journey. The adaptation’s development is being examined through interviews, including one with actor Briana Middleton. The long path from novel to screen reflects the difficulty of bringing the work to a filmed production.
items.summary_zh: William Gibson 于 1984 年出版了经典小说《神经漫游者》，这部作品经过 42 年终于登上 Apple TV。相关制作过程通过包括演员 Briana Middleton 在内的采访得到介绍。从小说到影视作品的漫长历程，体现了将该作品搬上荧幕的复杂过程。

items.title_en: Reverse engineering a vintage diode-transistor logic chip
items.title_zh: 逆向工程一枚老式二极管-晶体管逻辑芯片
items.summary_en: After CuriousMarc found an unidentified integrated circuit, it was opened and examined under a microscope. Reverse engineering showed that the chip implements four NAND gates using diode-transistor logic. The device was identified as the ST680A from Signetics' 600 series, dating to 1965.
items.summary_zh: CuriousMarc 找到一枚无法识别的集成电路后，将其打开并在显微镜下进行检查。逆向工程表明，这枚芯片使用二极管-晶体管逻辑实现了四个 NAND 门。最终确认它是 Signetics 600 系列的 ST680A，生产于 1965 年。

items.title_en: Running web sites makes me not want to
items.title_zh: 运营网站让我不想再运营了
items.summary_en: The writer says that operating self-hosted websites has become discouraging because LLM scrapers generate heavy traffic. After testing anti-scraping tools, the writer observed traffic from numerous cloud-provider IP ranges, including Meta, Azure, and Alibaba, saturating the site’s upload capacity with generated content. The experience led the writer to remove the mitigation tool and reconsider self-hosting.
items.summary_zh: 作者表示，由于大语言模型爬虫制造了大量流量，运营自托管网站变得令人沮丧。在测试反爬工具后，作者观察到来自多个云服务商 IP 段的流量，包括 Meta、Azure 和阿里巴巴，这些流量用生成内容占满了网站的上行带宽。这样的经历促使作者移除缓解工具，并重新考虑是否继续自托管。

items.title_en: Disk encryption on NetBSD – achieving secrecy
items.title_zh: NetBSD 磁盘加密：实现机密性
items.summary_en: The document describes threat models for which disk encryption is an appropriate defense. One explicitly identified case is a device being stolen or lost while its contents must remain secret. The focus is on protecting stored data from disclosure when physical control of the device is lost.
items.summary_zh: 该文档介绍了适合使用磁盘加密进行防护的威胁模型。其中一个明确场景是设备丢失或被盗，但其中的数据仍必须保密。重点是当设备不再由用户实际控制时，防止存储内容泄露。

items.title_en: Life on Claude Nine
items.title_zh: Claude 九号上的生活
items.summary_en: The story begins with a man automating his email. At 3 a.m., Ivan is exhausted and has not eaten since lunch while working at a laptop surrounded by a terminal, a Claude chat, and growing Python scripts. He is building the system because he realized he could, not because anyone asked him to.
items.summary_zh: 故事始于一个人自动化处理电子邮件。凌晨 3 点，Ivan 已经筋疲力尽，从午餐后便没有进食，仍守在笔记本前敲代码，屏幕上是终端、Claude 聊天窗口和不断增加的 Python 脚本。他构建这个系统并不是因为有人要求，而是因为意识到自己可以做到。

items.title_en: WebGL Flight Simulator with seed generated terrain
items.title_zh: 使用种子生成地形的 WebGL 飞行模拟器
items.summary_en: This free browser game lets players take off, explore a procedurally generated world, and land safely. Players can choose a biplane, turboprop, or jet in the hangar. It is built with DAI Studio.
items.summary_zh: 这款免费的浏览器游戏允许玩家起飞、探索程序生成的世界，并安全降落。玩家可以在机库中选择双翼机、涡桨飞机或喷气式飞机。游戏使用 DAI Studio 构建。

items.title_en: North Korean hackers used fake video calls in $400M crypto hack, says FBI
items.title_zh: FBI 称朝鲜黑客利用虚假视频通话实施 4 亿美元加密货币攻击
items.summary_en: U.S. authorities say North Korean state-sponsored hackers stole more than $400 million in cryptocurrency through fake video calls used to steal victims’ identities. The FBI calls the scheme FaceStealer. More than 900 victims are thought to have been targeted during the last 18 months.
items.summary_zh: 美国当局称，朝鲜国家支持的黑客利用虚假视频通话窃取受害者身份，盗走了超过 4 亿美元的加密货币。FBI 将这一骗局称为 FaceStealer。过去 18 个月中，据信已有 900 多名受害者遭到攻击。

items.title_en: LLMs Play Zachtronics' TIS-100
items.title_zh: 大语言模型挑战 Zachtronics 的《TIS-100》
items.summary_en: Sixteen LLMs competed on TIS-100's community leaderboard after receiving the game and its manual but not the existing leaderboard. They found 133 new frontier points across 18 of the game's 55 puzzles, including three outright cycle records. Human players subsequently improved most of the models' programs within days.
items.summary_zh: 16 个大语言模型在获得游戏和说明书、但看不到现有排行榜的情况下，挑战了《TIS-100》社区排行榜。它们在 55 道谜题中的 18 道上创造了 133 个新的前沿成绩，其中包括 3 项绝对周期记录。几天之内，人类玩家又改进了这些模型的大多数程序。

items.title_en: Testing a trash can Faraday cage
items.title_zh: 测试垃圾桶法拉第笼
items.summary_en: The experiment examines whether a trash can can serve as a Faraday cage against electromagnetic pulses. A strong EMP could destroy many electronics, and the author identifies a high-altitude nuclear detonation as the most likely near-term source of such a pulse. The discussion is framed around disaster preparedness for risks including pandemics, infrastructure failures, and EMPs.
items.summary_zh: 这项实验测试垃圾桶能否充当抵御电磁脉冲的法拉第笼。强电磁脉冲可能摧毁大量电子设备，作者认为近期最可能的来源是高空核爆。相关讨论属于灾害准备的一部分，也涉及疫情、基础设施故障和电磁脉冲等风险。

items.title_en: Kiri – The Modern Container Runtime
items.title_zh: Kiri：现代容器运行时
items.summary_en: Kiri is a container runtime and Docker Desktop alternative for macOS, Windows, and Linux, built around a single Rust daemon. It works with the Docker CLI, Compose, and Docker API, and reports a 22 ms `docker run` time on a Mac. The cited comparison gives Docker Desktop 178 ms, Colima 152 ms, and OrbStack 279 ms under the same two-CPU, 8 GB setup.
items.summary_zh: Kiri 是面向 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的容器运行时及 Docker Desktop 替代品，采用单一 Rust 守护进程。它兼容 Docker CLI、Compose 和 Docker API，并称在 Mac 上执行 `docker run` 只需 22 毫秒。在相同的双 CPU、8 GB 配置下，给出的对比数据为 Docker Desktop 178 毫秒、Colima 152 毫秒、OrbStack 279 毫秒。

items.title_en: Apify Security Incident
items.title_zh: Apify 安全事件
items.summary_en: Apify reported a security incident on its status page. The available notice does not provide further details about the incident, affected systems, or resolution.
items.summary_zh: Apify 在状态页面报告了一起安全事件。现有通知未提供事件详情、受影响系统或解决情况。

items.title_en: CERN Built the Large Hadron Collider's Next-Gen Magnets
items.title_zh: CERN 制造大型强子对撞机的下一代磁体
items.summary_en: CERN researchers are developing and testing new niobium-tin (Nb₃Sn) superconducting magnet coils for upgrades to the Large Hadron Collider. The magnets reach 11.3 tesla and use new materials and manufacturing processes. The stronger magnets are intended to let the collider bring more particles into collision.
items.summary_zh: CERN 研究人员正在为大型强子对撞机升级开发并测试新的铌锡（Nb₃Sn）超导磁体线圈。这些磁体达到 11.3 特斯拉，并采用了新材料和制造工艺。更强的磁体旨在让对撞机实现更多粒子的碰撞。

items.title_en: Show HN: DBDelve – Open-Source DB Client Made with Rust and GPUI
items.title_zh: Show HN：DBDelve——使用 Rust 和 GPUI 开发的开源数据库客户端
items.summary_en: DBDelve is an open-source database client written with Rust and GPUI, designed around performance and a lightweight user experience. In a benchmark on the same PostgreSQL table, version 0.3.6 reportedly launched in 1.1 seconds and used 133 MB of idle memory, compared with DBeaver’s 5.2 seconds and 606 MB. The benchmark also reported faster rendering for 1,000-row and one-million-row queries.
items.summary_zh: DBDelve 是一款使用 Rust 和 GPUI 编写的开源数据库客户端，重点是性能和轻量化使用体验。在同一 PostgreSQL 表上的测试中，据称 0.3.6 版本启动耗时 1.1 秒、空闲内存占用 133 MB，而 DBeaver 分别为 5.2 秒和 606 MB。测试还显示，DBDelve 在渲染 1000 行和 100 万行查询结果时更快。

items.title_en: Why Amstrad chose the 3" drives
items.title_zh: Amstrad 为何选择 3 英寸磁盘驱动器
items.summary_en: It focuses on the hardware decision behind that storage format.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨 Amstrad 为其计算机选择 3 英寸磁盘驱动器的原因，重点是这一存储格式背后的硬件决策。

items.title_en: Show HN: Agweb – a browser for agents that stays out of your way
items.title_zh: Show HN：Agweb——不妨碍用户操作的代理浏览器
items.summary_en: Agweb is a macOS browser for coding agents, built on WebKit and designed not to steal keyboard focus. Agents control the single window from the shell through an agweb command modeled on Playwright CLI, while users can watch all tabs live in one view. Idle tabs are suspended; the author reports that five open pages used 0% CPU on a Mac, compared with five to seven busy cores from Chrome’s GPU process.
items.summary_zh: Agweb 是一款面向编码代理的 macOS 浏览器，基于 WebKit 构建，设计目标是不抢占键盘焦点。代理通过类似 Playwright CLI 的 agweb 命令从 shell 控制这个窗口，用户则可以在一个视图中实时查看所有标签页。闲置标签页会被挂起；作者称，在 Mac 上打开五个页面时其 CPU 占用为 0%，而 Chrome 的 GPU 进程会占用五到七个繁忙核心。

items.title_en: Show HN: Aircad – Professional drafting and 3D modeling in the browser
items.title_zh: Show HN：Aircad——浏览器中的专业制图与 3D 建模
items.summary_en: Aircad is a browser-based CAD system with AI integration, professional drafting and documentation tools, and NURBS-based solid modeling. It exposes a scripting API that can perform interface operations and complex modeling tasks, and supports formats including DXF, DWG, STEP, and 3DM. The creator built it to address the cost, performance, collaboration, and extensibility limitations they see in existing CAD tools.
items.summary_zh: Aircad 是一款集成 AI 的浏览器 CAD 系统，提供专业制图与文档工具以及基于 NURBS 的实体建模。它提供脚本 API，可执行界面中的操作和复杂建模任务，并支持 DXF、DWG、STEP 和 3DM 等格式。开发者打造它是为了应对现有 CAD 工具在成本、性能、协作和可扩展性方面的问题。

items.title_en: Drones built to look like birds evaded detection at Air Force tech exercise
items.title_zh: 仿鸟无人机在空军技术演习中躲过探测
items.summary_en: A flapping-wing drone from U.S.-based Ornadyne evaded sensor detection during a recent Air Force technology exercise in the Mojave Desert. The company's small O1 ornithopter uses bird-like wing movements instead of propellers and is designed to resemble birds found in different regions. It is intended for low-altitude intelligence collection and area surveys.
items.summary_zh: 美国 Ornadyne 公司研发的一款扑翼无人机在莫哈韦沙漠举行的一次空军技术演习中躲过了传感器探测。该公司的小型 O1 扑翼机不使用螺旋桨，而是通过类似鸟类的振翅方式飞行，并被设计成类似不同地区常见的鸟类。它面向低空情报收集和区域侦察任务。

items.title_en: A comprehensive study of how fingerprintable users are
items.title_zh: 关于用户指纹可识别程度的全面研究
items.summary_en: A large-scale browser-fingerprinting study analyzed telemetry from nearly 25 million Firefox release users. The work examines how identifiable users are through browser characteristics and reports mitigations developed from the findings. The research was conducted by authors from Mozilla, the University of Toronto, and UC San Diego.
items.summary_zh: 一项大规模浏览器指纹研究分析了近 2,500 万名 Firefox 正式版用户的遥测数据。研究考察了通过浏览器特征识别用户的程度，并报告了据此制定的缓解措施。研究人员来自 Mozilla、多伦多大学和加州大学圣迭戈分校。

items.title_en: Simon Winchester has died
items.title_zh: 西蒙·温切斯特去世
items.summary_en: Simon Winchester has died.
items.summary_zh: 西蒙·温切斯特去世。

items.title_en: Sift: LSP, Lint, Format Lisp, Scheme and Emacs Lisp
items.title_zh: Sift：用于 Lisp、Scheme 和 Emacs Lisp 的 LSP、Lint 与格式化工具
items.summary_en: Sift is an idempotent formatter, rule-based linter, and language server for Scheme, Emacs Lisp, and Common Lisp. It reports malformed Lisp source and rewrites whitespace while preserving comments and read-time forms in their original positions. Formatting an already formatted file produces no further changes, a property asserted across the test suite.
items.summary_zh: Sift 是面向 Scheme、Emacs Lisp 和 Common Lisp 的幂等格式化器、基于规则的 linter 和语言服务器。它会报告格式错误的 Lisp 源码并重写空白，同时保留注释和读取时形式的原始位置。对已经格式化的文件再次格式化不会产生变化，该特性在整个测试套件中都有断言验证。

items.title_en: Dartmouth (Guarini) will not admit math PhD cohort this year
items.title_zh: 达特茅斯大学 Guarini 学院今年不招收数学博士生
items.summary_en: Dartmouth's Guarini School of Graduate and Advanced Studies has suspended admissions to the next mathematics PhD cohort, which would have enrolled in the 2027–2028 academic year. The dean and a college spokesperson did not say when, or whether, admissions would resume. Faculty members raised concerns about the suspension at a November 9 faculty meeting.
items.summary_zh: 达特茅斯大学 Guarini 研究生与高等研究学院暂停招收下一届数学博士生，该届原计划在 2027—2028 学年入学。院长和校方发言人没有说明招生何时或是否会恢复。教职员工在 11 月 9 日的全体教师会议上对这一暂停提出了担忧。

items.title_en: Ukraine knocks out 36% of Russia's oil refining capacity in under two weeks
items.title_zh: 乌克兰在不到两周内击瘫俄罗斯 36% 的炼油产能
items.summary_en: Ukrainian drone strikes hit at least nine major Russian refineries between October 30 and November 11, according to defense manufacturer Fire Point. The affected plants have combined annual processing capacity exceeding 120 million metric tons of crude oil, equivalent to 36% of Russia’s domestic refining capacity. The strikes therefore targeted more than a third of the country’s total refining capacity within 13 days.
items.summary_zh: 据国防制造商 Fire Point，乌克兰无人机在 10 月 30 日至 11 月 11 日期间袭击了至少 9 座俄罗斯大型炼油厂。受影响炼厂的原油年加工能力合计超过 1.2 亿吨，相当于俄罗斯国内炼油产能的 36%。换言之，13 天内遭到打击的产能超过了俄罗斯炼油总能力的三分之一。

items.title_en: Open-Source HF Communications for Remote Communities and Experimenters
items.title_zh: 面向偏远社区和实验者的开源 HF 通信
items.summary_en: In remote communities without reliable cellular or internet service, high-frequency radio can provide long-distance communication. Rhizomatica, a nonprofit focused on expanding access in underserved areas, recognized this potential and developed technology to make HF communications more accessible. The project includes HERMES, a High-frequency Emergency and Rural Multimedia Exchange System used in places such as the Ecuadorian Amazon.
items.summary_zh: 在蜂窝网络和互联网服务不可用或不可靠的偏远社区，高频无线电可以提供远距离通信。致力于扩大弱势地区通信接入的非营利组织 Rhizomatica 认识到这一潜力，并开发技术降低 HF 通信的使用门槛。该项目包括高频紧急与农村多媒体交换系统 HERMES，并已用于厄瓜多尔亚马逊地区等地。

items.title_en: The death knell of digital search
items.title_zh: 数字搜索的丧钟
items.summary_en: The piece argues that search is increasingly being replaced or reshaped by AI answers from systems such as Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT. Examples include Gmail summarizing conversations instead of finding exact addresses, Google Maps guessing destinations, and Google Search placing AI overviews or a full AI mode ahead of traditional links. This shift creates problems for Google’s advertising model, which depends on relevant search results.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，搜索正越来越多地被 Gemini、Claude 和 ChatGPT 等系统生成的 AI 答案取代或重塑。例子包括 Gmail 总结对话而不是查找确切地址、Google 地图猜测目的地，以及 Google 搜索用 AI 概览或完整 AI 模式取代传统链接。这种转变也给依赖相关搜索结果投放广告的 Google 商业模式带来问题。

items.title_en: Fitting Four 32 GB Resizable Bars Behind a PCIe Switch on Linux
items.title_zh: 在 Linux 上让 PCIe 交换机后方容纳四个 32 GB 可调整大小的 BAR
items.summary_en: Linux 7.0 allocated a PCIe switch bridge window that was too small for four 32 GB GPU BARs, preventing assignment. A kernel module that pads the BARs fixes the issue. The system places four AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700s and two RTX 3090s behind a Broadcom PEX88096 switch, allowing peer-to-peer transfers without routing through the CPU.
items.summary_zh: Linux 7.0 为 PCIe 交换机分配的桥接窗口不足以容纳四个 32 GB GPU BAR，导致设备无法分配。一个用于填充 BAR 的内核模块可以修复这一问题。该系统通过 Broadcom PEX88096 交换机连接四张 AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 和两张 RTX 3090，并允许显卡之间绕过 CPU 进行点对点传输。

items.title_en: GitHub Incident with Webhooks, Actions, etc.
items.title_zh: GitHub Webhooks、Actions 等服务发生故障
items.summary_en: GitHub reported an incident affecting multiple products, including Actions, Pages, and Copilot. No further technical details about the incident are available.
items.summary_zh: GitHub 报告了一起影响多个产品的故障，包括 Actions、Pages 和 Copilot。现有信息没有提供更多技术细节。

items.title_en: Sherman Anti-Trust Act (1890)
items.title_zh: 《谢尔曼反托拉斯法》（1890 年）
items.summary_en: The Sherman Anti-Trust Act was approved by the U.S. Congress on July 2, 1890. It was the first federal law to outlaw monopolistic business practices and prohibit trusts. The National Archives preserves the enrolled act and related congressional records.
items.summary_zh: 美国国会于 1890 年 7 月 2 日通过《谢尔曼反托拉斯法》。这是美国第一部禁止垄断性商业行为和托拉斯的联邦法律。美国国家档案馆保存了该法案正本及相关国会记录。

items.title_en: Handwritten 200-year-old dismissal notice found on roof tile
items.title_zh: 屋顶瓦片上发现手写的 200 年前解雇通知
items.summary_en: A message written on a roof slate and found at a salvage yard appears to be a 200-year-old dismissal letter. It tells a worker that he is no longer needed and is signed by Thomas Austin. The message reads: “I do hereby discharge you, John Lewis, from my employment, Thomas Austin.”
items.summary_zh: 一块在旧料场发现的屋顶石板上写着一则手写信息，看起来是一封约 200 年前的解雇通知。通知告知一名工人他不再受雇，并由 Thomas Austin 签署。内容为：“我特此解除你 John Lewis 的雇佣关系。Thomas Austin。”

items.title_en: An Open Field Guide to Inference Engineering
items.title_zh: 开放式推理工程指南
items.summary_en: This field guide introduces inference concepts, production operations, tooling, and career development for platform engineers. It explains how models and GPUs work together and how to run inference in production. The guide also covers tools and paths for developing an inference-engineering career.
items.summary_zh: 这份实践指南面向平台工程师，介绍推理概念、生产运维、工具和职业发展。内容解释模型与 GPU 如何协同工作，以及如何在生产环境运行推理服务。指南还涵盖相关工具和成长为推理工程师的路径。

items.title_en: US test reactor cleared for operations
items.title_zh: 美国测试反应堆获准运行
items.summary_en: The U.S. Department of Energy has cleared Oklo’s Groves Isotope Test Reactor in Texas for unrestricted operations. The reactor reached first criticality in August, less than a year after construction began, and is one of 11 projects selected for the DOE’s Nuclear Reactor Pilot Program. The approval allows Groves-1 to enter its research, testing, and training phase, with operating experience intended to inform Oklo’s planned Groves-2 Forge isotope facility.
items.summary_zh: 美国能源部已批准 Oklo 位于得克萨斯州的 Groves 同位素测试反应堆开展不受限制的运行。该反应堆在开工不到一年后的 8 月实现首次临界，是能源部核反应堆试点计划选中的 11 个项目之一。此次批准允许 Groves-1 进入研究、测试和培训阶段，其运行经验将用于指导 Oklo 计划中的 Groves-2 Forge 同位素设施。

items.title_en: Peer-to-peer WebRTC connections with built-in signaling and discovery
items.title_zh: 支持内置信令与发现机制的点对点 WebRTC 连接
items.summary_en: This project provides peer-to-peer WebRTC connections with built-in signaling and peer discovery. It works across browsers, Node.js, and React Native.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目提供带有内置信令和节点发现功能的点对点 WebRTC 连接。它支持浏览器、Node.js 和 React Native。

items.title_en: Let over Lambda–50 Years of Lisp (2008)
items.title_zh: 《Let over Lambda》：Lisp 五十年（2008）
items.summary_en: Let Over Lambda is a 376-page programming book focused on Common Lisp and advanced macro techniques. It begins with fundamentals before covering macros and other advanced language features. The book presents macros as programs that write programs, enabling abstraction, productivity, code efficiency, and security.
items.summary_zh: 《Let Over Lambda》是一本 376 页、专注于 Common Lisp 和高级宏技术的编程书。全书从基础开始，逐步介绍宏及其他高级语言特性。书中将宏描述为“编写程序的程序”，强调其在抽象、生产力、代码效率和安全性方面的作用。

items.title_en: The Hypertext Transfer Protocol Status Code 483 (I'm Not a Freezer)
items.title_zh: 超文本传输协议状态码 483（我不是冷冻柜）
items.summary_en: The document defines HTTP status code 483, “I'm Not a Freezer.” A server returns it when it understands a request requiring freezing or refrigeration capabilities but cannot provide them. It also distinguishes an actual freezer or refrigerator from a cold server, a frozen software process, and a service advertising “cold storage.”
items.summary_zh: 该文档定义了 HTTP 状态码 483：“我不是冷冻柜”。当服务器理解一个需要冷冻或制冷能力的请求、却无法提供这些能力时，就应返回此状态码。文档还区分了真正的冷冻柜或冰箱、低温运行的服务器、被冻结的软件进程，以及宣传“冷存储”的在线服务。

items.title_en: Show HN: Carton Clock – A working pendulum clock made from empty drink cartons
items.title_zh: Show HN：纸盒时钟——用空饮料盒制作的可运行摆钟
items.summary_en: The creator built a working pendulum clock mainly from empty drink cartons, with skewers, paper straws, string, nuts as weights, and hot glue. It includes a pendulum, escapement, and hour, minute, and second hands, and runs for about an hour. Claude assisted with interactive browser tools for generating gear templates and 3D-printable jigs and tools.
items.summary_zh: 创作者主要用空饮料盒制作了一台可运行的摆钟，另外使用了竹签、纸吸管、细绳、作为配重的螺母和热熔胶。时钟包含摆锤、擒纵机构以及时针、分针和秒针，可运行约一小时。Claude 协助制作了用于生成齿轮模板和可 3D 打印夹具、工具的交互式浏览器工具。

items.title_en: Notes on Mathematics for Engineers (1959) [pdf]
items.title_zh: 工程师数学笔记（1959 年）
items.summary_en: A 1959 PDF contains mathematics notes for engineers.
items.summary_zh: 这份 1959 年的 PDF 包含面向工程师的数学笔记。

items.title_en: Oxford Molecular Motors
items.title_zh: 牛津分子马达
items.summary_en: The bacterial flagellar motor is a rotary molecular engine powered by ions flowing across a bacterium's inner membrane. It drives a helical filament whose rotation propels the cell through water.
