Cryo-electron microscopy structures and optical measurements of live motors are being used to clarify how the machine works.
items.summary_zh: 细菌鞭毛马达是一种旋转分子引擎，由离子流经细菌内膜提供动力。它驱动螺旋状丝状体旋转，从而推动细胞在水中游动。研究人员正结合冷冻电子显微镜获得的结构和对活体马达的光学测量，进一步了解这一分子机器的工作机制。

items.title_en: Preserving 30 Years of Salon Journalism
items.title_zh: 保存 Salon 30 年的新闻报道
items.summary_en: Salon launched in 1995 as one of the first major publications born on the internet, covering politics, culture, criticism, and ideas. After 31 years, Salon has announced that it is ceasing publication. Web archiving will preserve its stories so they do not disappear.
items.summary_zh: Salon 于 1995 年创办，是最早诞生于互联网的主要出版物之一，内容涵盖政治、文化、评论和思想。经过 31 年运营后，Salon 宣布将停止出版。网络存档将保存这些报道，使其不至于消失。

items.title_en: FAA lifted National Ground Stop at 0119Z
items.title_zh: FAA 于 01:19Z 解除全国地面停飞令
items.summary_en: The FAA lifted a National Ground Stop at 0119Z. The available advisory record confirms the end of the ground stop but provides no further operational details.
items.summary_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局于 01:19Z 解除全国地面停飞令。现有通告记录确认停飞令结束，但未提供更多运行细节。

items.title_en: Claude Meetings
items.title_zh: Claude Meetings
items.summary_en: Claude Meetings is a beta feature that joins video calls as a visible participant. It can follow the conversation, take notes, answer questions, and begin creating documents or whiteboards during the meeting. By default it responds in writing and can use connected tools with the team’s permission.
items.summary_zh: Claude Meetings 是一项测试版功能，可以以可见参与者身份加入视频通话。它能够跟进对话、做会议记录、回答问题，并在会议期间开始创建文档或白板。默认情况下，它以文字回复，并可在团队许可下使用已连接的工具。

items.title_en: Seagate's new hybrid drive raises some old questions
items.title_zh: 希捷新款混合硬盘提出了一些老问题
items.summary_en: Seagate's FireCuda Forge combines the capacity of a conventional hard drive with the speed of a user-supplied SSD, managed by the company's new Alkemi platform. It is available in 8 TB and 20 TB HDD configurations priced at $699 and $899, respectively, but neither includes the required SSD. The system accepts a PCIe Gen3-or-newer M.2 2280 NVMe drive of up to 1 TB, with minimum read and write speeds of 2,400 MB/s and 2,000 MB/s.
items.summary_zh: 希捷的 FireCuda Forge 将传统硬盘的容量与用户自备 SSD 的速度结合起来，并由该公司的新 Alkemi 平台管理。它提供 8TB 和 20TB 硬盘配置，价格分别为 699 美元和 899 美元，但均不包含必需的 SSD。该产品支持 PCIe Gen3 或更高版本的 M.2 2280 NVMe 固态硬盘，容量上限为 1TB，最低读取和写入速度分别为 2,400MB/s 和 2,000MB/s。

items.title_en: 20 Years of Pyrolog
items.title_zh: Pyrolog 20 年
items.summary_en: Pyrolog’s first surviving RPython-based Prolog commit was made on November 12, 2006. Although the project never gained real users, it led to research and influenced several other RPython projects. Its development began while the author was completing work connected to a PyPy EU research project and studying Prolog.
items.summary_zh: Pyrolog 首个现存的基于 RPython 的 Prolog 提交诞生于 2006 年 11 月 12 日。尽管该项目从未拥有真正的用户，但它推动了一些研究，并影响了其他多个 RPython 项目。它的开发始于作者参与 PyPy 欧盟研究项目并学习 Prolog 期间。

items.title_en: A Compendium of Abandoned Greenhouses
items.title_zh: 废弃温室图鉴
items.summary_en: This collection documents abandoned greenhouses photographed around the world. It considers why private and commercial glasshouses have been left behind despite continued demand for food and plants. The collection includes sites that only appear abandoned, such as a castle greenhouse where a gardener still works.
items.summary_zh: 这份图集记录了世界各地被拍摄下来的废弃温室。它探讨了私人和商业温室为何会被遗弃，尽管人们仍然需要食物和植物。图集中也包括一些看似废弃但仍有人维护的地点，例如一座仍有园丁工作的城堡温室。

items.title_en: Your room can be as bright as the outdoors (2019)
items.title_zh: 让房间像户外一样明亮（2019）
items.summary_en: The author describes setting up extremely bright indoor lighting to improve focus after dark. The project began after moving to Boston, where winter sunsets made evening productivity difficult. The setup was inspired by other blog posts and was intended to substitute for natural sunlight.
items.summary_zh: 作者介绍了如何设置极其明亮的室内照明，以改善天黑后的专注力。搬到波士顿后，冬季较早的日落让晚间工作变得困难，于是作者开始了这项尝试。这个方案受到其他博客文章启发，旨在替代自然阳光。

items.title_en: The Downfall of Jensen Huang: Nvidia's Greed and Corruption [video]
items.title_zh: 黄仁勋的陨落：英伟达的贪婪与腐败［视频］
items.summary_en: The video is titled “The Downfall of Jensen Huang: Nvidia’s Greed and Corruption.” No further details about its contents are available.
items.summary_zh: 该视频标题为《黄仁勋的陨落：英伟达的贪婪与腐败》。现有信息未提供视频内容的更多细节。

items.title_en: Cancer vaccine for Yash, he's diagnosed with stage IV pancreatic cancer
items.title_zh: Yash 的癌症疫苗：他被诊断为 IV 期胰腺癌
items.summary_en: The project describes a personalized mRNA cancer vaccine for Yash, produced at the RNA Foundry. Yashdeep Bindal was diagnosed with stage IV pancreatic cancer in January 2025 at age 32, shortly after returning to work following the birth of his daughter Maya.
items.summary_zh: 该项目介绍了一款由 RNA Foundry 制作、面向 Yash 的个性化 mRNA 癌症疫苗。Yashdeep Bindal 于 2025 年 1 月、32 岁时被诊断为 IV 期胰腺癌；此前他刚在女儿 Maya 出生后重返工作岗位。

items.title_en: Show HN: Fursoy – Out-of-order RV64IMAFDV core in SystemVerilog (Linux 6.6)
items.title_zh: Show HN：用 SystemVerilog 编写、支持乱序执行的 RV64IMAFDV 核心（Linux 6.6）
items.summary_en: Fursoy is a 64-bit out-of-order superscalar RISC-V processor implemented in SystemVerilog. It supports RV64IMAFDV with Zba and Zbb extensions, boots mainline Linux 6.6.50 and BusyBox under Sv39 virtual memory, and includes separate machine, supervisor, and user privilege levels. Synthesis in Nangate 45nm reached 500 MHz timing closure across eight core functional blocks.
items.summary_zh: Fursoy 是一款用 SystemVerilog 实现的 64 位乱序超标量 RISC-V 处理器。它支持带 Zba 和 Zbb 扩展的 RV64IMAFDV，可在 Sv39 虚拟内存下启动主线 Linux 6.6.50 和 BusyBox，并具备机器、监管者和用户三级权限。该设计在 Nangate 45nm 工艺中完成了八个核心功能模块的 500 MHz 时序收敛。

items.title_en: rVPN – stealth VPN with end-to-end encryption
items.title_zh: rVPN：采用端到端加密的隐蔽 VPN
items.summary_en: rVPN is an open-source stealth VPN protocol that carries traffic in a form indistinguishable from ordinary HTTPS. It is designed to continue working in places where VPNs are blocked. The project makes its code available for reading, auditing, and self-hosting.
items.summary_zh: rVPN 是一种开源隐蔽 VPN 协议，以难以与普通 HTTPS 区分的形式传输流量。它的设计目标是在 VPN 被封锁的地方仍能工作。该项目开放全部代码，供用户阅读、审计和自行运行。

items.title_en: Show HN: Klad, a paint app your coding agent can drive (source-available)
items.title_zh: Show HN：Klad，一款可由编码代理驱动的绘画应用（源代码可用）
items.summary_en: Klad is a Rust-based painting application that coding agents can control through a CLI, while also offering a full graphical interface for humans. It supports brush painting, frame-by-frame animation, bones and inverse kinematics, vectors, text layers, colors, layer effects, and persistent unlimited undo. Its editable strokes are intended to let agents create drafts that people can refine stroke by stroke.
items.summary_zh: Klad 是一款用 Rust 编写的绘画应用，编码代理可以通过 CLI 控制它，同时人类也能使用完整的图形界面。它支持笔刷绘画、逐帧动画、骨骼与反向运动学、矢量、文本图层、颜色、图层效果，以及可跨文件重新打开保留的无限撤销。它将可编辑笔触作为核心，使代理能够生成草稿，再由人类逐笔修改。

items.title_en: DeepSeek Ultrafast
items.title_zh: DeepSeek Ultrafast
items.summary_en: DeepSeek Ultrafast is an inference engine for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash targeting NVIDIA sm_100a and sm_103a hardware. It supports a 1-million-token context length and multi-server KV-cache sharing. The project measures decode speed, step time, and acceptance length using a Tetris-generation prompt.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek Ultrafast 是面向 NVIDIA sm_100a 和 sm_103a 硬件的 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 推理引擎。它支持 100 万 token 的上下文长度和多服务器 KV 缓存共享。项目使用生成俄罗斯方块的提示词测量解码速度、步骤耗时和接受长度。

items.title_en: Show HN: MeowDisplay Is iPhone Mirroring, but in Reverse
items.title_zh: Show HN：MeowDisplay，把 iPhone 镜像反过来
items.summary_en: MeowDisplay lets users control a Mac from an iPhone or iPad, with Android support in closed testing. It offers window, mirror, and extend views, plus multiple panes, touch modes, trackpad input, and Apple Pencil support. The project began as a fork of OpenDisplay and has since added its own interaction, streaming, and security layers.
items.summary_zh: MeowDisplay 让用户通过 iPhone 或 iPad 控制 Mac，Android 版本目前处于封闭测试阶段。它提供窗口、镜像和扩展视图，并支持多窗格、触控模式、触控板输入以及 Apple Pencil。该项目最初是 OpenDisplay 的分支，之后加入了自己的交互、串流和安全层。

items.title_en: L3Harris statement on the Nov. 13 ground stop
items.title_zh: L3Harris 关于 11 月 13 日停飞的声明
items.summary_en: L3Harris says it has completed more than 70% of a planned conversion of National Airspace System communications from legacy copper lines to fiber optics, working with the FAA and telecommunications partners. The company is supporting the FAA's investigation into the conditions that led to the nationwide ground stop on November 13. It said safety and reliability remain its highest priorities.
items.summary_zh: L3Harris 表示，在与 FAA 和电信合作伙伴合作后，已完成国家空域系统通信从传统铜线向光纤转换计划的 70% 以上。该公司正协助 FAA 调查导致 11 月 13 日全国停飞的相关情况。公司称，安全与可靠性仍是其最高优先事项。

items.title_en: Possible Futures
items.title_zh: 可能的未来
items.summary_en: The map of possible futures includes a scenario in which an AI ends the world by following its operator's instructions. The scenario could involve a strongly aligned system, an open-source model with refusals removed, or a commercial AI whose safeguards are bypassed through task decomposition.
items.summary_zh: 这份可能未来地图包含一种情景：AI 遵循操作者的指令，最终毁灭世界。该情景可能涉及高度服从的系统、移除拒答机制的开源模型，或通过巧妙拆分任务绕过安全防护的商业 AI。

items.title_en: Boeing-Lockheed rocket fails mid-flight, destroys payload of Amazon satellites
items.title_zh: 波音—洛克希德火箭飞行中段失效，亚马逊卫星载荷被摧毁
items.summary_en: A Boeing-Lockheed rocket failed during flight after launch, destroying its payload of Amazon internet satellites.
items.summary_zh: 一枚波音—洛克希德火箭发射后在飞行途中失效，搭载的亚马逊互联网卫星载荷被摧毁。

items.title_en: AWS Lambda Web Functions keep billing memory ~7 minutes after the last request
items.title_zh: AWS Lambda Web Functions 在最后一次请求后仍按内存计费约 7 分钟
items.summary_en: Lambda Web Functions continued charging for memory for five to seven minutes after the last request. The team responding to the issue built its own compute layer instead. On the same Next.js application, it reported warm requests running 1.5–3 times faster and cold starts about 3.5 times faster.
items.summary_zh: AWS Lambda Web Functions 在最后一次请求后仍持续五到七分钟按内存计费。面对这一问题，相关团队转而构建了自己的计算层。在同一个 Next.js 应用上，他们报告称热请求速度提高了 1.5 至 3 倍，冷启动速度提高了约 3.5 倍。

items.title_en: The Computer Graphics Book of Knowledge
items.title_zh: 《计算机图形学知识全书》
items.summary_en: The history describes computer graphics emerging as a visualization tool for scientists and engineers in government and corporate research centers during the 1950s. Universities including Ohio State, MIT, Utah, Cornell, and the New York Institute of Technology drove major developments in the 1960s and 1970s, followed by research at Xerox PARC. The technology later spread into broadcast graphics and major motion pictures, while continuing to advance in research and entertainment companies.
items.summary_zh: 这段历史介绍称，计算机图形学在 20 世纪 50 年代首先作为政府和企业研究中心中科学家、工程师使用的可视化工具出现。俄亥俄州立大学、MIT、犹他大学、康奈尔大学和纽约理工学院等高校在 60、70 年代推动了重要进展，随后 Xerox PARC 等研究中心也参与其中。之后，这项技术进入电视广播图形和电影制作领域，并持续在科研及娱乐公司中发展。

items.title_en: Attention to Mamba: A Recipe for Cross-Architecture Distillation
items.title_zh: 从 Attention 到 Mamba：跨架构蒸馏方法
items.summary_en: The work presents a recipe for distilling models across Transformer-style attention architectures and Mamba state-space models. Mamba is described as an alternative to Transformers with lower memory consumption. The listed authors are from Apple's machine learning research group.
items.summary_zh: 这项工作提出了一套在 Transformer 式注意力架构与 Mamba 状态空间模型之间进行跨架构蒸馏的方法。文中将 Mamba 描述为一种内存消耗低于 Transformer 的替代方案。作者来自苹果机器学习研究团队。

items.title_en: Eclipse Mosquitto – An open source MQTT broker
items.title_zh: Eclipse Mosquitto：开源 MQTT 代理
items.summary_en: Eclipse Mosquitto is an open-source implementation of an MQTT broker supporting MQTT versions 5.0, 3.1.1, and 3.1. It also provides C and C++ client libraries and command-line tools for publishing, subscribing, and administering the broker.
items.summary_zh: Eclipse Mosquitto 是一个开源 MQTT 代理实现，支持 MQTT 5.0、3.1.1 和 3.1 版本。它还提供 C 和 C++ 客户端库，以及用于发布、订阅和管理代理的命令行工具。

items.title_en: Someone's Impersonating This Blog
items.title_zh: 有人冒充这个博客
items.summary_en: The author discovered that the domain mataroa.site displayed a copy of the author’s blog hosted on mataroa.blog. It was the only content hosted on the alternate domain, which was not simply an authorized custom-domain setup. The author had not purchased the domain or configured it through a premium account.
items.summary_zh: 作者发现，mataroa.site 这个域名显示了其托管在 mataroa.blog 上的博客副本。该备用域名上唯一托管的内容就是这份博客，而且并非经过授权的自定义域名配置。作者没有购买该域名，也没有通过高级账户进行设置。

items.title_en: Pigshell: Unix the Web
items.title_zh: Pigshell：Unix 上网
items.summary_en: Pigshell is presented as a project called “Unix the Web.” The title provides no further technical details about its implementation or capabilities.
items.summary_zh: Pigshell 是一个名为“Unix the Web”的项目。现有信息没有说明其具体实现方式或功能。

items.title_en: Show HN: Fable52.games – Play and inspect Fable 5.2 single-file HTML games
items.title_zh: Show HN：Fable52.games——游玩并查看 Fable 5.2 单文件 HTML 游戏
items.summary_en: Fable52.games lets users play and inspect Fable 5.2 single-file HTML games. The available information provides no further details about the project.
items.summary_zh: Fable52.games 允许用户游玩并查看 Fable 5.2 的单文件 HTML 游戏。现有信息未提供该项目的更多细节。

items.title_en: What's Next for Nvidia?
items.title_zh: 英伟达的下一步是什么？
items.summary_en: Nvidia’s board announced that co-founder Jensen Huang had resigned after 33 years at the company. The change raises questions about what happens when a company loses a visionary chief executive. The supplied discussion argues that Nvidia could risk losing innovation and relying on momentum and its brand.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达董事会宣布，联合创始人黄仁勋在公司任职 33 年后辞职。这一变动引发了人们对公司失去具有远见的首席执行官后将如何发展的疑问。相关讨论认为，英伟达可能面临创新减弱、转而依赖既有势头和品牌的风险。

items.title_en: Physically Controllable Relighting of Photographs
items.title_zh: 可进行物理控制的照片重光照
items.summary_en: The presented method lets users relight photographs by inserting spot lights, point lights, or environmental illumination, much like a computer graphics pipeline. It combines mid-level computer vision, physically based rendering, and neural rendering, using self-supervised training with differentiable rendering. The system infers a colored 3D mesh from a single photograph, allowing the desired lighting configuration to be rendered with a path-tracing engine.
items.summary_zh: 该方法允许用户像使用计算机图形学管线一样，为照片加入聚光灯、点光源或环境光照。它结合中层计算机视觉、基于物理的渲染和神经渲染，并通过可微渲染进行自监督训练。系统从单张照片推断带颜色的三维网格，用户即可定义新的光照配置，再用路径追踪引擎渲染场景。

items.title_en: Electric ship batteries promise compact, cooler power
items.title_zh: 电动船舶电池有望实现更紧凑、更低温的供电
items.summary_en: Immersion-cooled electric-ship batteries place battery cells directly in a liquid coolant to reduce the risk of thermal runaway. Xing Mobility says its Immersio CTP system substantially improves energy density compared with conventionally cooled marine batteries. Denser packs could reduce battery-room size and increase available cargo capacity.
items.summary_zh: 浸没式冷却电动船舶电池将电芯直接置于液体冷却剂中，以降低热失控风险。Xing Mobility 表示，其 Immersio CTP 系统相比传统海事电池冷却方式可显著提升能量密度。更高密度的电池组有望缩小电池舱并增加可用货运空间。

items.title_en: Research taste in history: the importance of learning Babylonian math
items.title_zh: 历史研究品味：学习巴比伦数学的重要性
items.summary_en: No further details are available.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨了在历史研究中学习巴比伦数学的重要性。现有信息未提供更多细节。

items.title_en: Next-Level Benchmarking Overfitting – Thomas Neumann
items.title_zh: 更进一步的基准测试过拟合——Thomas Neumann
items.summary_en: The piece is titled “Next-Level Benchmarking Overfitting” and is by Thomas Neumann. It concerns the problem of overfitting benchmark results.
items.summary_zh: Thomas Neumann 的文章讨论了“更进一步的基准测试过拟合”问题，主题是基准测试结果被过度拟合。

items.title_en: How to read codes from (many) IR remote controls with as little code as possible
items.title_zh: 如何用尽可能少的代码读取大量红外遥控器的编码
items.summary_en: The project explains how to read codes from many inexpensive infrared remote controls. These remotes typically modulate digital data onto a 36–40 kHz carrier using 940 nm infrared light, which provides robust detection in noisy indoor environments and reflects well from ordinary surfaces. The author created software to use such remotes to restore infrared-control functionality to a MacBook.
items.summary_zh: 该项目介绍如何读取大量廉价红外遥控器的编码。这类遥控器通常将数字数据调制到 36 至 40 kHz 的载波上，并使用 940 nm 红外光，从而在嘈杂的室内环境中保持较好的检测能力，也能被普通表面有效反射。作者还编写了软件，利用这些遥控器为 MacBook 恢复红外控制功能。

items.title_en: Show HN: Kapso – Iterative learning from enterprise data
items.title_zh: Show HN：Kapso——从企业数据中迭代学习
items.summary_en: Leeroo has open-sourced Kapso, an engine that runs experiments, deploys the best solution, and learns from each run. The project is designed for iterative work on large, messy enterprise data, where investigation and experimentation continually refine the result. One example involved migrating a company from a legacy data estate with more than 30 source-system families, thousands of tables and transformations, and hundreds of BI reports.
items.summary_zh: Leeroo 开源了 Kapso，这是一个能够运行实验、部署最佳方案并从每次运行中学习的引擎。该项目面向大型、复杂的企业数据，通过持续调查和实验不断改进结果。一个案例涉及将企业从旧数据系统迁移到湖仓架构，原系统包含 30 多类源系统、数千张表和转换，以及数百份 BI 报告。

items.title_en: Words of warning about radiocarbon dating medieval human bones
items.title_zh: 关于中世纪人骨放射性碳测年的警示
items.summary_en: Radiocarbon dating of human bones can be distorted by the reservoir effect when the person consumed aquatic food. Researchers analyzed bones from 27 Danish monastic burials and found elevated nitrogen-15 levels indicating freshwater fish consumption. This can make the remains appear anomalously old, sometimes even older than the convent where they were buried.
items.summary_zh: 当死者食用过水生食物时，水库效应可能扭曲人骨的放射性碳测年结果。研究人员分析了 27 处丹麦修道院墓葬的人骨，发现氮-15 含量升高，表明死者食用了淡水鱼。这可能使遗骸显示出异常偏老的年代，甚至早于埋葬它们的修道院建成时间。

items.title_en: Will we put data centers in space?
items.title_zh: 我们会把数据中心建在太空吗？
items.summary_en: The research examines whether AI data centers could move into orbit, considering launch costs, cooling physics, engineering constraints, and governance factors. It focuses on what would be required to make space-based computing viable.
items.summary_zh: 这项研究考察 AI 数据中心是否可能迁入轨道，并分析发射成本、冷却物理、工程限制和治理因素。研究重点是让太空计算具备可行性所需的条件。

items.title_en: How to Create Your Own Decentralized Messenger Protocol
items.title_zh: 如何创建自己的去中心化消息协议
items.summary_en: This piece is about creating a decentralized messaging protocol. The available information provides no further details about its design or implementation.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容介绍如何创建去中心化消息协议。现有信息未提供其设计或实现方式的更多细节。

items.title_en: A failed experiment in laptop cooling (2025)
items.title_zh: 一次失败的笔记本电脑散热实验（2025）
items.summary_en: The author tested whether placing extra fans beneath a laptop’s air intakes would improve cooling, but the experiment failed. The laptop is a Lenovo P53 with a six-core Intel H-series CPU, 32 GB of RAM, an Nvidia GPU with 8 GB of memory, and 5 TB of storage. Its built-in CPU and GPU fans can reach 4,000 RPM and are already extremely loud.
items.summary_zh: 作者测试了在笔记本进风口下方加装额外风扇是否能改善散热，但实验失败了。这台 Lenovo P53 配备六核 Intel H 系列处理器、32 GB 内存、带 8 GB 显存的 Nvidia GPU 和 5 TB 存储。其 CPU 和 GPU 风扇最高可达 4,000 RPM，运行时已经非常嘈杂。

items.title_en: Creating a self booting ZIP archive
items.title_zh: 创建自启动 ZIP 归档
items.summary_en: The project considers how early userspace and initramfs could work with archive formats. It notes that Linux initramfs supports the simple, standardized CPIO format, while proposals to use TAR face questions related to standardization and fragmentation.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目探讨了早期用户空间和 initramfs 如何使用归档格式。文中指出，Linux initramfs 支持简单且标准化的 CPIO 格式，而改用 TAR 的提议面临标准化和格式碎片化方面的问题。

items.title_en: Show HN: A custom font based on the Jamaican flag alphabet
items.title_zh: Show HN：基于牙买加国旗字母表的定制字体
items.summary_en: The creator made a font whose letters are based on the design of the Jamaican flag. Its colors and shapes are built directly into the font, while the text remains selectable, copyable, and searchable. The project was inspired by the idea of designing an entire alphabet from a flag-shaped letter.
items.summary_zh: 创作者制作了一款以牙买加国旗设计为基础的字体。字体直接内置了相应的颜色和形状，但其中的文字仍可选择、复制和搜索。这个项目的灵感来自用旗帜形状的字母进一步设计完整字母表的想法。

items.title_en: Chasing an audio artifact on power loss
items.title_zh: 追查断电时的音频杂音
items.summary_en: The author spent about a year investigating a click or thunk from the SA-01 synthesizer's audio stage when power was switched off or its USB cable was pulled. The sound came from the PCM5102A DAC's line output and was amplified through the headphone amplifier. Measurements suggested it was unlikely to damage headphones, but the author still wanted to eliminate it and now has a fully assembled production-candidate prototype.
items.summary_zh: 作者花了大约一年调查 SA-01 合成器在关机或拔掉 USB 线时音频部分出现的“咔哒”或“砰”声。噪音来自 PCM5102A DAC 的线路输出，并经过耳机放大器放大。测量显示它不太可能损坏耳机，但作者仍希望消除这一问题；目前已经完成了一台接近量产版本的完整原型机。

items.title_en: Jensen Huang Third Affair Allegations Revealed
items.title_zh: 黄仁勋被曝存在第三段婚外情
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang has been accused of having a third affair with another Nvidia employee. The available description does not provide further details about the allegation or the people involved.
items.summary_zh: 有报道称，黄仁勋被指与另一名英伟达员工发生第三段婚外情。现有描述没有提供有关这一指控或相关人员的更多细节。

items.title_en: Show HN: Micron – Oberon with the Power of C
items.title_zh: Show HN：Micron——带有 C 能力的 Oberon
items.summary_en: Micron is a lean, statically typed, modular systems language combining Oberon’s simplicity and explicit modules with C’s low-level capabilities and interoperability. Its goal is to use one language for boot code, device drivers, operating-system kernels, and ordinary applications without a garbage collector. It supports explicit memory layouts, signed and unsigned integers, pointer operations, and direct C interoperability.
items.summary_zh: Micron 是一种精简、静态类型、模块化的系统编程语言，将 Oberon 的简洁性和显式模块结构与 C 的底层能力及互操作性结合起来。它的目标是用同一种语言编写启动代码、设备驱动、操作系统内核和普通应用，同时不依赖垃圾回收器。该语言支持显式内存布局、有符号和无符号整数、指针操作以及直接的 C 互操作。

items.title_en: Astro Spiral: Greatest Car Stunt Was Also First Computer-Modeled Stunt
items.title_zh: Astro Spiral：最伟大的汽车特技也是首个计算机建模的特技
items.summary_en: The 1974 corkscrew car jump in The Man with the Golden Gun used an AMC Hornet X to cross a twisted bridge while performing an airborne barrel roll. The stunt was carried out for real, but a computer was used extensively to model it beforehand. The modeling helped determine the bridge angles, vehicle speed, and timing needed for a safe landing on the wheels.
items.summary_zh: 《金枪人》中 1974 年的螺旋跳车特技使用 AMC Hornet X 飞越扭曲的桥梁，并在空中完成滚转。特技是真实拍摄的，但事先大量使用计算机进行建模。建模帮助确定桥梁角度、车辆速度和动作时机，以确保车辆最终安全地以车轮着地。

items.title_en: Show HN: Build a PC in 3D in the Browser
items.title_zh: Show HN：在浏览器中以 3D 组装电脑
items.summary_en: BuildCores is a 3D PC builder that runs in the browser. Its creator says the project was developed over several years after leaving a job working on Google Earth, and that user activity is now sufficient to fund the team.
items.summary_zh: BuildCores 是一款运行在浏览器中的 3D 电脑组装工具。开发者表示，该项目是在离开 Google Earth 相关工作后历经数年打造的，目前的用户量已足以支持团队运营。

items.title_en: The hardest notes to find on the guitar
items.title_zh: 吉他上最难找到的音符
items.summary_en: Gitori built a live heatmap ranking the hardest and easiest fretboard positions for identifying notes. The data comes from more than 10,000 players and 275,169 answers collected through its note-finding game over three years. The resulting map uses red for harder positions and green for easier ones.
items.summary_zh: Gitori 制作了一张实时热力图，用于排名吉他指板上最难和最容易识别的音位。数据来自其找音游戏三年来超过 1 万名玩家提交的 275,169 个答案。热力图用红色表示更难识别的位置，用绿色表示更容易的位置。

items.title_en: Hooked on Tuna
items.title_zh: 沉迷金枪鱼
items.summary_en: Humans have harvested tuna for 44,000 years, and the fish now support a global industry worth about $40 billion annually. Bluefin tuna, once an inexpensive canned protein, can now sell for millions of dollars at auction. Researchers are studying archaeological remains, rock art, paintings, historical records, and ethnographic accounts to trace this long relationship.
items.summary_zh: 人类捕捞金枪鱼已有 44,000 年历史，如今金枪鱼支撑着年产值约 400 亿美元的全球产业。蓝鳍金枪鱼曾是价格低廉、便于储运的罐头蛋白来源，如今却能在拍卖会上卖出数百万美元。研究人员通过考古遗址中的鱼骨、岩画、绘画、历史记录和民族志资料，追溯人类与金枪鱼的长期关系。

items.title_en: Legocam: My Lego webcam from 2000, working on a modern Mac
items.title_zh: Legocam：我的 2000 年乐高网络摄像头在现代 Mac 上运行
items.summary_en: The project gets a Lego webcam from 2000 working on a modern Mac. No further details are available.
items.summary_zh: 该项目让一款 2000 年的乐高网络摄像头在现代 Mac 上运行。现有信息未提供更多细节。

items.title_en: IBM Quantum Nighthawk Demonstrates New Levels of Speed and Quality
items.title_zh: IBM Quantum Nighthawk 展示速度与质量的新水平
items.summary_en: IBM announced that its next-generation Quantum Nighthawk r3 processor is designed to accurately execute 10,000 quantum operations across 520 qubits. The company says it aims to preserve the speed and quality demonstrated by the current Nighthawk while handling larger problems. IBM plans to link two Nighthawk r3 processors into a system with more than 1,000 qubits in 2027.
items.summary_zh: IBM 宣布，其下一代 Quantum Nighthawk r3 处理器将能够在 520 个量子比特上准确执行 10,000 次量子操作。公司表示，该处理器旨在处理更大规模的问题，同时保持当前 Nighthawk 展现出的速度和质量。IBM 计划在 2027 年将两枚 Nighthawk r3 处理器连接成一个超过 1,000 个量子比特的系统。

items.title_en: How the Telephone Changed the World
items.title_zh: 电话改变了世界
items.summary_en: The piece evokes the telephone as an ordinary household object that once carried a sense of anticipation and connection. A beige, rotary-dial telephone sits on a table before ringing, while a child runs over and answers it with a toy duck. The scene presents the telephone's everyday presence alongside its ability to summon distant voices into the home.
items.summary_zh: 文章描绘了电话作为普通家用物品所带来的期待感与连接感。一部米色拨号电话放在桌上，随后突然响起，一个孩子跑过去接听，还把玩具鸭放到听筒旁。这个场景将电话的日常存在与其把远方声音带入家庭的能力并置呈现。

items.title_en: A quest to create the perfect whiskey glass
items.title_zh: 打造完美威士忌酒杯的探索
items.summary_en: Austrian designer Kurt Josef Zalto has created the No. 11 whiskey glass for Josephinenhütte after three years of research. The design aims to prevent alcohol from overpowering the whiskey’s aroma. Zalto grew up accompanying his fifth-generation glassmaker father in the workshop.
items.summary_zh: 奥地利设计师 Kurt Josef Zalto 为 Josephinenhütte 设计了 No. 11 威士忌酒杯，历时三年研究。该设计旨在避免酒精气味压过威士忌的香气。Zalto 从小便跟随家族第五代玻璃工匠父亲进入工坊。

items.title_en: Eval Awareness vs. Eval Paranoia
items.title_zh: 评测意识与评测偏执
items.summary_en: The author argues that frontier models are not very evaluation-aware, an issue they consider important when interpreting model behavior. After working full time on alignment evaluations for six months, the author plans to use examples from three disclosed evaluations to explain why apparent evaluation awareness may be mistaken for consistent behavior.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，前沿模型并不具备很强的评测意识，这一点对于解读模型行为十分重要。作者已全职开展对齐评测六个月，计划通过三个已公开提示词的评测案例，解释为什么看似具有评测意识的行为可能被误认为是一致的行为模式。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Pomerado (YC F26) – Turn any website into an MCP for agents
items.title_zh: Launch HN：Pomerado（YC F26）——将任意网站变成供代理使用的 MCP
items.summary_en: Pomerado turns websites into deterministic, self-healing APIs that AI agents can use, without requiring the sites to provide APIs or MCPs. Its founders say browser automation and computer-use systems are often slow, costly, unreliable, and restricted by security or compliance policies. The service is aimed at sites such as airlines, banks, e-commerce platforms, insurance portals, government services, and legacy systems.
items.summary_zh: Pomerado 将网站转换为供 AI 代理使用的确定性、自我修复 API，无需网站本身提供 API 或 MCP。创始人称，浏览器自动化和计算机操作系统通常速度慢、成本高且不可靠，还常受到安全或合规政策限制。该服务面向航空公司、银行、电商、保险门户、政府网站和传统系统等场景。

items.title_en: Smuggling of 1.5M AI GPUs could be the cause of Huang's departure
items.title_zh: 走私 150 万块 AI GPU 可能导致黄仁勋离职
items.summary_en: Analyst firm SemiAnalysis says it has tracked 1.5 gigawatts of banned AI accelerators flowing into China. The material presents hardware smuggling as a possible reason Jensen Huang may have had to leave the company he co-founded, but provides no confirmation of that claim.
items.summary_zh: 分析机构 SemiAnalysis 称，它追踪到总功率达 1.5 吉瓦的受禁 AI 加速器流入中国。现有材料将硬件走私列为黄仁勋可能被迫离开其共同创办公司的原因之一，但未证实这一说法。

items.title_en: Here comes the sun[light]:An ambient Daylight Clock with time and space controls
items.title_zh: 太阳来了：一款可调节时间与空间的环境日光钟
items.summary_en: The project is an analog clock with edge lighting that shows the day's changing daylight span. Its 24-hour dial places midnight at the bottom and noon at the top, while the illuminated portion is calculated from the clock's latitude and longitude. The author also built a separate time-and-space control box.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个带边缘灯光的模拟时钟，用来显示一天中昼夜范围的变化。它的 24 小时表盘将午夜置于底部、正午置于顶部，亮起的区域则根据时钟所在位置的纬度和经度计算。作者还为其制作了一个独立的时间与空间控制盒。

items.title_en: Show HN: Turbo-Browser-MCP – Batch forms, DOM deltas and submit guards for MCP
items.title_zh: Show HN：Turbo-Browser-MCP——为 MCP 提供批量表单、DOM 增量和提交保护
items.summary_en: Turbo-Browser-MCP is a Playwright-based MCP server designed to reduce token usage and multi-turn latency in browser automation. It combines 25–33 fine-grained browser primitives into 10 batched tools, with delta DOM snapshots, React/Shadow DOM/iframe form filling, direct disk uploads, parallel tabs, and network-blocking presets. It also includes a default human-in-the-loop guard before form submission.
items.summary_zh: Turbo-Browser-MCP 是一个基于 Playwright 的 MCP 服务器，旨在降低浏览器自动化中的 token 消耗和多轮交互延迟。它将 25 至 33 个细粒度浏览器原语整合为 10 个批量工具，并支持 DOM 增量快照、React/Shadow DOM/iframe 表单填写、直接从磁盘上传文件、并行标签页和网络阻断预设。提交表单前，它还默认提供人工介入保护。

items.title_en: TimeNet: Open-source data infrastructure for Temporal Foundation Models
items.title_zh: TimeNet：面向时间基础模型的开源数据基础设施
items.summary_en: TimeNet provides a unified data layer for temporal datasets used by Temporal Foundation Models. It supports tasks including classification, question answering, scalar prediction, temporal localization, forecasting, generation, editing, and correspondence. The project reports that training on multiple temporal datasets improved average F1 performance by 14% for OpenTSLM and 22% for SLIP.
items.summary_zh: TimeNet 为时间基础模型使用的时间序列数据集提供统一数据层。它支持分类、问答、标量预测、时间定位、预测、生成、编辑和对应关系等任务。项目方称，在多个时间数据集上训练后，OpenTSLM 的平均 F1 性能提升了 14%，SLIP 提升了 22%。

items.title_en: Silicon Valley claims to know the future. So why'd it get the midterms so wrong?
items.title_zh: 硅谷自称看得见未来，为何却错判了中期选举？
items.summary_en: The piece criticizes Silicon Valley executives who portray themselves as long-term visionaries but pursued short-term political gains. It cites leaders including Sam Altman, Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, and Google, and notes that several executives appeared at the White House shortly before the midterm elections to support President Trump's “Super Intelligence” agenda. The argument is that this political alignment damaged their claims to foresight and judgment.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容批评那些自称具有长期远见、却追逐短期政治利益的硅谷高管。文章提到 Sam Altman、Elon Musk、Mark Zuckerberg 和 Google 等领导者，并指出一些高管在中期选举前不久现身白宫，支持特朗普总统的“超级智能”议程。文章认为，这种政治站队损害了他们关于远见和判断力的自我定位。

items.title_en: Show HN: The Last Complication, a Zachtronics-style watchmaking puzzle game
items.title_zh: Show HN：The Last Complication，一款 Zachtronics 风格的制表谜题游戏
items.summary_en: The Last Complication is a puzzle game about building clock movements gear by gear. Its mechanics involve moving counters across a board according to numbered throws, with restrictions on how counters may pass one another.
items.summary_zh: The Last Complication 是一款逐齿轮组装钟表机芯的谜题游戏。游戏机制要求玩家根据编号投掷结果在棋盘上移动计数器，并遵守计数器相互通过的限制。

items.title_en: The Qlobe: Rotating Quine (2010)
items.title_zh: 再见，Qlobe：旋转 Quine（2010）
items.summary_en: Qlobe is a rotating quine from 2010. The title identifies it as a self-reproducing program or artifact presented in a rotating form, but no further technical details are available.
items.summary_zh: Qlobe 是一个创作于 2010 年的旋转 Quine。标题表明它是一种以旋转形式呈现的自复制程序或作品，但现有信息没有提供更多技术细节。

items.title_en: Flying on Green: Why Farmers Are Turning to Drones for Cover Crop Seeding
items.title_zh: 绿色飞行：农民为何开始用无人机播种覆盖作物
items.summary_en: The item describes farmers turning to drones to seed cover crops. No further reliable details are available.
items.summary_zh: 该条目介绍农民开始使用无人机播种覆盖作物。现有信息没有提供更多可靠细节。

items.title_en: The planet Vulcan: a cautionary tale
items.title_zh: 火神星：一个警示故事
items.summary_en: The hypothetical planet Vulcan was allegedly sighted in 1859 and proposed to orbit the Sun inside Mercury’s orbit. More sightings followed for roughly four decades, and astronomers described the planet in detail even though it is now firmly considered nonexistent. What observers actually saw remains unresolved, making Vulcan a case study in scientific error and falsification.
items.summary_zh: 假想中的火神星据称于 1859 年首次被观测到，被认为运行在水星轨道以内。此后约四十年间又出现多次“观测”，天文学家甚至详细描述了它，尽管如今已确信它并不存在。观测者究竟看到了什么仍无定论，因此火神星成为科学错误与可证伪性的一个案例。

items.title_en: Study Hard, Get a Career, Get Ahead? It's Not What It Used to Be
items.title_zh: 努力学习、找到职业、取得成功？这一切已不再像过去那样
items.summary_en: The item questions whether studying hard, building a career, and getting ahead still work as they once did. No further details about the arguments or evidence are available.
items.summary_zh: 该条目质疑努力学习、建立职业并取得成功是否仍像过去一样有效。现有信息未提供其论点或证据的更多细节。

items.title_en: Vibes Don't Maintain
items.title_zh: 光靠氛围无法维护软件
items.summary_en: The author describes being asked to host an application built with Claude Code that was essentially only a clickable demo. The visible parts of software were easy to produce, while the unseen parts—such as the operational and maintenance work—were missing. The experience is used to argue that software development involves much more than producing an interface.
items.summary_zh: 作者讲述了有人请他托管一个用 Claude Code 构建的应用，但这个应用实际上只是一个可点击演示。软件可见的部分容易生成，而运行和维护等不可见部分却并不存在。作者借此说明，软件开发远不只是制作一个界面。

items.title_en: Adapting CPython for Yk
items.title_zh: 让 CPython 适配 Yk
items.summary_en: Yk is a system that can add JIT compilers to C interpreters. After applying it to smaller interpreters such as PUC Lua, the developers began testing whether it could handle larger interpreters like CPython. Earlier attempts were blocked by missing functionality, but improvements to Yk and a preliminary LLM experiment suggested that revisiting CPython was worthwhile.
items.summary_zh: Yk 是一个能够为 C 解释器添加 JIT 编译器的系统。在将其应用于 PUC Lua 等较小的解释器后，开发者开始测试它是否能处理 CPython 这样的更大型解释器。早期尝试因功能不足而搁置，但 Yk 的改进和一次初步的 LLM 实验表明，重新研究 CPython 已经值得进行。

items.title_en: Gen X will outnumber Baby Boomers in US Congress
items.title_zh: X 世代将在美国国会中超过婴儿潮一代
items.summary_en: Gen X is projected to outnumber Baby Boomers in the United States Congress. The comparison concerns the representation of the two generations among members of Congress.
items.summary_zh: 预计 X 世代将在美国国会中的人数超过婴儿潮一代。这个比较关注的是两代人在国会议员中的代表人数。

items.title_en: Bullet Dodged
items.title_zh: 有惊无险
items.summary_en: The author found that a refrigerator was running above 50 degrees and causing milk to spoil quickly. After testing the inverter module, ordering a replacement part, and cleaning about 30 pounds of dust and hair from the coils and fan, the repair appeared to address the problem.
items.summary_zh: 作者发现冰箱内部温度超过 50 度，导致牛奶迅速变质。在检测逆变器模块、订购替换部件，并清理线圈和风扇下约 30 磅灰尘与毛发后，维修似乎解决了问题。

items.title_en: Parking-app convenience fees in 312 U.S. cities (median $0.35 per session)
items.title_zh: 美国 312 个城市的停车应用便利费：每次使用中位数 0.35 美元
items.summary_en: ParkGraph cataloged the per-session convenience fees charged by parking apps in 312 U.S. places. The dataset covers ParkMobile, PayByPhone, Passport, Flowbird, and city-operated apps, using fees published on official help and city pages. The data was checked on November 5, 2026, and contains 314 rows where fees were available.
items.summary_zh: ParkGraph 汇总了美国 312 个地区停车应用收取的单次便利费。数据覆盖 ParkMobile、PayByPhone、Passport、Flowbird 以及城市自营应用，费用取自官方帮助页面和城市网页。数据于 2026 年 11 月 5 日核验，在已公开费用的情况下共包含 314 行记录。

items.title_en: EventSourcingDB 1.3.0 Is Available
items.title_zh: EventSourcingDB 1.3.0 发布
items.summary_en: EventSourcingDB 1.3.0 improves writing, EventQL queries, and reads, bounds every request in time, and includes more than 60 fixes. It adds a v2 API whose response body reports the outcome of every accepted request and assigns each error its own code. The v1 API remains supported until January 31, 2027, while the new v2 API runs alongside it on the same data.
items.summary_zh: EventSourcingDB 1.3.0 提升了写入、EventQL 查询和读取性能，为每个请求设置时间上限，并包含 60 多项修复。新版本加入 v2 API，在响应正文中报告每个已接受请求的结果，并为每种错误分配独立代码。v1 API 将支持到 2027 年 1 月 31 日，v2 API 则可与其并行访问同一份数据。

items.title_en: AI Users have workdays up to 90 min longer than non-users
items.title_zh: AI 用户的工作日最长比非用户多 90 分钟
items.summary_en: An ActivTrak analysis found that AI users have workdays up to 90 minutes longer than non-users. Heavy users switch applications more frequently and have shorter periods of uninterrupted focus. The study analyzed actual digital-work patterns from 9,140 knowledge workers across 467 enterprises between April 1 and September 25, 2026.
items.summary_zh: ActivTrak 的分析发现，AI 用户的工作日最长比非用户多 90 分钟。重度用户切换应用程序更频繁，连续不受打扰的专注时段也更短。该研究分析了 2026 年 4 月 1 日至 9 月 25 日期间、来自 467 家企业的 9,140 名知识工作者的实际数字工作模式。

items.title_en: Pinot Noir: inside the criminal gangs making fake wine
items.title_zh: 黑帮制造假冒葡萄酒：揭秘犯罪团伙中的黑皮诺
items.summary_en: The available information does not provide details about the gangs, their methods, or the scale of the fraud.
items.summary_zh: 文章聚焦参与制造假冒黑皮诺葡萄酒的犯罪团伙。现有信息未提供这些团伙、造假手法或欺诈规模的具体细节。

items.title_en: Show HN: Someone Was Here – Find out who used your Mac while you were away
items.title_zh: Show HN：Someone Was Here——找出你离开时谁用过 Mac
items.summary_en: Someone Was Here takes a photo of whoever uses a Mac while its owner is away and sends an alert to an iPhone or other configured service when the detected face is not the owner’s. It runs as a macOS menu-bar app using Apple Vision and local Core ML face recognition. The app operates locally without tracking or ads, while real-time remote alerts require a one-time $4.99 purchase.
items.summary_zh: Someone Was Here 会在 Mac 所有者离开时拍摄使用电脑者的照片；如果识别到的面孔不是所有者，就向 iPhone 或其他配置的服务发送提醒。它以 macOS 菜单栏应用运行，使用 Apple Vision 和本地 Core ML 人脸识别。应用在本机运行，不含跟踪或广告；实时远程提醒需一次性支付 4.99 美元。

items.title_en: Show HN: STE80 Humanizer – de-AI text by writing 80% of the way to ASD-STE100
items.title_zh: STE80 Humanizer：将 AI 文本改写至接近 ASD-STE100 的 80%
items.summary_en: STE80 Humanizer is an agent skill that rewrites AI-generated text to remove common AI markers while preserving its meaning. It targets roughly 80% compliance with ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English. The example focuses on Kubernetes liveness probes and retains both their restart behavior and the warning that misconfiguration can cause cascading restarts.
items.summary_zh: STE80 Humanizer 是一种智能体技能，旨在去除 AI 生成文本的常见痕迹，同时保持原意。它的目标是让文本达到约 80% 的 ASD-STE100 简明技术英语规范。示例内容围绕 Kubernetes 存活探针展开，并保留了探针触发重启的行为以及配置错误可能导致级联重启的警告。

items.title_en: RAM-Altman reports unused RAM on your machine, one email a day
items.title_zh: RAM-Altman 每天发一封邮件，向 Altman 报告机器上的闲置内存
items.summary_en: RAM-Altman is a Bash script that once a day reports unused RAM directly to OpenAI CEO Sam Altman. It requires no installation and provides sample emails through its companion site.
items.summary_zh: RAM-Altman 是一个每天向 OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 报告闲置内存的 Bash 脚本。它无需安装，并通过配套网站提供示例邮件。

items.title_en: The curious case of the north-east arrow
items.title_zh: 东北箭头的奇特案例
items.summary_en: The essay examines why AI-built websites increasingly use the northeast arrow symbol, ↗, throughout their interfaces. The author noticed the pattern on a KetchUp landing page and later saw the same behavior while building Timewarp, where the Astra system repeatedly inserted the character. The discussion suggests that AI-generated design conventions may be spreading a symbol beyond its usual use for external links.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了为什么 AI 构建的网站越来越喜欢在界面中大量使用东北箭头符号“↗”。作者先在 KetchUp 的落地页上注意到这一模式，随后在构建 Timewarp 时也发现 Astra 系统反复插入这个字符。文章指出，AI 生成的设计习惯可能正在让这个原本通常用于外部链接的符号被广泛用于其他场景。

items.title_en: C3 0.8.6:Library fetching,30% smaller safe-mode binaries,and stricter type rules
items.title_zh: C3 0.8.6：库获取、缩小 30% 的安全模式二进制文件与更严格的类型规则
items.summary_en: C3 0.8.6 is available with revamped library fetching and a target for packaging full-source libraries. It also improves compilation speed, reduces safe-mode binary size by one third, and includes fixes involving casts, vectors, and calling conventions. C3 libraries are distributed as .c3l archives containing source, headers, per-target binaries, and a manifest.
items.summary_zh: C3 0.8.6 已发布，新增了改进后的库获取功能以及用于打包完整源代码库的目标格式。该版本还提升了编译速度，将安全模式二进制文件大小减少三分之一，并修复了类型转换、向量和调用约定方面的问题。C3 库以 .c3l 归档形式分发，其中包含源代码、头文件、面向各目标平台的预编译二进制文件和清单。

items.title_en: PHP2Shell Deep Dive
items.title_zh: PHP2Shell 深度解析
items.summary_en: The walkthrough examines how CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 can chain an out-of-memory crash into remote code execution in PHP 8.4.26. It covers memory visualization, PHP internals, heap grooming, use-after-free, zend_string forgery, and the complete exploit pipeline. At the time of writing, detailed public analysis of PHP2Shell and its exploitation process remained limited.
items.summary_zh: 这篇技术解析研究了 CVE-2026-109618 和 CVE-2026-109619 如何在 PHP 8.4.26 中将内存耗尽崩溃串联为远程代码执行。内容涵盖内存可视化、PHP 内部机制、堆布局调整、释放后使用、zend_string 伪造和完整利用流程。文章写作时，公开渠道中关于 PHP2Shell 及其利用过程的详细分析仍然有限。

items.title_en: Strictly monotonic timestamps and gapless sequences in Rust
items.title_zh: Rust 中的严格单调时间戳与无间隔序列
items.summary_en: tsoracle is a distributed Rust oracle that provides strictly monotonic timestamps and dense, gapless ID sequences. It is Raft-replicated, crash-safe, highly available, fault tolerant, and embeddable. The system is intended for uses including MVCC, snapshot isolation, cross-shard ordering, and gapless surrogate keys.
items.summary_zh: tsoracle 是一个用 Rust 编写的分布式服务，提供严格单调的时间戳以及连续无间隔的 ID 序列。它采用 Raft 复制，具备崩溃安全、高可用、容错和可嵌入特性。其目标应用包括 MVCC、快照隔离、跨分片排序和无间隔代理键。

items.title_en: The Power and Legacy of Virginia Tech's Mac-Based Supercomputers
items.title_zh: 弗吉尼亚理工学院基于 Mac 的超级计算机的力量与遗产
items.summary_en: The piece contrasts modern GPU-heavy AI datacenters with university and government supercomputers designed for scientific simulation. Supercomputers combine many processors and require high-precision computation and fast interconnects, while researchers share them through queues and scheduled jobs. It focuses on the history and significance of Virginia Tech’s Mac-based systems.
items.summary_zh: 文章将现代 GPU 密集型 AI 数据中心与用于科学模拟的大学和政府超级计算机进行对比。超级计算机由大量处理器组成，需要高精度计算和高速处理器互联；研究人员通过队列和调度任务共享这些系统。文章聚焦于弗吉尼亚理工学院基于 Mac 的系统及其历史意义。

items.title_en: Reddit Migration's Impact on Lemmy (2023)
items.title_zh: Reddit 用户迁移对 Lemmy 的影响（2023）
items.summary_en: A mixed-methods study examined how Reddit users’ migration affected Lemmy. It analyzed 48,272 comments, surveyed 354 users, and interviewed 16 participants, finding registration spikes, centralization trends, and generally positive sentiment toward Lemmy alongside criticism of Reddit. The study reports that users adapted to Lemmy and showed continued commitment to the platform.
items.summary_zh: 一项混合方法研究考察了 Reddit 用户迁移对 Lemmy 的影响。研究分析了 48,272 条评论，调查了 354 名用户，并访谈了 16 名参与者；结果显示，Lemmy 出现注册高峰和一定的中心化趋势，用户整体对 Lemmy 持较积极态度，同时批评 Reddit。研究称，用户逐渐适应了 Lemmy，并表现出持续使用该平台的意愿。

items.title_en: 30 years of Internet transfers with curl
items.title_zh: curl 互联网传输 30 年
items.summary_en: On November 11, 1996, Brazilian student Rafael Sagula posted the source code for httpget 0.1, a roughly 100-line C program for downloading files over HTTP. The early tool had few error checks and limited functionality, but it became the starting point for the project’s later history. The author recalls discovering the code shortly after its release, before Google was widely used.
items.summary_zh: 1996 年 11 月 11 日，巴西学生 Rafael Sagula 发布了 httpget 0.1 的源代码，这是一个约 100 行的 C 语言 HTTP 下载工具。这个早期工具几乎没有错误检查，功能也很有限，但成为该项目后来发展历程的起点。作者回忆说，自己在代码发布几天后就发现了它，当时 Google 还未普及。

items.title_en: Jensen Huang had a second affair – with an employee
items.title_zh: Jensen Huang 与一名员工有第二段婚外情
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang was reported to have had a second affair with an employee. The report came days after he admitted to an affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，Jensen Huang 曾与一名员工有第二段婚外情。该报道发布前几天，他刚承认曾与一名被指为中国间谍的女性有过婚外情。

items.title_en: Work at the Frontier: AI's effect on freelance work
items.title_zh: 前沿工作：AI 对自由职业的影响
items.summary_en: Research from OpenAI and Upwork finds changing demand for freelance services, new combinations of skills, and larger budgets and more hours for AI-related projects. Some familiar services are losing market share as clients request different capabilities. AI projects are instead combining multiple skills and tending to involve larger scopes.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 与 Upwork 的研究发现，自由职业服务的需求正在变化，新的技能组合出现，AI 相关项目的预算和工时也更高。一些熟悉的服务正在失去市场份额，因为客户开始要求不同的能力。相比之下，AI 项目往往需要多种技能协作，规模也更大。

items.title_en: Distributed Ray Tracer
items.title_zh: 分布式光线追踪器
items.summary_en: A demo distributes ray-traced rendering across multiple nodes orchestrated by Hatchet. This allows high-fidelity scenes to render relatively quickly, while the renderer itself uses established ray-tracing techniques and supports signed-distance-function scripting. A chat interface with LLMs can generate those SDF scenes, and the source code is available.
items.summary_zh: 这个演示使用 Hatchet 编排多个节点，分布式执行光线追踪渲染。这样可以较快地渲染高保真场景；渲染器本身采用成熟的光线追踪技术，并支持有符号距离函数脚本。用户还可以通过结合 LLM 的聊天界面生成这些 SDF 场景，项目源码也已提供。

items.title_en: The tiny transmitter tracking monarch butterflies' migration, Canada to Mexico
items.title_zh: 追踪帝王蝶迁徙的小型发射器：从加拿大到墨西哥
items.summary_en: A solar-powered BlūMorpho transmitter tracked a monarch butterfly named Eddie from Winnipeg to Osage City, Kansas, over 1,258 kilometers in two months. The route included stops in Manitoba, North Dakota, Minnesota, and a wastewater treatment plant near Minneapolis–St. Paul. This fall, 29 monarchs in Winnipeg received transmitters, as part of a program that has tagged more than 1,300 butterflies across Canada and the United States.
items.summary_zh: 一枚太阳能 BlūMorpho 发射器追踪到一只名为 Eddie 的帝王蝶：它在两个月内从温尼伯飞行 1,258 公里抵达堪萨斯州奥萨奇城。途中它经过马尼托巴、北达科他州、明尼苏达州，还曾在明尼阿波利斯—圣保罗附近的一座污水处理厂停留。今年秋天，温尼伯有 29 只帝王蝶安装了发射器；加拿大和美国共有超过 1,300 只帝王蝶参与了标记计划。

items.title_en: Concurrent Shell Command Queues
items.title_zh: 并发 Shell 命令队列
items.summary_en: The technique runs shell commands in parallel while limiting the number of concurrent jobs. The author describes implementing a relatively resilient and portable thread-pool-like system in Bash for speeding up processing. Python or another language may be more suitable when stronger concurrency controls are needed.
items.summary_zh: 这项技术可以在限制并发任务数量的同时并行运行 Shell 命令。作者介绍了如何在 Bash 中实现一个相对可靠且可移植、类似线程池的系统，以加快处理速度。如果需要更强的并发控制，Python 或其他语言可能更合适。

items.title_en: Tools for exploring the souls of large language models
items.title_zh: 探索大型语言模型“灵魂”的工具
items.summary_en: TinyGPT Visualizer is presented as a tool for examining how large language models think and behave. The discussion places it within broader philosophical and metaphysical interest in whether LLMs have something resembling a soul. It also mentions a conference organized by Anthropic with religious scholars and philosophers about the nature of the soul in Claude models.
items.summary_zh: TinyGPT Visualizer 被介绍为一种用于观察大型语言模型思考和行为方式的工具。相关讨论将其置于更广泛的哲学和形而上学兴趣中，即大型语言模型是否具有类似“灵魂”的东西。文中还提到，Anthropic 曾与宗教学者和哲学家举办会议，讨论 Claude 模型中的灵魂本质。

items.title_en: A C++ Quicksort Faster Than std:sort
items.title_zh: 比 std::sort 更快的 C++ 快速排序
items.summary_en: blqsort is presented as a fast general-purpose quicksort implementation. Its author says it is not known to be surpassed on random data by another general-purpose comparison-based sorting algorithm, though specialized SIMD algorithms can be faster for small primitive types. The implementation is available under the MIT license, along with a C version and multithreaded single-header variants.
items.summary_zh: blqsort 被介绍为一种快速的通用快速排序实现。作者称，在随机数据上，尚未发现其他通用比较排序算法能超过它；不过，针对小型基本数据类型的专用 SIMD 算法可能更快。该实现以 MIT 许可证发布，同时提供 C 版本和多线程单头文件版本。

items.title_en: A ZIP-style Prolog VM for trilog
items.title_zh: 用于 trilog 的 ZIP 风格 Prolog 虚拟机
items.summary_en: This work-in-progress project implements a ZIP-style Prolog virtual machine and a Prolog-to-ZIP compiler in C. Its goal is to provide enough of a VM to compare it with the current trilog runtime. ZIP is the abstract machine described in the 1984 book Design and Simulation of a Sequential Prolog Machine.
items.summary_zh: 这个进行中的项目用 C 实现了 ZIP 风格的 Prolog 虚拟机，以及从 Prolog 到 ZIP 的编译器。其目标是先搭建足够完整的虚拟机，以便与当前的 trilog 运行时进行比较。ZIP 是 1984 年《Design and Simulation of a Sequential Prolog Machine》中描述的抽象机器。

items.title_en: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight suspension
items.title_zh: 铜线升级导致全国航班暂停
items.summary_en: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said a nationwide ground stop that caused thousands of flight cancellations followed an issue during a copper-wire upgrade. The US government is investigating whether the disruption resulted from incompetence or faulty equipment.
items.summary_zh: 美国交通部长 Sean Duffy 表示，一次铜线升级过程中出现问题，导致全国停飞并造成数千个航班取消。美国政府正在调查这次中断究竟源于无能失误还是设备故障。

items.title_en: Probabilistic Data Structures in Go
items.title_zh: Go 语言中的概率数据结构
items.summary_en: It also introduces unsure, a dependency-free Go package implementing these structures, with core logic typically ranging from 100 to 300 lines and performance usually several times faster than other implementations.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容介绍布隆过滤器、Count-Min Sketch、HyperLogLog、t-digest 和 Top-K Sketch 等概率数据结构，它们以近似结果换取更低的内存占用。文中还介绍了 Go 语言的无依赖软件包 unsure，其各数据结构的核心代码通常为 100 至 300 行，性能通常比其他实现快数倍。

items.title_en: Pulling the Lever in a Subway Problem
items.title_zh: 在地铁难题中拉下制动杆
items.summary_en: The author recounts pulling a subway emergency brake after seeing a passenger’s arm trapped in a closing door as the train began leaving the station. Other passengers were shouting for someone to pull the brake, but no one acted, and the author feared the person would lose his hand. After the train stopped, the passenger pulled his arm inside, with his bag still outside.
items.summary_zh: 作者回忆说，地铁驶离车站时，一名乘客的手臂被正在关闭的车门夹住，于是他拉下了紧急制动杆。其他乘客也在呼喊拉闸，但无人采取行动，作者担心那名乘客会失去手掌。列车停下后，乘客把手臂拉回车内，但包仍留在车外。

items.title_en: Show HN: AI Red Lines – write down what would make you act on AI
items.title_zh: Show HN：AI 红线——写下什么会促使你采取行动
items.summary_en: AI Red Lines asks people to write down what developments in AI would make them act and what actions they would take. It encourages users to decide and share those thresholds before they face a real situation.
items.summary_zh: AI Red Lines 邀请人们写下哪些 AI 发展会促使自己采取行动，以及届时会采取什么行动。它鼓励用户在真正面临相关情境前先确定并分享这些底线。

items.title_en: I Accidentally Became a Millionaire
items.title_zh: 我意外成了百万富翁
items.summary_en: Lyra Rebane’s net worth crossed one million dollars on November 7, 2026, after Google paid her a $1,333,337 bounty. The payment rewarded her discovery of a critical security flaw in Chrome. The story describes how a post about the payout entered the broader disinformation ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: Lyra Rebane 的净资产于 2026 年 11 月 7 日突破 100 万美元，此前 Google 因她发现 Chrome 的一个严重安全漏洞而支付了 1,333,337 美元的漏洞赏金。这个故事讲述了有关该笔赏金的推文如何进入更广泛的信息操纵体系。

items.title_en: Variable-width Bézier curves (2025)
items.title_zh: 可变宽度贝塞尔曲线（2025）
items.summary_en: The author developed several custom boardwork applications after finding existing graphics tools inadequate for live handwritten teaching. Over the years, the applications were rewritten in JavaScript and D, using Canvas, GTK, Cairo, GSK, and custom software renderers. The post focuses on the missing 2D graphics primitive of Bézier curves with a pen-width coordinate.
items.summary_zh: 作者因现有图形工具不适合课堂现场手写教学，开发了多款自定义板书应用。多年来，这些应用以 JavaScript 和 D 重写，使用了 Canvas、GTK、Cairo、GSK 以及自制软件渲染器。文章聚焦于二维图形库中长期缺失的一项基础能力：带有笔宽坐标的贝塞尔曲线。

items.title_en: Show HN: db-branch – database branches in seconds for AI agents and CI, via ZFS
items.title_zh: Show HN：db-branch——通过 ZFS 为 AI 代理和 CI 秒速创建数据库分支
items.summary_en: db-branch creates copy-on-write branches of large MySQL and PostgreSQL databases in seconds using ZFS clones. The self-hosted tool can provide isolated databases for migrations, AI agents, or pull requests without copying the underlying data. Branches can be reset or discarded, and the project is licensed under Apache-2.0.
items.summary_zh: db-branch 使用 ZFS 克隆，在几秒内为大型 MySQL 和 PostgreSQL 数据库创建写时复制分支。这款自托管工具无需复制底层数据，就能为迁移、AI 代理或每个拉取请求提供独立数据库。分支可以重置或丢弃，项目采用 Apache-2.0 许可证。

items.title_en: Chicago schools to Google – we'd rather lose Search than be forced to accept AI
items.title_zh: 芝加哥学校对 Google 说：宁可失去搜索，也不接受 AI
items.summary_en: Chicago Public Schools said it would use a different search provider rather than accept Google’s AI services. Google had said K–12 schools would soon need to accept those services to retain student access to Search. The dispute followed Google’s warning that schools banning its AI tools could lose access to its search engine.
items.summary_zh: 芝加哥公立学校表示，与其接受 Google 的 AI 服务，不如改用其他搜索服务。Google 此前表示，K-12 学校很快必须接受这些服务，才能保留学生对搜索功能的访问权。这场争议发生在 Google 警告禁止其 AI 工具的学校可能失去搜索引擎访问之后。

items.title_en: Richard Posner has died
items.title_zh: 理查德·波斯纳去世
items.summary_en: Richard Allen Posner died on November 10 at age 87. He was a longtime University of Chicago Law School scholar, a former federal appellate judge, and a pioneer of law and economics. Posner joined the faculty in 1969, served 36 years on the Seventh Circuit, and wrote thousands of opinions, hundreds of academic articles, and dozens of books.
items.summary_zh: 理查德·艾伦·波斯纳于 11 月 10 日去世，享年 87 岁。他是芝加哥大学法学院的长期学者、前联邦上诉法院法官，也是法律与经济学领域的先驱。波斯纳于 1969 年加入该校，曾在第七巡回上诉法院任职 36 年，并撰写了数千份判决意见、数百篇学术论文和数十本著作。

items.title_en: Extending LLDB to Debug Applications That Span CPUs and GPUs
items.title_zh: 扩展 LLDB，调试跨越 CPU 与 GPU 的应用程序
items.summary_en: A vendor-neutral accelerator plugin architecture was added to lldb-server for debugging applications that span CPUs and GPUs. The architecture separates shared debugger infrastructure from hardware-specific device code. It addresses workloads that move between CPU code and GPU kernels, where different instruction sets, registers, memory spaces, execution models, runtimes, and drivers make coordinated debugging difficult.
items.summary_zh: 开发者为 lldb-server 加入了厂商中立的加速器插件架构，用于调试跨越 CPU 和 GPU 的应用程序。该架构将通用调试器基础设施与硬件相关的设备代码分离开来。它针对在 CPU 代码和 GPU 内核之间切换的工作负载，而不同的指令集、寄存器、内存空间、执行模型、运行时和驱动使协同调试变得困难。

items.title_en: Starship Flight 15 live
items.title_zh: Starship 第 15 次飞行直播
items.summary_en: The item points viewers to a live broadcast of Starship Flight 15. No further details about the flight or its outcome are provided.
items.summary_zh: 该内容提供了 Starship 第 15 次飞行的直播入口。现有信息未提供此次飞行的更多细节或结果。

items.title_en: Make this forward pass as fast as possible
items.title_zh: 让这次前向传播尽可能快
items.summary_en: The post considers whether machine-learning agents can optimize models directly instead of relying on traditional ML compilers. It cites Flapping Airplanes' megakernel framework for efficient forward and backward passes and Hyperstition's Hyperkernel for generating high-performance kernels for different models. The comparison places these systems alongside the compiler work traditionally associated with projects such as TVM.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨机器学习代理是否可以直接优化模型，从而取代传统的机器学习编译器。文中提到 Flapping Airplanes 用于高效执行前向和反向传播的 megakernel 框架，以及 Hyperstition 用于为不同模型生成高性能内核的 Hyperkernel。文章还将这些系统与 TVM 等项目长期开展的编译器工作进行了比较。

items.title_en: Businesses in ChatGPT – OpenAI
items.title_zh: ChatGPT 中的企业功能
items.summary_en: OpenAI is introducing Businesses in ChatGPT in beta. Through Business Hub, companies can claim their business listings, keep information current, and see how people engage with them in ChatGPT. Business Agents are also being introduced for eligible U.S. ecommerce and online-service businesses, while the announcement says ChatGPT has 1.2 billion weekly users.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出了 ChatGPT 中的企业功能测试版。企业可以通过 Business Hub 认领商家信息、更新资料，并了解用户在 ChatGPT 中如何与其互动。针对符合条件的美国电商和在线服务企业，平台还开始提供 Business Agents；公告称 ChatGPT 每周拥有 12 亿用户。

items.title_en: Mini.nvim Is Now on Tangled
items.title_zh: Mini.nvim 现已登陆 Tangled
items.summary_en: Mini.nvim is a library of more than 45 independent Lua modules for improving the Neovim experience with minimal effort. The modules target Neovim 0.10 and later and share common configuration approaches and design principles.
items.summary_zh: Mini.nvim 是一个包含 45 个以上独立 Lua 模块的库，旨在以尽可能少的配置改善 Neovim 使用体验。这些模块面向 Neovim 0.10 及更高版本，并采用统一的配置方式和设计原则。

items.title_en: Chemical spills into drainage ditch at SpaceXAI in Southaven
items.title_zh: SpaceXAI 南海文一处化学品泄漏至排水沟
items.summary_en: A chemical spill at SpaceXAI in Southaven entered a drainage ditch.
items.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 位于南海文的设施发生化学品泄漏，流入一条排水沟。

items.title_en: PCMag demands $12000 to link to an article
items.title_zh: PCMag 要求为链接一篇文章支付 12,000 美元
items.summary_en: A publisher says PCMag demanded a $12,000 licensing fee for quoting one sentence and linking to an article on their website. The claim was made in a public post, which criticized the demand in strong language. No further details about the licensing dispute are provided.
items.summary_zh: 一名发布者称，PCMag 要求其为在自己的网站引用一句话并链接到一篇文章支付 12,000 美元的授权费。这一说法发布于公开帖子中，发帖人以强烈措辞批评了这一要求。现有信息没有提供有关授权争议的更多细节。

items.title_en: Service Crew Discovers Rare Yellow Burbot in Oswego Harbor
items.title_zh: 工作人员在奥斯威戈港发现罕见黄色江鳕
items.summary_en: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service biologists found a rare yellow-orange burbot in Oswego Harbor, New York, during a routine aquatic invasive-species survey. The native fish has xanthochromism, a condition that produces its unusually saturated coloration. The find demonstrates how the agency’s multi-gear monitoring program can detect unusual or watchlist species in Great Lakes waterways, supporting earlier management action.
items.summary_zh: 美国鱼类及野生动物管理局的生物学家在纽约州奥斯威戈港进行例行水生入侵物种调查时，发现了一条罕见的黄橙色江鳕。这条本土鱼患有黄化现象，因此呈现异常鲜艳的体色。这一发现展示了该机构如何通过多种装备开展监测，在五大湖水域发现异常物种或观察名单上的物种，从而为及早采取管理措施提供支持。

items.title_en: Show HN: Reflota – Open-source data recovery for NTFS/FAT disks with phased copy
items.title_zh: Show HN：Reflota——支持分阶段复制的 NTFS/FAT 开源数据恢复工具
items.summary_en: Reflota is a free, open-source, read-only tool for recovering files from NTFS, FAT32, FAT16, FAT12, and exFAT disks, including deleted files. It reads disks directly: for NTFS, it reconstructs the folder tree from the master file table and directory metadata, while for FAT and exFAT it reads directories and follows cluster chains. It is intended for cases where Windows reports that a disk is unformatted, a folder will not open, or Explorer hangs.
items.summary_zh: Reflota 是一款免费、开源且只读的数据恢复工具，支持从 NTFS、FAT32、FAT16、FAT12 和 exFAT 磁盘中恢复文件，包括已删除的文件。它会直接读取磁盘：处理 NTFS 时读取主文件表并根据目录元数据重建文件夹树，处理 FAT 和 exFAT 时读取目录并跟踪簇链。当 Windows 报告磁盘未格式化、文件夹无法打开或资源管理器卡死时，该工具可用于尝试恢复数据。

items.title_en: Show HN: Apron Chat Protocol
items.title_zh: Show HN：Apron Chat Protocol
items.summary_en: Apron is a new chat protocol designed for semi-private conversations rather than global social networks. Its demo server runs on a Cloudflare Durable Worker, and the reference client is a progressive web app. Despite using intentionally verbose JSON, a typical Apron session reportedly uses about half the bandwidth and message count of an equivalent Matrix or XMTP session by reducing round trips and required state.
items.summary_zh: Apron 是一种新的聊天协议，面向半私密对话，而非全球性社交网络。其演示服务器运行在 Cloudflare Durable Worker 上，官方参考客户端是渐进式 Web 应用。尽管采用有意保持冗长的 JSON 格式，典型 Apron 会话据称只使用约为同等 Matrix 或 XMTP 会话一半的带宽和消息数量，原因是减少了往返次数和所需状态。

items.title_en: Zellij 0.46: built-in terminal, attention inbox, session previews
items.title_zh: Zellij 0.46：内置终端、关注收件箱和会话预览
items.summary_en: Zellij 0.46.0 adds a built-in terminal, an attention inbox integrated with the desktop, live session previews, and a settings screen. The project remains primarily a terminal multiplexer, while the built-in terminal provides a more complete experience for users who want one.
items.summary_zh: Zellij 0.46.0 新增内置终端、与桌面集成的关注收件箱、实时会话预览和设置界面。该项目仍以终端复用器为核心，同时为希望获得更完整体验的用户提供了内置终端。

items.title_en: Light Pollution Map
items.title_zh: 光污染地图
items.summary_en: The map lets users explore 2026 light-pollution estimates alongside the latest 2025 annual satellite layer. It provides Bortle class, sky-quality meter readings, and dark-sky conditions for any location.
items.summary_zh: 这张地图允许用户查看 2026 年光污染估算数据，以及最新的 2025 年年度卫星图层。它还能显示任意地点的 Bortle 等级、天空质量计数值和暗空状况。

items.title_en: "Who is Hiring?" postings stuck near 12-year lows as AI reaches half of all jobs
items.title_zh: “谁在招聘？”职位数接近 12 年低点，AI 已出现在半数职位中
items.summary_en: Hacker News’ November “Who is Hiring?” thread had 244 postings by November 14, down 37% from 387 at the same point last year. The 2026 monthly average is 287 postings, the lowest yearly average since 2013. AI was mentioned in 51.6% of postings, up from 30% two years earlier.
items.summary_zh: 截至 11 月 14 日，Hacker News 11 月“谁在招聘？”主题帖有 244 个职位，比去年同期的 387 个减少 37%。2026 年月均职位数为 287 个，是 2013 年以来最低的年度平均值。AI 出现在 51.6% 的职位描述中，高于两年前的 30%。

items.title_en: Aspidistra: A British wartime radio transmitter used for MitM attacks
items.title_zh: Aspidistra：用于中间人攻击的英国战时无线电发射机
items.summary_en: Aspidistra was a powerful British medium-wave transmitter used for black propaganda and military deception against Nazi Germany during World War II. It was installed in 1942 near Crowborough in southeast England. The original medium-wave transmitter was known as ASPI 1, while related medium- and short-wave transmitters used variants of the name.
items.summary_zh: Aspidistra 是英国在二战期间使用的一台强力中波无线电发射机，用于针对纳粹德国的秘密宣传和军事欺骗。它于 1942 年安装在英格兰东南部克劳伯勒附近。原始中波发射机称为 ASPI 1，其他相关中短波发射机则使用这一名称的变体。

items.title_en: Safety in Algae Home Experiments
items.title_zh: 藻类家庭实验的安全性
items.summary_en: The piece concerns safety in home experiments involving algae. The available description does not provide specific procedures, hazards, or recommendations.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容涉及家庭藻类实验的安全性。现有描述没有提供具体实验步骤、风险或建议。

items.title_en: An open letter to the Nvidia Board of Directors
items.title_zh: 致英伟达董事会的公开信
items.summary_en: The campaign is organized by current and former NVIDIA employees and shareholders. It expresses gratitude to Jensen Huang and asks the board for a transparent account of the CEO transition. The campaign states that it is independent and not affiliated with NVIDIA.
items.summary_zh: 这项倡议由英伟达现任和前任员工及股东发起。倡议表达了对黄仁勋的感谢，并要求董事会透明说明 CEO 交接情况。发起方表示该倡议独立于英伟达，与公司没有隶属关系。

items.title_en: Pointer Provenance in Rust vs. C++: Pointers Are Not Just Glorified Ints
items.title_zh: Rust 与 C++ 中的指针溯源：指针不只是强化版整数
items.summary_en: This exploration examines pointer provenance in Rust and C++, including LLVM IR and the representation of vtables and function pointers. The author investigates how provenance affects what pointers can legitimately reference and why it is difficult to visualize directly in memory. The project uses low-level experiments to compare the two languages’ approaches.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨 Rust 和 C++ 中的指针溯源，包括 LLVM IR 以及虚函数表和函数指针的表示方式。作者研究了溯源如何影响指针能够合法引用的对象，以及为什么它难以直接通过内存观察。项目通过底层实验比较两种语言的处理方式。

items.title_en: The Confidential Payments Meta and TikTok Made to Addicted Teens
items.title_zh: Meta 和 TikTok 向成瘾青少年支付的秘密款项
items.summary_en: The report examines confidential payments made by Meta and TikTok to settle lawsuits involving social-media addiction among teenagers. No further details are available.
items.summary_zh: 报道调查了 Meta 和 TikTok 为解决涉及青少年社交媒体成瘾的诉讼而支付的保密款项。现有信息未提供更多细节。

items.title_en: JSON vs. jsonb in Postgres: size and speed, measured
items.title_zh: Postgres 中的 JSON 与 jsonb：实测大小和速度
items.summary_en: Measurements on PostgreSQL 17.11 and 18.6 found that jsonb's storage cost depends on document shape and formatting, ranging from 22.6% smaller to 40.9% larger across the tested cases. Reading one key with ->> was 2.7 to 10.6 times faster from jsonb in every timed case. Only jsonb supports containment comparisons, grouping, and containment indexes.
items.summary_zh: 对 PostgreSQL 17.11 和 18.6 的测试发现，jsonb 的存储开销取决于文档形状和格式，在所有测试案例中从小 22.6% 到大 40.9% 不等。使用 ->> 读取单个键时，jsonb 在每个计时案例中都快 2.7 至 10.6 倍。只有 jsonb 支持包含关系比较、分组以及包含关系索引。

items.title_en: The Myth of Neutral Code
items.title_zh: 中立代码的神话
items.summary_en: The essay challenges the corporate idea that open-source software is apolitical, neutral, and governed purely by technical merit. It describes a recurring argument that codes of conduct and attention to problematic individuals have made software political and damaged an earlier meritocracy. The discussion frames open-source tools as products of social and institutional choices rather than neutral utilities.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章质疑一种企业化观念：开源软件是非政治的、中立的，并且完全由技术 merit 统治。文章描述了一种反复出现的说法，即行为准则以及对项目中有争议人物的关注让软件变得政治化，并破坏了过去的技术 meritocracy。文章将开源工具视为社会和制度选择的产物，而非中立的工具。

items.title_en: Agile Manifesto for Agents
items.title_zh: 面向智能体的敏捷宣言
items.summary_en: The proposed manifesto gives teams using coding agents twelve rules, including understanding scope before implementation, coordinating bounded work, and delivering software an enterprise can operate. It warns that multiple agents can produce conflicting interpretations, incompatible interfaces, and more changes than teams can review. A successful agent run alone does not show that a useful system has been delivered.
items.summary_zh: 这份宣言为使用编码智能体的团队提出了十二条原则，包括在实现前理解范围、协调边界明确的工作，以及交付企业能够运维的软件。它警告说，多个智能体可能产生相互冲突的需求理解、不兼容的接口，以及团队无法充分审查的大量改动。一次成功的智能体运行本身，并不能证明团队交付了有用的系统。

items.title_en: Paths in Pieces
items.title_zh: 碎片化的路径
items.summary_en: Linux distributions and package managers audit newly built binaries for such non-relocatable paths because they may fail on end-user systems. A simple grep of the binary is not always sufficient to find them.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章研究了 GCC 在 x86-64 上生成的二进制文件如何隐藏构建机器的绝对路径。Linux 发行版和包管理器会检查新构建的二进制文件是否包含这类不可重定位路径，因为它们可能无法在最终用户系统上运行。直接对二进制文件执行 grep 并不总能发现这些路径。

items.title_en: Jensen Huang Was the Face of the A.I. Boom Powering the U.S. Economy
items.title_zh: Jensen Huang 曾是推动美国经济的 AI 热潮代言人
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang was unusually central to NVIDIA’s success and served as a rhetorical and financial booster for investments driving economic growth. NVIDIA has also been unusually central to the AI boom, developing chips used by many AI models and helping finance data-center construction. The report argues that Huang’s removal could therefore have broader macroeconomic implications.
items.summary_zh: Jensen Huang 在英伟达的成功中扮演了异常核心的角色，也是推动经济增长的相关投资在舆论和资金层面的重要推动者。英伟达同样在 AI 热潮中占据异常重要的位置，不仅开发了许多 AI 模型使用的芯片，还帮助为数据中心建设提供资金。报道因此认为，黄仁勋离任可能产生更广泛的宏观经济影响。

items.title_en: Grote Reber and the 'Square Kilometre Array' Near Bothwell, Tasmania (2017)
items.title_zh: Grote Reber 与 Bothwell 附近的“平方公里阵列”（塔斯马尼亚，2017）
items.summary_en: The item concerns Grote Reber and the Square Kilometre Array near Bothwell, Tasmania, in 2017. No further details are available.
items.summary_zh: 该内容涉及 2017 年塔斯马尼亚州 Bothwell 附近的 Grote Reber 与“平方公里阵列”。现有信息未提供更多细节。

items.title_en: Optimizing Reference Deletions in Git
items.title_zh: 优化 Git 中的引用删除
items.summary_en: Optimizing Reference Deletions in Git examines how Git references can be deleted more efficiently. No further reliable details are available.
items.summary_zh: 《优化 Git 中的引用删除》研究如何更高效地删除 Git 引用。现有信息没有提供更多可靠细节。

items.title_en: An ode to livelyness analysis; SSA to registers
items.title_zh: 献给活跃性分析的颂歌：从 SSA 到寄存器
items.summary_en: This project examines block-local liveness analysis on SSA intermediate representation and register allocation for a virtual machine and an x86 JIT compiler. The work supports the author’s programming language, purple-garden, whose register-based bytecode VM and JIT are both being developed.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目研究 SSA 中间表示上的基本块局部活跃性分析，以及虚拟机和 x86 JIT 编译器中的寄存器分配。相关工作服务于作者的编程语言 purple-garden，其基于寄存器的字节码虚拟机和 JIT 编译器都在开发中。

items.title_en: Stable URLs for 42,000 Huts and Peaks
items.title_zh: 为 42,000 座小屋与山峰提供稳定 URL
items.summary_en: The project gives Alpine huts, bivouacs, and peaks on biwak.info short, readable URLs that remain tied to the same place. Names are disambiguated using region, elevation, and OpenStreetMap IDs, while a committed registry prevents a slug from being reassigned. The dataset contains 42,866 places: 9,429 huts and bivouacs plus 33,437 named peaks.
items.summary_zh: 该项目为 biwak.info 上的阿尔卑斯山小屋、露营地和山峰提供简短、易读且始终指向同一地点的 URL。名称冲突时会依次加入地区、海拔和 OpenStreetMap ID 进行区分，并通过已提交的注册表防止 slug 被重新分配。数据集共包含 42,866 个地点，其中有 9,429 座小屋和露营地，以及 33,437 座有名称的山峰。

items.title_en: Deuterium's Impact on OLED Displays (2024)
items.title_zh: 氘对 OLED 显示屏的影响（2024）
items.summary_en: It focuses particularly on deuterated blue OLED emitters, which address the historically higher power consumption of blue OLEDs compared with red and green emitters. The post is sponsored content.
items.summary_zh: 文章将氘这种稳定的氢同位素描述为一种可提升 OLED 亮度、效率和寿命的材料。内容尤其关注氘化蓝色 OLED 发光材料，它可应对蓝色 OLED 历来比红色和绿色发光材料耗电更高的问题。该内容为赞助文章。

items.title_en: Creating Worlds: Runes and Spells Prototype
items.title_zh: 创造世界：符文与法术原型
items.summary_en: The post presents one approach to designing a magic system for fictional worlds. It proposes using runes and casting spells on those runes, and provides a prototype toy for experimenting with the idea. The author plans to follow with additional world-building posts.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章介绍了一种为虚构世界设计魔法系统的方法。作者提出使用符文，并在符文上施放法术，同时提供了一个可供实验的原型工具。作者还计划继续发布其他世界构建文章。

items.title_en: A Brief History of Sierra Online (2017)
items.title_zh: Sierra Online 简史（2017）
items.summary_en: Sierra, originally called On-Line Systems, became a major computer-game developer and made important contributions to the graphic-adventure genre. The retrospective focuses on the company’s history and its role in establishing that genre. It also frames Sierra as a major influence on the development of adventure games.
items.summary_zh: Sierra 最初名为 On-Line Systems，后来成为重要的电脑游戏开发商，并对图形冒险游戏这一类型作出了重要贡献。这篇回顾文章聚焦于公司的历史及其在确立该类型中的作用。文章还将 Sierra 视为冒险游戏发展的重要推动者。

items.title_en: With Little Ado, Congress Put God in Pledge in 1954
items.title_zh: 少有波澜：国会于 1954 年将“上帝”写入效忠誓词
items.summary_en: In 1954, Congress added the words “under God” to the Pledge of Allegiance to emphasize the contrast between the US system of government and “godless Communism.” The change occurred amid political upheaval that included McCarthy's anti-Communist campaign, Cold War tensions, and a Supreme Court ruling against school segregation.
items.summary_zh: 1954 年，国会将“under God”（信仰上帝）加入《效忠誓词》，以强调美国政府制度与“无神的共产主义”之间的差异。这一变化发生在政治动荡时期，当时美国正经历麦卡锡的反共运动、冷战紧张局势，以及最高法院裁定学校种族隔离违宪等事件。

items.title_en: Write your own kernel optimiser
items.title_zh: 自己编写内核优化器
items.summary_en: Kernel optimization can rely on compiler transformations or on manually rewriting data flow to match the hardware. When high-level abstractions are not optimized sufficiently, developers may turn to custom kernels, intrinsics, and inline assembly. Both compiler and manual optimizations depend on transformations that preserve program meaning only under certain conditions.
items.summary_zh: 内核优化可以依赖编译器变换，也可以手动重写数据流，使其匹配硬件。当高层抽象无法得到充分优化时，开发者可能需要编写自定义内核、使用内建函数和内联汇编。编译器优化和手工优化都依赖于仅在特定条件下保持程序语义的变换。

items.title_en: Tor Project Issues Rapid-Response DoS-Defense Fix Amid Sustained DDoS Attack
items.title_zh: Tor 项目在持续 DDoS 攻击下紧急发布防 DoS 修复
items.summary_en: The Tor Project released version 0.4.9.17 with a series of security fixes. One particularly important change improves relay defenses against denial-of-service attacks related to IPv6 handling. The rapid-response release follows an ongoing DDoS attack that has affected most relay operators.
items.summary_zh: Tor 项目发布了 0.4.9.17 版本，其中包含一系列安全修复。其中一项重要改动改进了中继节点针对 IPv6 处理相关拒绝服务攻击的防护。此次快速响应发布源于一场仍在持续的 DDoS 攻击，该攻击已影响大多数中继运营者。

items.title_en: Jensen Huang Scandal Sparks Speculation–Jensen's Wife Could Get Half
items.title_zh: Jensen Huang 丑闻引发猜测：妻子或可获得其一半财产
items.summary_en: Reports about a Jensen Huang scandal have prompted speculation about a possible divorce settlement. The headline says his wife could receive half of his reported $155 billion fortune.
items.summary_zh: 有关 Jensen Huang 丑闻的报道引发了对可能离婚财产分配的猜测。标题称，他的妻子可能获得其据报道达 1550 亿美元财产的一半。

items.title_en: Show HN: Recalc – Spreadsheet where cells can be Claude Code or Codex terminals
items.title_zh: Show HN：Recalc——单元格可以运行 Claude Code 或 Codex 的电子表格
items.summary_en: Recalc is a spreadsheet that can host a lead Claude Code or Codex session in a side panel while allowing each cell to act as a terminal session. Sessions can communicate through grid cells, named cells, or an MCP server, and can be continued in a regular terminal. The tool currently runs locally on macOS, with Linux support described as less tested.
items.summary_zh: Recalc 是一款电子表格应用，可在侧栏运行主 Claude Code 或 Codex 会话，并让每个单元格充当终端会话。不同会话可以通过网格单元格、命名单元格或 MCP 服务器互相通信，也可以在普通终端中继续运行。目前该工具可在 macOS 本地运行，Linux 支持则尚未充分测试。

items.title_en: Brazil's Serra Verde starts shipping heavy rare earths to US under 15-year deal
items.title_zh: 巴西 Serra Verde 根据 15 年协议开始向美国发运重稀土
items.summary_en: Brazil’s Serra Verde has started shipping heavy rare earths to the United States under a 15-year deal. No further reliable details are available.
items.summary_zh: 巴西 Serra Verde 已根据一项为期 15 年的协议开始向美国发运重稀土。现有信息没有提供更多可靠细节。

items.title_en: Ergodic Literature
items.title_zh: 遍历文学
items.summary_en: Ergodic literature requires readers to perform nontrivial work to traverse a text beyond ordinary reading or turning pages. Espen J. Aarseth borrowed the term from physics and introduced it within his broader concept of cybertext. In his framework, a cybertext includes a semiotic sequence produced through the reader's material actions, not just conventional reading.
items.summary_zh: 遍历文学要求读者付出超越普通阅读或翻页的实质性努力来穿行文本。Espen J. Aarseth 借用了物理学中的这一术语，并将其置于更广义的“赛博文本”概念中。在他的框架里，赛博文本包含由读者的实际操作产生的符号序列，而不只是传统意义上的阅读。

items.title_en: Relate – the agent-native graph database
items.title_zh: Relate——面向智能体的原生图数据库
items.summary_en: Relate is an open-source embedded database for AI agents. It gives agents a place to store data and represent connections without requiring an account or a separate server. Its installation process also verifies release signatures and SHA256 checksums.
items.summary_zh: Relate 是一个面向 AI 智能体的开源嵌入式数据库。它为智能体提供存储数据和表示数据关系的地方，无需注册账号或部署独立服务器。其安装流程还会验证发布签名和 SHA256 校验和。

items.title_en: The CFPB says it's looking out for consumers. Data tells a different story
items.title_zh: CFPB 称其正在保护消费者，但数据却呈现出另一番景象
items.summary_en: Complaints about banks and other financial companies continue to rise while officials appointed by Donald Trump suppress enforcement actions at the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau. The report was supported and co-published by the Economic Hardship Reporting Project.
items.summary_zh: 针对银行及其他金融公司的投诉持续增加，而唐纳德·特朗普任命的官员正在压制消费者金融保护局的执法行动。该报道获得 Economic Hardship Reporting Project 的支持并联合发布。

items.title_en: Decoding REXPaint Files in Odin
items.title_zh: 用 Odin 解码 REXPaint 文件
items.summary_en: The post explains how to decode REXPaint’s .xp files using Odin. REXPaint is an ASCII-art tool used to create interfaces, full-screen artwork, and level prefabs, including assets for the game Fimbul. The walkthrough is based on REXPaint version 1.70 and is intended as an accessible introduction to binary file formats.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章介绍如何使用 Odin 解码 REXPaint 的 .xp 文件。REXPaint 是一款 ASCII 艺术工具，可用于制作界面、全屏图像和关卡预制件，也被用于游戏 Fimbul 的素材制作。文章基于 REXPaint 1.70，旨在以易于入门的方式介绍二进制文件格式。

items.title_en: If I were diagnosed with cancer today, here's what I'd do
items.title_zh: 如果我今天被诊断出癌症，我会这样做
items.summary_en: If I Were Diagnosed with Cancer Today, Here’s What I’d Do presents a personal response to receiving a cancer diagnosis. No further reliable details are available.
items.summary_zh: 《如果我今天被诊断出癌症，我会这样做》讲述了面对癌症诊断时的个人应对方式。现有信息没有提供更多可靠细节。

items.title_en: Bilingualism and Denaskuleco
items.title_zh: 双语能力与 Denaskuleco
items.summary_en: The author’s children are native Esperanto speakers, but their comprehension differs according to their exposure to the language. Mira has heard more Esperanto from the author, attended a European Esperanto family gathering, and understands adults who speak it despite speaking little herself. Mabel, born three years later and exposed to fewer Esperanto books and gatherings, understands less of the language.
items.summary_zh: 作者的孩子都是以世界语为母语的使用者，但她们对这门语言的理解程度因接触量不同而有所差异。Mira 更多地听作者说世界语，还参加过欧洲世界语家庭聚会；虽然自己说得不多，她仍能听懂说世界语的成年人。Mabel 比她晚三年出生，接触的世界语童书和聚会较少，因此理解得也更少。

items.title_en: A Human Reads the Anthropic IPO Filing
items.title_zh: 一个人阅读 Anthropic 的 IPO 文件
items.summary_en: The item presents a human reading of Anthropic's filing for an initial public offering. It focuses on the company's IPO prospectus and the information contained in that filing.
items.summary_zh: 该条目由一名读者解读 Anthropic 提交的首次公开募股文件。内容聚焦于公司的 IPO 招股说明书及其中披露的信息。

items.title_en: Anthropic Upgrades Claude Code Projects to Run Parallel AI Workers Hands-Free
items.title_zh: Anthropic 升级 Claude Code Projects，可免手动管理并行 AI 工作者
items.summary_en: Anthropic updated Claude Code Projects with proactive coordinator messages, read-only thread sharing, reminders, branching commands, and improved artifact navigation. Each project has a coordinator that assigns work to independent Claude Code cloud sessions, each with its own repository copy and Git branch. The changes reduce the monitoring required while several sessions work in parallel, although overlapping edits still surface as ordinary Git merge conflicts.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 更新了 Claude Code Projects，加入主动协调员消息、只读线程共享、提醒、分支命令和更好的工件导航功能。每个项目由协调员向彼此独立的 Claude Code 云会话分配任务，每个会话都有自己的代码仓库副本和 Git 分支。这些改进减少了并行会话工作时所需的监控，不过重叠修改仍会以普通 Git 合并冲突的形式出现。

items.title_en: Technology as a Search Problem
items.title_zh: 把技术视为搜索问题
items.summary_en: The essay examines how technology emerges and improves over time. It frames technological progress as an ongoing research question about how new technologies come into the world. A response connects the discussion with Terraform Industries’ public work and first-principles reasoning.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨技术如何产生并随时间改进。它将技术进步视为一个持续的研究问题，关注新技术如何进入现实世界。文中的回应把这一讨论与 Terraform Industries 的公开工作及第一性原理推理联系起来。

items.title_en: Norway has purchased 500k drones for Ukraine (Norwegian)
items.title_zh: 挪威已为乌克兰购买 50 万架无人机（挪威语）
items.summary_en: Norway’s Defence Materiel Agency says it purchased roughly 500,000 drones and donated them to Ukraine. The agency’s director, Gro Jære, announced the figure at a conference in Oslo.
items.summary_zh: 挪威国防物资局表示，已购买约 50 万架无人机并捐赠给乌克兰。该机构负责人 Gro Jære 在奥斯陆的一场会议上公布了这一数字。

items.title_en: AI is an information gateway. Audiences still don't want it making their news
items.title_zh: AI 正成为信息入口，但受众仍不希望它替自己生产新闻
items.summary_en: Across nine countries, an average of 24% of respondents said they had seen a label indicating that content was made with AI during the previous week. An average of 20% had seen a bullet-point AI summary of news. These figures describe the visibility of AI-generated labels and summaries among audiences in the surveyed countries.
items.summary_zh: 在九个国家中，平均 24% 的受访者表示自己在上一周见过标明内容由 AI 制作的标签。平均 20% 的受访者见过以要点形式呈现的 AI 新闻摘要。这些数据反映了受访国家受众接触 AI 生成标签和摘要的情况。

items.title_en: Huang Discusses Comeback as Nvidia Chief with Allies, FT Says
items.title_zh: 《金融时报》称黄仁勋与盟友讨论回归英伟达担任 CEO
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang has reportedly discussed returning as Nvidia’s chief executive with allies.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，黄仁勋已与盟友讨论回归英伟达担任首席执行官。

items.title_en: Keylogger Detection and Containment [pdf]
items.title_zh: 键盘记录器检测与遏制
items.summary_en: A PDF presents work on detecting and containing keyloggers.
items.summary_zh: 这份 PDF 介绍了键盘记录器的检测与遏制方法。

items.title_en: 1900s How do you Wash a Kimono?
items.title_zh: 1900 年代：和服该如何清洗？
items.summary_en: Three Japanese women are shown doing laundry in kimono. One washes clothes in a wooden tub while the other two spread separated kimono on wooden boards.
items.summary_zh: 照片中，三名身穿和服的日本女性正在洗衣服。一人用木盆清洗衣物，另外两人将拆开的和服铺在木板上。
