items.title_en: Twelve things you could build on a live index of internet radio
items.title_zh: 基于实时互联网广播索引可以构建的十二件事
items.summary_en: Tuneping tracks what about 23,000 radio stations are playing now and what 58,000 stations played over recent weeks. The post proposes twelve projects that could use this live index, including email notifications triggered by releases. It also describes the endpoints and implementation plans, with most ideas intended to fit into a weekend.
items.summary_zh: Tuneping 记录约 23,000 个电台当前播放的内容，以及约 58,000 个电台过去几周播放过的内容。文章提出了 12 个可以利用这一实时索引的项目，包括在新作品发布当天发送邮件通知。文中还说明了所需接口和实现计划，其中大多数想法预计一个周末即可完成。

items.title_en: Lighting the Skies
items.title_zh: 照亮天空
items.summary_en: The piece considers the role of technology in warfare, beginning with early expectations that a mechanical device would decide World War I. It places nuclear weapons in a broader historical context, noting that they became available only very late in World War II and that the conventional firebombing of Tokyo may have caused as many deaths as the attacks on Hiroshima and Nagasaki. The discussion questions whether nuclear weapons had the decisive impact on the war that is often assumed.
items.summary_zh: 文章从一战早期人们认为某种机械装置将决定战争胜负的期待出发，讨论技术在战争中的作用。文章将核武器置于更广泛的历史背景中，指出核武器直到二战末期才出现，而东京的常规燃烧弹轰炸可能造成了与广岛、长崎核攻击相当的死亡人数。文章因此质疑核武器是否真的像通常认为的那样，对战争产生了决定性影响。

items.title_en: Coles hit by a cybersecurity incident
items.title_zh: Coles 遭遇网络安全事件
items.summary_en: Coles has been hit by a cybersecurity incident.
items.summary_zh: Coles 遭遇了一起网络安全事件。

items.title_en: DKIM2 – Every system that handles an email signs for what it did
items.title_zh: DKIM2：每个处理电子邮件的系统都为自己的操作签名
items.summary_en: DKIM2 proposes a verifiable way for legitimate email to demonstrate its origin and attribute every modification to the system that made it. The project addresses forwarding, mailing lists, Bcc, replayed signatures, and forged bounces. It is described as work in progress within the IETF DKIM working group, where the goal is to make legitimate mail easier to distinguish from abuse.
items.summary_zh: DKIM2 提出了一种可验证的机制，让合法邮件证明其来源，并将每次修改归因于执行该操作的系统。该项目针对转发、邮件列表、密送、重放签名和伪造退信等问题。目前它仍是 IETF DKIM 工作组中的进行中项目，目标是让合法邮件更容易与滥用邮件区分开来。

items.title_en: Trump had urged Nvidia’s Jensen Huang to fight for his job
items.title_zh: 特朗普曾敦促英伟达的黄仁勋为保住职位而战
items.summary_en: President Trump called Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on Tuesday and urged him to keep fighting for his job, according to people briefed on the conversation. The call came before Huang stepped down as a spy scandal was intensifying. Trump had continued supporting Huang, who had become an ally and adviser on artificial intelligence.
items.summary_zh: 据了解通话情况的人士透露，美国总统特朗普周二致电英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋，敦促他继续为保住职位而努力。这通电话发生在间谍丑闻加剧、黄仁勋随后辞职之前。特朗普此前一直支持黄仁勋，后者已成为其在人工智能领域的重要盟友和顾问。

items.title_en: Multiple remote code execution vulnerabilities in danfoss sm-800A
items.title_zh: Danfoss SM-800A 存在多个远程代码执行漏洞
items.summary_en: Researchers found several pre-authentication remote-code-execution zero-days in Danfoss AK-SM 800A refrigeration controllers in less than an hour of manual inspection. The discovery follows waves of attacks against internet-exposed Danfoss and Copeland controllers, in which attackers triggered defrosting and caused spoiled food and fires. The researchers recommend reducing internet exposure rather than relying only on patching these devices.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员称，他们通过不到一小时的人工检查，就在 Danfoss AK-SM 800A 制冷控制器中发现了多个无需身份验证即可利用的远程代码执行零日漏洞。此前，面向互联网暴露的 Danfoss 和 Copeland 控制器已遭遇多轮攻击，攻击者触发除霜操作，造成食品变质，甚至引发火灾。研究人员建议优先减少设备暴露面，而不要只依赖给这些设备打补丁。

items.title_en: Why, oh why, is it so hard to buy a digital bus ticket in 2026?
items.title_zh: 为什么 2026 年买张数字公交票仍然这么难？
items.summary_en: The author describes trying to buy a digital bus ticket in Munich through the MVV app. Although the app is meant to handle fare zones and cap daily charges, it had logged the author out despite recent use. The recurring sign-out turned a theoretically simple purchase into a rushed process before catching the bus.
items.summary_zh: 作者讲述了自己在慕尼黑通过 MVV 应用购买数字公交票的经历。该应用本应自动处理票价区域，并将一天的收费封顶，但作者最近使用过它，却再次发现自己已被登出。反复发生的登出问题，让原本应该简单的购票过程变成了赶车前的慌乱操作。

items.title_en: Modern Web Guidance 1.0: The web platform expertise your coding agent is missing
items.title_zh: Modern Web Guidance 1.0：编码代理缺少的 Web 平台专业知识
items.summary_en: Modern Web Guidance 1.0 provides AI coding agents with expert-reviewed web platform skills, browser compatibility data, and codebase modernization guidance. The announcement notes that coding models can usually produce working code, but expert reviews often find opportunities to improve speed, accessibility, and security. The guidance is intended to fill that web-development expertise gap.
items.summary_zh: Modern Web Guidance 1.0 为 AI 编码代理提供经过专家审阅的 Web 平台技能、浏览器兼容性数据和代码库现代化指导。公告指出，编码模型通常能够生成可运行的代码，但 Web 专家往往还能发现提升速度、可访问性和安全性的空间。这套指导旨在弥补代理在 Web 开发专业知识上的不足。

items.title_en: Small-Grid Wraparound Cellular Automata
items.title_zh: 小网格环绕元胞自动机
items.summary_en: The piece concerns cellular automata running on small grids with wraparound boundaries. In such a grid, activity leaving one edge re-enters from the opposite edge.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容讨论运行在小型网格上的环绕元胞自动机。在这种网格中，从一条边离开的状态会从相对的另一条边重新进入。

items.title_en: Open-source AI without Jensen
items.title_zh: 没有黄仁勋的开源 AI
items.summary_en: It also questions who benefits from the sequence of events, while offering no further factual details in the available excerpt.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容将一位重要开源 AI 倡导者和竞争者的离去描述为一次重大打击。文章还质疑这一连串事件的受益者，但现有摘录未提供更多事实细节。

items.title_en: Why platform teams fail (and AI makes it worse)
items.title_zh: 平台团队为何失败（以及 AI 如何让情况更糟）
items.summary_en: It draws on observations from nearly a decade of work with platform teams across companies of different sizes and maturity levels. The proposed lessons concern golden paths, guardrails, and organizational buy-in.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容探讨了平台团队为何经常变成换了名称的运维团队，并认为生成式 AI 正在加速这一失调循环。作者基于近十年来与不同规模、不同成熟度公司的平台团队合作和观察，总结了相关经验。讨论的重点包括黄金路径、防护栏和组织支持。

items.title_en: SEC Enforcement Failures Abandon Investors, Benefit Crooks
items.title_zh: SEC 执法失误抛弃投资者、纵容犯罪分子
items.summary_en: Better Markets criticized the SEC after it released enforcement results for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026. Its securities policy director, Benjamin Schiffrin, said the agency's enforcement activity had declined during Chair Paul Atkins's tenure and argued that the statistics showed it had abandoned its investor-protection duty. These claims are presented as a statement from Better Markets rather than as independent findings in the excerpt.
items.summary_zh: Better Markets 在 SEC 发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日财年的执法结果后对其提出批评。该组织证券政策主任 Benjamin Schiffrin 称，SEC 在主席 Paul Atkins 任期内的执法活动有所下降，并认为相关统计数据表明 SEC 放弃了保护投资者的职责。现有摘录中的这些说法来自 Better Markets 的声明，而非独立调查结论。

items.title_en: Tell HN: Google Search to start locking down search behind a login wall
items.title_zh: 告诉 HN：Google Search 开始把搜索结果锁在登录墙后
items.summary_en: A user reports that Google Search has begun placing some search-result pages behind a login prompt for certain ISP CGNAT addresses. Those addresses had already triggered repeated CAPTCHA challenges, while some VPN addresses did not. The change could make signed-out search less accessible, especially on shared or public computers.
items.summary_zh: 一名用户报告称，对于某些 ISP CGNAT 地址，Google Search 开始要求登录后才能查看部分搜索结果页面。这些地址此前已经频繁触发 CAPTCHA，而部分 VPN 地址却没有遇到同样问题。这一变化可能降低未登录搜索的可访问性，尤其会影响共享或公共电脑。

items.title_en: Lying to Zed to get its remote server running on FreeBSD
items.title_zh: 欺骗 Zed，让它在 FreeBSD 上运行远程服务器
items.summary_en: The author got Zed’s remote development feature working with a FreeBSD machine. The effort involved a 768-byte buffer and adapting the setup despite Zed not natively targeting that environment. The author favors Zed’s speed and its option to disable AI features.
items.summary_zh: 作者让 Zed 的远程开发功能在 FreeBSD 机器上运行起来。过程中涉及一个 768 字节的缓冲区，并需要在 Zed 未原生针对该环境的情况下调整配置。作者偏爱 Zed 的速度，以及其关闭 AI 功能的选项。

items.title_en: A teacher that made $20M a year making videos for babies
items.title_zh: 一位靠制作婴儿视频年赚 2000 万美元的教师
items.summary_en: Julie Aigner-Clark invested $15,000 of her savings in a baby video, sold 20% of the company to a distributor, and sold the business to Disney five years later. The company’s sale price was $25 million. The story traces how a basement video became the Baby Einstein business.
items.summary_zh: Julie Aigner-Clark 用 15,000 美元积蓄投资制作了一部婴儿视频，将公司 20% 的股份卖给发行商，并在五年后把公司卖给迪士尼。公司的出售价格为 2,500 万美元。这个故事讲述了一部地下室制作的视频如何发展成 Baby Einstein 生意。

items.title_en: Before Pixels: Speed-Minder
items.title_zh: 像素之前：Speed-Minder
items.summary_en: The post looks at an early version of radar-based speed displays. The author encountered modern signs showing a driver’s detected speed in a segmented font and then learned about an earlier implementation of the idea. It connects the example to the history of displaying measured vehicle speed.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章介绍了基于雷达的速度显示器的早期版本。作者先注意到使用分段字体显示车辆检测速度的现代标牌，随后了解到这一想法的早期实现。文章由此串联起车辆测得速度显示技术的发展。

items.title_en: Show HN: 3D to 2D, point clouds flattening (geometry images)
items.title_zh: Show HN：3D 转 2D，展平点云（几何图像）
items.summary_en: Flatpoints applies geometry-image principles directly to point clouds. It maps each 3D point from a point cloud sampled on an unknown surface to a 2D pixel, arranging the points into a square grid. The resulting flat representation can serve as an image-like indexing structure.
items.summary_zh: Flatpoints 将几何图像的原理直接应用于点云。它把从未知曲面采样得到的每个三维点映射为二维像素，并将这些点排列到方形网格中。生成的平面表示可以作为类似图像的索引结构。

items.title_en: Too Many Stadiums with Roofs
items.title_zh: 屋顶体育场太多了
items.summary_en: The piece argues that modern cities are building too many football stadiums with roofs. It uses the planned Washington Commanders stadium as an example; the venue is expected to open in 2030 and has an announced cost of $2.7 billion.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容认为，现代城市正在建造过多带屋顶的橄榄球场。文章以规划中的华盛顿指挥官队体育场为例：该场馆预计于 2030 年开放，公布造价为 27 亿美元。

items.title_en: A few drawings about Linux (2016)
items.title_zh: 几幅关于 Linux 的图画（2016）
items.summary_en: The author spent several days drawing one picture about Linux each day and collected the results in this series. The drawings cover topics such as /proc and were intended to make unfamiliar Linux concepts easier to discover.
items.summary_zh: 作者连续数日每天绘制一幅关于 Linux 的图画，并将成果整理成这一系列。图画涉及 /proc 等主题，旨在帮助读者发现并理解不熟悉的 Linux 概念。

items.title_en: I ran 120B MoE models on my 32GB M1 Max using under 16 GB
items.title_zh: 我在 32GB M1 Max 上运行 120B MoE 模型，内存占用低于 16GB
items.summary_en: The project runs large mixture-of-experts models on a MacBook Pro with an M1 Max and 32 GB of RAM by keeping most model data on the SSD. It loads the required portions during inference and enforces a memory limit that can be checked against macOS’s own memory counters. The approach is intended to run models that would not fit entirely in the machine’s memory.
items.summary_zh: 该项目通过将大部分模型数据放在 SSD 上，让配备 M1 Max 和 32GB 内存的 MacBook Pro 运行大型混合专家模型。推理过程中，系统按需加载所需部分，并施加可与 macOS 自身内存计数器核对的内存上限。这种方法旨在运行无法完全装入机器内存的模型。

items.title_en: Tesla Opens Cybercab Orders to 'Select Customers' at $29,990 Plus $299 per Month
items.title_zh: 特斯拉向“精选客户”开放 Cybercab 订单：售价 29,990 美元，另加每月 299 美元
items.summary_en: Tesla says the Cybercab will be available for personal use at a price of $29,990. Autonomous driving requires an additional $299-per-month subscription. Orders are being opened to selected customers.
items.summary_zh: 特斯拉表示，Cybercab 将以 29,990 美元的价格供个人使用。自动驾驶功能还需每月支付 299 美元的订阅费。目前订单面向精选客户开放。

items.title_en: Vercel should fork and maintain Deno
items.title_zh: Vercel 应该 fork 并维护 Deno
items.summary_en: The proposal argues that Vercel should take over Deno after its acquisition by Cloudflare and the stated plan to eventually sunset it. The author says Vercel has the resources to maintain the project and expresses interest in working on that effort. The post asks how Deno should continue after the Cloudflare acquisition.
items.summary_zh: 这项提议认为，在 Deno 被 Cloudflare 收购且后者已表示最终会停止其项目之后，Vercel 应该接手并维护 Deno。作者认为 Vercel 具备维护该项目所需的资源，并表示有兴趣参与这项工作。帖子还征询 Deno 在 Cloudflare 收购后的发展方向。

items.title_en: Qwen4-Max is now in Preview
items.title_zh: Qwen4-Max 现已开放预览
items.summary_en: Qwen4-Max is now available in preview through Alibaba's Token Plan. The Qwen4 line is positioned for deeper knowledge, richer world understanding, stronger coding, and agentic capabilities. It is aimed at tasks including complex coding, knowledge work, front-end development, and professional software workflows.
items.summary_zh: Qwen4-Max 现已通过阿里巴巴的 Token Plan 开放预览。Qwen4 系列主打更深入的知识理解、更丰富的世界理解能力，以及更强的编程和智能体能力。其目标任务包括复杂编程、知识工作、前端开发和专业软件流程。

items.title_en: A DrRacket style editor for Clojure with some Lisp Machine inspired features
items.title_zh: 一款具有 Lisp Machine 风格功能的 DrRacket 式 Clojure 编辑器
items.summary_en: Jonquil is a DrRacket-style editor for Jolt, Clojure, ClojureScript, jank, Basilisp, and babashka. It provides six dialect profiles, runs code in a REPL, and can stop runaway programs. Jolt can run in or out of process, while jank and ClojureScript are launched automatically and the other dialects attach over nREPL.
items.summary_zh: Jonquil 是一款面向 Jolt、Clojure、ClojureScript、jank、Basilisp 和 babashka 的 DrRacket 风格编辑器。它提供六种方言配置，可在 REPL 中运行代码并停止失控程序。Jolt 支持进程内或进程外运行，jank 和 ClojureScript 会自动启动，其他方言则通过 nREPL 连接。

items.title_en: Supply chain attack on Qubole customers
items.title_zh: 针对 Qubole 客户的供应链攻击
items.summary_en: The incident involved attackers using a trusted vendor’s keys to reach data at multiple companies. Sentra describes the event as a third-party compromise that created an access path into several organizations and says it uncovered the attack in less than 24 hours.
items.summary_zh: 这起事件中，攻击者利用受信任供应商的密钥访问多家公司数据。Sentra 将其描述为一次第三方供应商遭入侵，并称该事件为进入多个组织的攻击路径；公司在不到 24 小时内发现了这次攻击。

items.title_en: Claude Fable 5.2 launch offers
items.title_zh: Claude Fable 5.2 发布优惠
items.summary_en: To mark the launch of Claude Fable 5.2, eligible paid subscribers receive additional Fable usage for a limited time. Depending on the plan and subscription duration, users may receive one to three resets, or one week of included Fable usage plus one reset. The offers apply to selected Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, and legacy seat-based Enterprise plans, but exclude Free and several Enterprise plan types.
items.summary_zh: 为庆祝 Claude Fable 5.2 发布，符合条件的付费订阅者可在限时期间获得额外的 Fable 使用额度。根据套餐和订阅时长，用户可能获得一到三次重置，或一周的 Fable 使用权及一次重置。优惠适用于部分 Pro、Max、Ultra、Team 和旧版按席位计费的 Enterprise 套餐，但不适用于免费版及多种 Enterprise 套餐。

items.title_en: Testing Claude on real-world electronics design
items.title_zh: 在真实电子设计中测试 Claude
items.summary_en: Anthropic asked Claude to design a speakerphone, a voice-assistant hub, and a handheld virtual pet, and says all three prototypes worked without circuit fixes. The work involved circuit design and simulation, board layout, mechanical components, firmware, and manufacturing constraints. Anthropic says the newer models can now design and prototype electronic hardware from start to finish.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 让 Claude 设计免提电话、语音助手中枢和手持虚拟宠物，并称三个原型的电路都无需修改即可运行。这项工作涉及电路设计与仿真、电路板布局、机械部件、固件以及制造约束。Anthropic 表示，新模型现在能够从头到尾完成电子硬件的设计和原型制作。

items.title_en: Tool Built by Election Deniers Said These Voters Were Dead. We Found Them Alive
items.title_zh: 选举否认者制作的工具称这些选民已死亡，我们发现他们仍然活着
items.summary_en: After the midterm election, a Republican member of Georgia’s Forsyth County election board challenged dozens of ballots using data from a controversial election-integrity tool. The tool identified four voters as allegedly dead and was presented as evidence of wrongdoing. An investigation found that the voters identified by the tool were alive.
items.summary_zh: 美国中期选举后，佐治亚州福赛思县选举委员会的一名共和党成员使用一款有争议的选举诚信工具提供的数据，质疑数十张选票。该工具将四名选民标记为疑似已死亡，并被用作不当行为的证据。调查发现，这些被工具标记的选民实际上仍然在世。

items.title_en: The largest open-source DLE collection
items.title_zh: 最大的开源 DLE 收藏集
items.summary_en: The project is an open-source collection of assets for daily games. The available information provides no further details about the collection.
items.summary_zh: 该项目是一个面向每日游戏的开源资源收藏集。现有信息未提供该收藏集的更多细节。

items.title_en: Show HN: ThingStudio, Node-RED style programming for microcontrollers
items.title_zh: Show HN：ThingStudio，面向微控制器的 Node-RED 式编程
items.summary_en: ThingStudio is a local, Apache-2.0-licensed flow-programming environment for microcontrollers. Its drag-and-drop editor generates MicroPython and uploads it to the board, which can then run without the editor. Uploading currently requires an installation because WebSerial is not universally supported.
items.summary_zh: ThingStudio 是一个本地运行、采用 Apache 2.0 许可证的微控制器流程编程环境。它提供拖放式编辑器，生成 MicroPython 并上传到开发板，之后开发板无需编辑器即可运行。由于 WebSerial 尚未得到普遍支持，上传功能目前需要安装软件。

items.title_en: MacroHands: 3D hands and camera pose from egocentric video
items.title_zh: MacroHands：从第一视角视频估计三维手部与相机姿态
items.summary_en: MacroHands is a set of 3D hand-tracking and camera-pose models for egocentric video, available in mono and stereo variants. The authors evaluate them against the open-source baselines they tested. The project is motivated by the growing use of head-mounted cameras as a cheaper and more scalable source of robotics training data than robot teleoperation.
items.summary_zh: MacroHands 是一组用于第一视角视频的三维手部追踪和相机姿态模型，提供单目与双目版本。作者将其与测试过的开源基线进行了比较。该项目基于这样一种需求：与机器人远程操作相比，头戴式摄像头可以更低成本、更大规模地提供机器人训练数据。

items.title_en: iCloud Down
items.title_zh: iCloud 服务中断
items.summary_en: The item concerns the status of iCloud and other Apple services. The available status page description covers planned and unplanned service events but does not specify the cause, scope, or duration of an outage.
items.summary_zh: 该条目涉及 iCloud 和其他 Apple 服务的状态。现有状态页说明涵盖计划内和非计划服务事件，但未说明此次中断的原因、范围或持续时间。

items.title_en: Someone registered horny.ceo this week, and we all know why
items.title_zh: 有人本周注册了 horny.ceo，我们都知道原因
items.summary_en: Horny CEO is a parody AI companion for leaders who want to avoid appearing in headlines. It markets “enterprise-grade fantasies” with zero corporate scandals and claims to leave users focused on their share price.
items.summary_zh: Horny CEO 是一款面向不想登上头条的企业领导者的讽刺性 AI 伴侣。它以“企业级幻想”和零企业丑闻为卖点，并称能让用户专注于股价。

items.title_en: Possible 19th-century castaway camp found on Isla de los Estados
items.title_zh: 伊斯拉·德洛斯埃斯塔多斯岛或发现 19 世纪漂流者营地
items.summary_en: Archaeologists have uncovered the remains of a possible 19th-century castaway camp on the remote Isla de los Estados. The camp may have belonged to a renowned Argentine sailor and his shipwrecked crew.
items.summary_zh: 考古学家在偏远的伊斯拉·德洛斯埃斯塔多斯岛发现了一处可能属于 19 世纪漂流者的营地遗迹。该营地或许曾属于一名著名的阿根廷水手及其遭遇海难的船员。

items.title_en: Beyond the compiler: Making IBM i run modified native code
items.title_zh: 超越编译器：让 IBM i 运行经过修改的原生代码
items.summary_en: IBM i does not treat application programs as ordinary files containing POWER instructions. Compilers produce Machine Interface code, which IBM i translates into native code containing checks for its object and tagged-pointer model.
items.summary_zh: IBM i 不会把应用程序当作包含 POWER 指令的普通文件处理。编译器生成 Machine Interface 代码，IBM i 再将其转换为包含对象模型和带标签指针模型检查的原生代码。文章研究了修改这些原生指令如何使系统执行原始 MI 输入中不存在的行为，并重点讨论 IBM i 7.5 的 Program Validation Value。

items.title_en: Nvidia is reportedly preparing to fire Jensen Huang
items.title_zh: 据报道英伟达正准备解雇 Jensen Huang
items.summary_en: Nvidia’s board was reportedly preparing to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang after reports of a second alleged affair with an executive who reports to him. The executive was identified as Nvidia vice president of health care Kimberly Powell. The report followed Huang’s admission of a separate affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，英伟达董事会正准备解雇 CEO Jensen Huang，此前有报道称他与一名向他汇报的高管存在第二段婚外情。报道指该高管是英伟达医疗保健部门副总裁 Kimberly Powell。此前，Huang 刚承认与一名被指为中国间谍的女性有过另一段婚外情。

items.title_en: Making the Iron Giant Live
items.title_zh: 让《钢铁巨人》动起来
items.summary_en: Making the Iron Giant Live concerns bringing The Iron Giant to life. No further reliable details are available.
items.summary_zh: 《让钢铁巨人动起来》围绕让《钢铁巨人》“活起来”展开。现有信息没有提供更多可靠细节。

items.title_en: The Surprising Effectiveness of Deleting Weights in LLM Post-Training
items.title_zh: 在 LLM 后训练中删除权重的惊人效果
items.summary_en: The researchers found that zeroing fewer than 0.05% of a pretrained LLM's weights can match full fine-tuning across reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, supervised fine-tuning, and on-policy distillation. Their Deletion Tuning method learns a binary mask over transformer gate projections, producing a checkpoint hundreds to thousands of times smaller than a full fine-tuning checkpoint. It also preserves prior-task accuracy better than full fine-tuning, LoRA, and random sparse fine-tuning in the reported reinforcement-learning experiments.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员发现，将预训练大语言模型中少于 0.05% 的权重归零，在带可验证奖励的强化学习、监督微调和在线蒸馏三种后训练设置下，都能达到全量微调的效果。他们提出的 Deletion Tuning 会为 Transformer 模块的门控投影学习二值掩码，生成的检查点比全量微调检查点小数百至数千倍。在报告的强化学习实验中，该方法对原有任务准确率的保持也优于全量微调、LoRA 和随机稀疏微调。

items.title_en: Magic: The Gathering is getting a Netflix series
items.title_zh: 《万智牌》将推出 Netflix 剧集
items.summary_en: The animated series Magic: The Gathering: Planeswalker is scheduled to debut on Netflix in 2027. The project was first teased in 2019 with Joe and Anthony Russo attached, but that version fell apart. Netflix later announced in 2024 that it would rework the series from the ground up.
items.summary_zh: 动画剧集《万智牌：Planeswalker》计划于 2027 年在 Netflix 首播。该项目最早于 2019 年公布，当时由乔·罗素和安东尼·罗素参与，但那一版本后来搁置。Netflix 于 2024 年宣布将从头重新制作这部剧集。

items.title_en: Hands-on fabrication of 2D material field-effect transistors for the classroom
items.title_zh: 面向课堂的二维材料场效应晶体管动手制作
items.summary_en: The project describes classroom fabrication of field-effect transistors made from two-dimensional materials. It uses commercially available ionic gel and is presented as a physics education activity. The listed authors include Sozen, Kutlu, Riquelme, and Castellanos-Gomez.
items.summary_zh: 该项目介绍了在课堂上制作二维材料场效应晶体管的方法。实验使用市售离子凝胶，并被定位为一项物理教学活动。列出的作者包括 Sozen、Kutlu、Riquelme 和 Castellanos-Gomez。

items.title_en: Go Turns 17
items.title_zh: Go 迎来 17 周年
items.summary_en: Go celebrated the 17th anniversary of its open-source release on November 10, 2026. The anniversary was marked by the Go team. The milestone records 17 years since the language became open source.
items.summary_zh: Go 于 2026 年 11 月 10 日迎来开源发布 17 周年。Go 团队对这一纪念日进行了庆祝。这一里程碑标志着该语言开源至今已有 17 年。

items.title_en: Show HN: TheoremSmith: Mass-Producing Hard Proof Problems to Train LLMs
items.title_zh: Show HN：TheoremSmith——批量生成训练 LLM 的高难证明题
items.summary_en: TheoremSmith is a pipeline for generating synthetic formal-verification environments for training models. It is designed to create multi-hour, frontier-difficulty tasks at scalable throughput, with proofs verified by formal checkers. The project seeks feedback on possible verifier exploits and whether synthetic tasks can improve performance on real proofs.
items.summary_zh: TheoremSmith 是一个用于生成合成形式化验证环境的流水线，旨在训练模型。它可以大规模生成需要数小时解决、难度接近前沿的任务，并由形式化检查器验证证明。项目希望获得关于模型可能如何欺骗验证器，以及合成任务能否提升真实证明能力的反馈。

items.title_en: Show HN: WolveKafka – Consume Kafka with a plain HTTP endpoint
items.title_zh: Show HN：WolveKafka——通过纯 HTTP 接口消费 Kafka
items.summary_en: WolveKafka lets applications consume Kafka through an HTTP handler in any programming language. It manages consumer groups, batching, retries, offsets, and dead-letter queues. The project includes a quickstart, examples, deployment guidance, and comparison material.
items.summary_zh: WolveKafka 允许应用使用任意编程语言，通过 HTTP 处理器消费 Kafka。它负责管理消费者组、批处理、重试、偏移量和死信队列。项目还提供快速入门、示例、部署指南和对比资料。

items.title_en: Israel kidnapped Iranian generals, killed one, in effort to locate Ron Arad
items.title_zh: 以色列绑架伊朗将军、杀死一人，试图寻找 Ron Arad
items.summary_en: Israeli officials believed Tehran was responsible for the disappearance of airman Ron Arad, who has been missing since 1986. A report says Israel kidnapped Iranian generals and killed one person as part of an effort to locate him. Alternative theories about his disappearance had previously received little attention.
items.summary_zh: 以色列官员认定德黑兰应对飞行员 Ron Arad 的失踪负责；他自 1986 年起下落不明。据报道，以色列曾绑架伊朗将军并杀死一人，作为寻找他的行动的一部分。此前，有关其失踪原因的其他理论很少受到关注。

items.title_en: FIRE says US to end efforts to curb App,s FB groups reporting on ICE activity
items.title_zh: FIRE 称美国将停止限制应用和 Facebook 群组报告 ICE 活动的努力
items.summary_en: FIRE says the United States will end efforts to curb apps and Facebook groups that report Immigration and Customs Enforcement activity. The available information does not provide further details about the decision or its timing.
items.summary_zh: FIRE 称，美国将停止限制应用和 Facebook 群组报告移民与海关执法局活动的努力。现有信息未提供这一决定的更多细节或时间安排。

items.title_en: Agda v2.9.0
items.title_zh: Agda v2.9.0
items.summary_en: Agda 2.9.0 adds an experimental `-j` option for type-checking modules in parallel in batch mode. The release also includes substantial performance improvements and drops support for GHC 8.8, 8.10, and 9.0. Agda is a dependently typed programming language and interactive theorem prover.
items.summary_zh: Agda 2.9.0 在批处理模式下新增实验性的 `-j` 选项，可并行进行模块类型检查。该版本还带来了显著的性能改进，并停止支持 GHC 8.8、8.10 和 9.0。Agda 是一种依赖类型编程语言和交互式定理证明器。

items.title_en: M4 Pro vs. M5 Pro (24GB): Qwen 3.8 Flash Next at 374 Tok/S Prefill with MoEShift
items.title_zh: M4 Pro 对比 M5 Pro（24GB）：Qwen 3.8 Flash Next 使用 MoEShift 达到 374 Tok/s 预填充速度
items.summary_en: MoEShift is an Apple Silicon inference engine for memory-efficient, high-performance mixture-of-experts models. On a Mac mini with an M4 Pro and 24 GB of unified memory, it runs the 125-billion-parameter Qwen 3.8 Flash Next using under 10 GB of peak process memory. The project reports roughly half the peak memory usage of Strata and 2.6× faster long-prompt processing.
items.summary_zh: MoEShift 是一款面向 Apple Silicon 的高性能、节省内存的混合专家模型推理引擎。在配备 M4 Pro 和 24GB 统一内存的 Mac mini 上，它运行 1250 亿参数的 Qwen 3.8 Flash Next 时，进程峰值内存低于 10GB。项目称，与 Strata 相比，它的峰值内存占用约少一半，长提示处理速度快 2.6 倍。

items.title_en: Show HN: DRS-VPT. Localize a photo in a 3D point cloud without an initial pose
items.title_zh: Show HN：DRS-VPT——无需初始位姿，在三维点云中定位照片
items.summary_en: DRS-VPT estimates a camera’s six-degree-of-freedom pose from a single photo and a 3D point cloud without an initial pose or known camera intrinsics. The same model works across driving LiDAR scans, indoor iPhone photos, and structure-from-motion maps. The authors provide the code, model, weights, and an online demo.
items.summary_zh: DRS-VPT 可以根据一张照片和一个三维点云估计相机的六自由度位姿，无需初始位姿或已知相机内参。同一个模型可用于驾驶场景的 LiDAR 扫描、室内 iPhone 照片和运动恢复结构地图。作者提供了代码、模型、权重以及在线演示。

items.title_en: Roadside investigations of psyllids, ants and eucs
items.title_zh: 路边调查：木虱、蚂蚁与桉树
items.summary_en: While driving along a country highway, the writer noticed that young River Red Gums appeared to be dead or dying. These young trees, called “recruits,” were seedlings, saplings, and immature trees that had self-seeded around older parent trees. The post uses the observation as the starting point for a roadside botanical investigation.
items.summary_zh: 作者在乡间公路驾车时注意到，年轻的河红桉似乎已经死亡或正在枯死。这些被称为“更新个体”的树木，是在成年母树周围自然播种形成的幼苗、树苗和未成熟树木。文章以这一观察为起点，展开了一次路边植物调查。

items.title_en: ExecuTorch WebGPU: PyTorch Models on the GPU, in the Browser
items.title_zh: ExecuTorch WebGPU：在浏览器中通过 GPU 运行 PyTorch 模型
items.summary_en: ExecuTorch now runs PyTorch models on browser GPUs through WebGPU without converting them to another framework’s format. Models are exported with torch.export to an ExecuTorch .pte file and can run on WebGPU-enabled desktop, laptop, and mobile browsers. Browser inference keeps prompts, inputs, and outputs on the device, while also enabling offline use and reducing server-side inference costs.
items.summary_zh: ExecuTorch 现在可以通过 WebGPU 在浏览器 GPU 上运行 PyTorch 模型，无需转换为其他框架的格式。模型通过 torch.export 导出为 ExecuTorch 的 .pte 文件，可在支持 WebGPU 的桌面、笔记本和移动浏览器中运行。浏览器端推理可将提示词、输入和输出保留在设备上，同时支持离线使用并降低服务器端推理成本。

items.title_en: How to make a CNC plasma cutter with high-frequency start
items.title_zh: 如何制作带高频启动的 CNC 等离子切割机
items.summary_en: High-frequency ignition on plasma cutters creates substantial electromagnetic interference when it starts the pilot arc. This interference can disconnect a nearby CNC motion controller’s USB connection. The project addresses the problem by communicating with the motion controller over Wi-Fi.
items.summary_zh: 等离子切割机使用高频启动点燃引导弧时，会产生很强的电磁干扰。这种干扰可能导致附近 CNC 运动控制器的 USB 连接断开。该项目通过 Wi-Fi 与运动控制器通信来解决这一问题。

items.title_en: Show HN: Shotoku – Local-first action governance and budget caps for AI agents
items.title_zh: Show HN：Shotoku——面向 AI 智能体的本地优先行动治理与预算上限
items.summary_en: Shotoku gives AI agents spending limits, human approvals, and a tamper-evident audit trail enforced locally before a payment occurs. It requires no cloud service or custody of funds, and is designed to make every autonomous action pass through a decision process.
items.summary_zh: Shotoku 为 AI 智能体提供支出上限、人工审批和防篡改审计记录，并在付款发生前完全由本地系统执行。它不需要云服务，也不托管资金，旨在让每个自主操作都经过决策流程。

items.title_en: Air-Traffic Resilience Portfolio
items.title_zh: 空中交通韧性投资组合
items.summary_en: This thematic research portfolio focuses on air-traffic resilience through government IT integration, cybersecurity, operational software, and secure network services. It ranks and sizes up to 30 companies by thematic relevance, while explicitly making no assumptions about cyberattack attribution, new spending, or additional contract wins. It is a provider-oriented research proxy rather than an FAA-verified portfolio.
items.summary_zh: 这一主题投资组合通过政府 IT 集成、网络安全、运营软件和安全网络服务，聚焦空中交通韧性。它按主题相关性对最多 30 家公司进行排名和配置，同时明确不假设存在网络攻击归因、新增支出或额外合同。该组合是面向供应商的研究代理，并非经 FAA 验证的投资组合。

items.title_en: Shellport: An SSH terminal, file browser and live server dashboard
items.title_zh: Shellport：SSH 终端、文件浏览器与实时服务器仪表盘
items.summary_en: Shellport is an upcoming iPhone app that combines an SSH terminal, SFTP and FTP file browser, live server and stack dashboards, and a database client. It supports SSH or Mosh sessions in tabs, with Mosh preserving sessions across network changes. The app requires neither an installed agent nor an account.
items.summary_zh: Shellport 是一款即将推出的 iPhone 应用，将 SSH 终端、SFTP/FTP 文件浏览器、实时服务器和技术栈仪表盘，以及数据库客户端整合在一起。它支持以标签页运行 SSH 或 Mosh 会话，Mosh 可在网络切换时保持会话。该应用无需安装代理，也不要求注册账户。

items.title_en: We Need More Goat Sacrifices
items.title_zh: 我们需要更多山羊祭祀
items.summary_en: The piece connects ideas about luck and magic with the way people notice opportunities in their environment. It references studies suggesting that people who consider themselves lucky may be more attentive to opportunities, while noting that the author is not a scientist and is uncertain about the original mathematics. It also says that medieval magic practitioners viewed magic as working through this kind of perception rather than through physics.
items.summary_zh: 文章将关于运气和魔法的观点，与人们发现周围机会的方式联系起来。文章提到，有些研究认为自认为幸运的人可能更容易注意到机会，同时也承认作者不是科学家，并不确定原始研究的数学依据。文章还指出，中世纪的魔法实践者认为魔法正是通过这种感知方式发挥作用，而不是通过物理机制。

items.title_en: Librem 5 v2: A phone that frees us all
items.title_zh: Librem 5 v2：一部让我们获得自由的手机
items.summary_en: Purism is crowdfunding the Librem 5 v2 smartphone. The project emphasizes privacy, security, and user control, while rejecting corporate surveillance, app-level tracking, and monitoring of users’ digital lives. Its stated goal is to give users greater freedom in choosing how the phone is used.
items.summary_zh: Purism 正在为 Librem 5 v2 手机发起众筹。该项目强调隐私、安全和用户控制，反对企业监视、应用开发者追踪以及对用户数字生活的监控。其目标是让用户更自由地决定手机的使用方式。

items.title_en: Show HN: Cerulion – ROS 2-compatible robotics runtime with multi-process replay
items.title_zh: Show HN：Cerulion——支持 ROS 2、带多进程回放的机器人运行时
items.summary_en: Cerulion is a ROS 2-compatible robotics runtime written in Rust. It aims to reduce inter-process communication latency without requiring a single process or restricting messages to plain-old-data types. Its multi-process graphs can be deterministically resimulated, and existing ROS 2 nodes and launch files can run alongside native Cerulion Rust or Python code.
items.summary_zh: Cerulion 是一个用 Rust 编写、兼容 ROS 2 的机器人运行时。它旨在降低进程间通信延迟，同时不要求将程序合并为单进程，也不限制消息必须使用普通数据类型。其多进程图可以进行确定性重演，现有 ROS 2 节点和 launch 文件也能与原生 Cerulion Rust 或 Python 代码并行运行。

items.title_en: Announcement: Conductor Is Back
items.title_zh: 公告：Conductor 回来了
items.summary_en: The Conductor team has decided to continue developing the project. It says regular updates will resume the following week. The announcement reverses an earlier suggestion that development had ended.
items.summary_zh: Conductor 团队决定继续开发该项目。团队表示，定期更新将在下周恢复。这一公告推翻了此前项目已经停止开发的说法。

items.title_en: What It Costs to Run 4 Apps on My Own Servers
items.title_zh: 在自己的服务器上运行 4 个应用的成本
items.summary_en: The author runs four production applications, each with its own PostgreSQL database, workers, scheduled jobs, and backups, for about $45 per month. Hydrafetch, DataHyena, CatchIntent, and Eternal Vault all run on a single self-managed server. The post breaks down the bill, the gaps in that budget, and the problems encountered along the way.
items.summary_zh: 作者在一台自行搭建的服务器上运行四个生产应用，每个应用都有自己的 PostgreSQL 数据库、后台工作进程、定时任务和备份，总成本约为每月 45 美元。这四个产品是 Hydrafetch、DataHyena、CatchIntent 和 Eternal Vault。文章详细拆解了费用、这笔预算无法覆盖的部分，以及过程中遇到的问题。

items.title_en: Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron Fail to Get DRAM Antitrust Suit Dismissed
items.title_zh: 三星、SK 海力士和美光未能驳回 DRAM 反垄断诉讼
items.summary_en: A class-action lawsuit accusing Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron of restricting DRAM supply will proceed. On November 14, a U.S. District Court judge denied the three companies’ joint motion to dismiss. The court found that the complaint plausibly alleged the companies had restricted supply.
items.summary_zh: 一项指控三星、SK 海力士和美光限制 DRAM 供应的集体诉讼将继续进行。11 月 14 日，美国地区法院法官驳回了三家公司联合提出的撤诉申请。法院认为，原告关于三家公司限制供应的指控具有合理依据。

items.title_en: The Denny's where Nvidia was born has removed the sign honoring the company
items.title_zh: 英伟达诞生地的 Denny's 移除了纪念该公司的标牌
items.summary_en: A Denny’s diner in Santa Clara where Nvidia’s early history began has removed a sign honoring the company. The missing sign was noticed inside the roadside restaurant on Thursday. The change comes as references to Jensen Huang’s downfall are reportedly appearing at both the diner and Nvidia’s headquarters.
items.summary_zh: 位于圣克拉拉、见证英伟达早期历史的一家 Denny's 餐厅移除了纪念该公司的标牌。周四，人们注意到这家路边餐厅内部原本的标牌已经不见。报道称，随着有关黄仁勋失势的迹象出现，公司总部和这家餐厅都开始发生相关变化。

items.title_en: Magnets and Rare Earths
items.title_zh: 磁铁与稀土
items.summary_en: This seven-step educational guide explains why joint motors need magnets, what those magnets are made of, and which companies manufacture most of them. It covers topics from the strongest magnets to current export controls, with a short quiz accompanying each step.
items.summary_zh: 这份七步教程解释关节电机为何需要磁铁、磁铁由什么制成，以及哪些企业生产了其中的大部分产品。内容从“最强磁铁”讲到当今的出口管制，每一步都配有简短测验。

items.title_en: Little Red Dots Are Direct-Collapse Black Hole–Forming Galaxies
items.title_zh: 小红点是由直接坍缩黑洞形成的星系
items.summary_en: The paper is titled "Little Red Dots are Direct-collapse Black Hole–forming Galaxies." It lists Daniel J. Whalen, Muhammad A. Latif, Konstantinos Topalakis, Fergus Cullen, Devesh Nandal, and Sadegh Khochfar as authors. The available excerpt provides no further details about the observations or proposed formation process.
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文题为《小红点是由直接坍缩黑洞形成的星系》。作者包括 Daniel J. Whalen、Muhammad A. Latif、Konstantinos Topalakis、Fergus Cullen、Devesh Nandal 和 Sadegh Khochfar。现有摘录未提供有关观测结果或形成过程的更多细节。

items.title_en: DefCon: Breaking into Amazon Lockers by Any Means Necessary
items.title_zh: DefCon：用各种手段攻入亚马逊储物柜
items.summary_en: A DefCon presentation covers breaking into Amazon lockers by various means.
items.summary_zh: 一场 DefCon 演讲介绍了如何用各种手段攻入亚马逊储物柜。

items.title_en: Please Just Text Me – reply to voice message with a typing video
items.title_zh: 请直接发短信——用打字视频回复语音消息
items.summary_en: This service turns a typed reply into a video showing hands slowly typing it on a phone. It is designed as an intentionally inconvenient response to voice messages, which recipients cannot easily skim or read silently. The service is free and requires no installation.
items.summary_zh: 这项服务会把用户输入的回复转换成一段视频，显示双手在手机上慢慢打出文字。它旨在以一种刻意不便的方式回应语音消息，因为接收者通常无法快速浏览或在安静环境中阅读语音内容。该服务免费且无需安装。

items.title_en: Show HN: Light control for MacBook charger status light (open-source)
items.title_zh: Show HN：开源控制 MacBook 充电器状态灯
items.summary_en: This open-source project lets users control the status light on a MacBook charger. It supports turning the light on or off automatically based on time or Focus status, as well as keeping it persistently on or off. The project invites feature suggestions through GitHub.
items.summary_zh: 这个开源项目可以控制 MacBook 充电器的状态灯。它支持根据时间或专注模式状态自动开关灯，也可以让灯持续亮起或关闭。项目通过 GitHub 征集功能建议。

items.title_en: Why is there anything at all?
items.title_zh: 为什么会有任何东西存在？
items.summary_en: “Why is there anything at all?” is a question about the reason for basic existence, discussed by philosophers and physicists including Leibniz, Wittgenstein, and Heidegger. It is often called a fundamental question of metaphysics. The excerpt notes that no experiment could support the hypothesis of absolute nothingness, because any observation implies an observer exists.
items.summary_zh: “为什么会有任何东西存在？”这一问题探讨基本存在的原因，莱布尼茨、维特根斯坦和海德格尔等哲学家与物理学家都曾讨论过它。它通常被称为形而上学的根本问题。摘录指出，任何实验都无法支持“绝对虚无”这一假说，因为任何观察都意味着存在观察者。

items.title_en: Reddit Reviews
items.title_zh: Reddit Reviews
items.summary_en: Reddit has begun testing Reddit Reviews, an experience that organizes product conversations from its communities into dedicated reviews. It highlights important takeaways so shoppers can more easily understand how a product performs in real life. The feature builds on Reddit's product discussions and recommendations as a source of user experience.
items.summary_zh: Reddit 开始测试 Reddit Reviews，将社区中的产品讨论整理成专门的评测内容。该功能会突出重要结论，帮助购物者更容易了解产品在现实使用中的表现。它建立在 Reddit 社区积累的产品讨论和推荐之上。

items.title_en: Jiff – A datetime library for Rust – reaches 1.0
items.title_zh: Rust 日期时间库 Jiff 达到 1.0
items.summary_en: Jiff is a Rust datetime library that puts time-zone handling at the center of its API. It automatically addresses many common daylight-saving-time problems and has already seen broad adoption in the Rust ecosystem. Its 1.0 release marks its stable milestone.
items.summary_zh: Jiff 是一个将时区处理置于 API 核心位置的 Rust 日期时间库。它会自动处理许多与夏令时相关的常见问题，并已在 Rust 生态中得到广泛采用。此次 1.0 发布标志着它达到了稳定版本里程碑。

items.title_en: Does until it doesn't and doesn't until it does
items.title_zh: 直到不再如此，以及不再如此直到再次如此
items.summary_en: The essay examines how intense hype around new technologies can shape people’s beliefs. It argues that such beliefs may resemble ideas associated with new religions or cults.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了对新技术的强烈炒作如何塑造人们的信念。文章认为，这类信念可能类似于新宗教或邪教所形成的观念。

items.title_en: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
items.summary_en: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 is a text-generation model with 1.7 trillion parameters. The model files are available to download and explore through Hugging Face.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 是一款拥有 1.7 万亿参数的文本生成模型。其模型文件可通过 Hugging Face 下载和探索。

items.title_en: I asked Claude Fable 5.2 to turn my site into a 90s Silicon Graphics workstation
items.title_zh: 我让 Claude Fable 5.2 把我的网站变成 90 年代的 Silicon Graphics 工作站
items.summary_en: The project recreates a 1993 Silicon Graphics workstation as an interactive web experience. Visitors can log into an emulated IRIX environment, navigate a 3D file system, and play the game Soft Break. The page requires WebGL to run in the browser.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目将一台 1993 年的 Silicon Graphics 工作站重现为可交互的网页体验。访客可以登录模拟的 IRIX 环境，在三维文件系统中浏览，并游玩 Soft Break。该页面需要浏览器支持 WebGL 才能运行。

items.title_en: Fortune Telling and Speculative Design
items.title_zh: 占卜与推测性设计
items.summary_en: The piece presents practical tools for using speculative design to explore possible futures. The author describes collecting weak signals, developing theories about where software is heading, and building artifacts that make those theories tangible. The approach is framed as especially useful for design engineers who imagine and prototype new software ideas.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章介绍了利用推测性设计探索可能未来的实用工具。作者描述了收集微弱信号、构建关于软件发展方向的理论，以及制作让这些理论变得具体的实物或原型。文章认为，这种方法尤其适合构想并原型化新软件想法的设计工程师。

items.title_en: History of Password Cracking
items.title_zh: 密码破解史
items.summary_en: History of Password Cracking presents a timeline of password cracking, with material leading up to 1979. It also clarifies that cracking a hashed password is not decryption, because no key can reverse a hash into the original password. The post expands on an appendix from a book.
items.summary_zh: 《密码破解史》整理了一条密码破解时间线，并补充了截至 1979 年之前的背景内容。文章还澄清，破解哈希密码并不是解密，因为不存在能够将哈希值还原为原始密码的密钥。该文章扩展自一本书中的附录。

items.title_en: 'It's like the Wild West': how AI has rocked the literary world
items.title_zh: “像狂野西部”：AI 如何撼动文学界
items.summary_en: Accusations of AI use are disrupting publishing, with authors losing lucrative deals and writers being removed from prize shortlists. Romance novelist Coral Hart says she has written 370 novels under 21 pen names using AI since 2025, earning a high six-figure income. Kindle Unlimited’s algorithm rewards prolific output, encouraging writers to publish at least one book a month.
items.summary_zh: 有关使用 AI 的指控正在扰乱出版业，一些作者失去高收入合同，作家也被从文学奖入围名单中撤下。言情小说家 Coral Hart 表示，自 2025 年以来，她使用 AI 以 21 个笔名创作了 370 部小说，收入达到六位数高位。Kindle Unlimited 的算法奖励高产作者，促使作家至少每月出版一本书。

items.title_en: How I Remember the Byrds
items.title_zh: 我如何记得 Byrds 乐队
items.summary_en: This personal essay examines how memories can become false. The author realized this while trying to remember how he bought the first four Byrds albums, after watching videos about the band and recalling a 1968 conversation about preferring the Byrds to the Beatles.
items.summary_zh: 这篇个人随笔探讨记忆如何变成虚假的记忆。作者在试图回忆自己如何买到 Byrds 乐队前四张专辑时意识到这一点；此前，他看了一些关于该乐队的视频，并想起自己曾在 1968 年说过更喜欢 Byrds 而不是披头士。

items.title_en: Moonshine is dead, long live Moonshine
items.title_zh: Moonshine 已死，Moonshine 万岁
items.summary_en: The author shut down the startup Moonshine after four years and $12 million in investment failed to produce enough revenue or growth, and no compelling acquisition emerged. The company entered liquidation with little recovery for investors, while the cofounder joined OpenAI. The author personally acquired Moonshine’s intellectual property, data, and code to continue the open-source work.
items.summary_zh: 作者在 Moonshine 创业四年、获得 1,200 万美元投资后关闭了公司，因为收入和增长仍不足以维持运营，也没能找到合适的收购方案。公司随后进入清算程序，投资者几乎没有收回资金，而联合创始人加入了 OpenAI。作者个人购得 Moonshine 的知识产权、数据和代码，以继续其开源工作。

items.title_en: Show HN: NETWAR – hacker MMO with 15-second card duels on a shared hex map
items.title_zh: Show HN：NETWAR——共享六边形地图上的黑客 MMO 与 15 秒卡牌对决
items.summary_en: NETWAR is a hacker-themed MMO built around 15-second card duels on a shared hexagonal map. The game interface lets players zoom to a sector grid, select empty land, and name a core. New frontier deployments start near active operators, with shields covering the first 48 hours.
items.summary_zh: NETWAR 是一款以共享六边形地图和 15 秒卡牌对决为核心的黑客主题 MMO。游戏界面允许玩家缩放至区域网格、选择空地并为核心命名。新的前线部署会出现在活跃运营者附近，并在最初 48 小时受到护盾保护。

items.title_en: End‑to‑End 4‑Bit Training
items.title_zh: 端到端 4 位训练
items.summary_en: The work examines training large language models with 4-bit numerical representations. Lower precision reduces memory use and can speed up GPU calculations, but it also increases rounding errors that accumulate during training and can hurt accuracy. The proposed focus is end-to-end 4-bit training rather than applying low precision only after training.
items.summary_zh: 这项工作研究使用 4 位数值表示训练大型语言模型。较低精度可以减少内存占用并加快 GPU 计算，但也会增加舍入误差；这些误差在训练中累积后可能损害准确率。其重点是端到端采用 4 位训练，而不是只在训练结束后应用低精度。

items.title_en: Movistar Blocks Its Own Support Forum Under LaLiga Anti-Piracy Order
items.title_zh: 西班牙反盗版禁令下，Movistar 屏蔽了自己的支持论坛
items.summary_en: Spain's court-ordered piracy-blocking system blocked Movistar's official customer-support forum on a Saturday night. Internet providers must block hundreds of IP addresses linked to pirate football streams during every LaLiga match weekend. The regime comes from a December 2024 court order obtained by LaLiga and Telefónica Audiovisual Digital, and applies even to Telefónica's own network.
items.summary_zh: 西班牙法院下令实施的盗版屏蔽机制在一个周六晚间屏蔽了 Movistar 的官方客户支持论坛。每逢西甲比赛周末，互联网服务商都必须屏蔽数百个与盗播足球相关的 IP 地址。该机制源自 LaLiga 和 Telefónica Audiovisual Digital 于 2024 年 12 月取得的法院命令，甚至适用于 Telefónica 自己的网络。

items.title_en: Show HN: Skillset: Easily curate and install agent skills collection
items.title_zh: Show HN：Skillset，轻松整理并安装代理技能集合
items.summary_en: Skillset groups programming, backend, and other agent skills into collections that can be installed with one command from a JSON file. It wraps the Vercel Skill CLI and uses it as the underlying library, aiming to preserve compatibility with the standard CLI across teams. The project is designed to avoid installing unnecessary skills globally and consuming excess context.
items.summary_zh: Skillset 将编程、后端等代理技能整理成集合，用户可以通过一个 JSON 文件和一条命令安装所需集合。它封装并直接使用 Vercel Skill CLI，旨在保持与标准 CLI 的团队间兼容性。该项目希望避免全局安装不必要的技能并消耗过多上下文。

items.title_en: Show HN: Minea – a Mac assistant that never steals your cursor (36-min raw run)
items.title_zh: Show HN：Minea——不会抢鼠标的 Mac 助手（36 分钟原始运行视频）
items.summary_en: MINEA monitors a user’s screen and mail, then proactively drafts messages, compares prices, and handles reversible tasks before stopping at actions such as sending or paying. It supports macOS 11 and later and offers 30 free runs without requiring a card. The assistant can also monitor an iPhone and Apple Watch and call the user when spoken input is needed.
items.summary_zh: MINEA 会监控用户的屏幕和邮件，主动起草内容、比较价格并处理可撤销的任务，然后在发送或付款前停下。它支持 macOS 11 及更高版本，提供 30 次免费运行且无需绑定银行卡。该助手还可以监控 iPhone 和 Apple Watch，并在需要用户口头处理时打电话通知。

items.title_en: SuperMimic
items.title_zh: SuperMimic
items.summary_en: SuperMimic trains a humanoid whole-body motion tracker using a single differentiable world model. The project reports surpassing SONIC’s return after three hours of training on one GPU, compared with seven days on 128 GPUs for SONIC.
items.summary_zh: SuperMimic 使用一个可微分世界模型训练人形全身动作跟踪器。项目称，它在单块 GPU 上训练三小时后，就超过了 SONIC 的回报表现，而 SONIC 使用了 128 块 GPU、训练七天。

items.title_en: FAA lifts ground stop at U.S. airports
items.title_zh: FAA 解除美国机场地面停飞令
items.summary_en: The FAA lifted the ground stop affecting U.S. airports. No further details about the timing, cause, or operational recovery are provided.
items.summary_zh: FAA 解除了影响美国机场的地面停飞令。现有信息未提供解除时间、原因或运行恢复情况的更多细节。

items.title_en: 37% on ARC-AGI-2 Kaggle Without LLMs
items.title_zh: 不使用 LLM，在 ARC-AGI-2 Kaggle 上取得 37%
items.summary_en: A 100-million-parameter looped transformer trained from scratch achieved a 37% score on the ARC-AGI-2 Kaggle competition without using an LLM. The author says the system reached sixth place and surpassed the previous year’s winning LLM. Adding looping improved the score from 33% to 35% and then 37%.
items.summary_zh: 一个从头训练、拥有 1 亿参数并采用循环结构的 Transformer，在不使用 LLM 的情况下于 ARC-AGI-2 Kaggle 比赛中取得了 37% 的分数。作者称，该系统一度排名第六，并超过了上一年度获胜的 LLM。加入循环机制后，分数从 33% 提升到 35%，再提升到 37%。

items.title_en: Skydio's asymmetrical F10 Lightrunner solves a problem with fixed-wing drones
items.title_zh: Skydio 不对称 F10 Lightrunner 解决固定翼无人机难题
items.summary_en: Skydio’s F10 Lightrunner uses an asymmetrical design and a wingtip-mounted camera to improve aerial vision and reduce blind spots. The autonomously operated, high-speed fixed-wing drone is designed to provide higher-quality video than other fixed-wing drones.

items.title_en: The efficient frontier of LLM inference
items.title_zh: LLM 推理的效率前沿
items.summary_en: The article maps inference techniques including batch sizing, parallelism, quantization, optimized kernels, speculative decoding, and disaggregation. Some techniques move a deployment along the latency-throughput frontier, while others expand the frontier and create more efficiency to allocate. The discussion uses “efficient frontier” to describe tradeoffs among model cost, capability, latency, and throughput.
items.summary_zh: 文章梳理了批大小、并行化、量化、优化内核、推测解码和解耦部署等推理技术。有些技术是在延迟—吞吐量前沿上移动部署方案，另一些则会扩大整个前沿，为分配带来更多效率。文章用“效率前沿”描述模型成本、能力、延迟和吞吐量之间的权衡。

items.title_en: Show HN: Rbit – Self Hosted Git Forge in Rust
items.title_zh: Show HN：Rbit——使用 Rust 构建的自托管 Git 托管平台
items.summary_en: Rbit is a self-hosted Git forge built around speed, security, and efficiency. Its stack includes Rust, Axum, Askama, Gitoxide, SQLite, redb, HTMX, and Tailwind, and the project uses its own CI/CD pipeline for dogfooding. It has been localized into nine languages, including Simplified Chinese.

items.title_en: Do We Still Have to Denormalize? Have Your Schema and Search It Too
items.title_zh: 我们还需要反规范化吗？让数据库模式与搜索兼得
items.summary_en: ParadeDB describes ways to accelerate search and aggregate joins across normalized PostgreSQL schemas. The approach combines DataFusion, Rank Joins, co-partitioning, and tuple tagging. The challenge is that search across related tables such as users, posts, and comments is harder to optimize than search over one denormalized table.
items.summary_zh: ParadeDB 介绍了如何加速规范化 PostgreSQL 模式上的搜索和聚合连接。其方法结合了 DataFusion、Rank Joins、共同分区和元组标记。难点在于，跨 users、posts 和 comments 等关联表搜索，比在单个反规范化表中搜索更难优化。
